reviews.author: Cathy L
reviews.title: For a 5 Star Resort - The Reserve - You would expect MUCH better!!!
reviews.text:
Arrived Sunday Nov. 3, 2024 - for a work conference.  The check in process was slow - but that was expected with a large group.  Most of the group had paid for the upgrade to be in The Reserve section of the resort - adults only - along with perks outlined on their website.    
Once in The Reserve - pyramid 5 - we were advised that any issues or concerns moving forward would be addressed at the Customer Service Desk within The Reserve.   
We were escorted to the room we paid for - an OceanView Suite - when the door was opened - there was a very strong chemical smell - ignoring the smell for a moment and excited to see our OceanView - I ran to the curtains to open them...just to find a large grass berm - you could "see" the ocean if you looked past the berm to the left or right - but there was definitely no OceanView - to pay additional for - very disappointing.  
...back to the smell - it was so bad our Bell Hop was waiving his hand in front of his nose - and made the comment "you can not stay here".  
I went to the Customer Service Desk - I sat down to discuss our concerns with ALANDRA - I expressed the fact we paid extra to be in the OceanView Suite and along with the smell - we would like to be moved to another room.  She very quickly and rudely said "no" - no care for our situation at all.  I pleaded with her - stating even their Bell Hop said we could not stay in the room - and she very bluntly again said "no - we have no where to move you"    ....again pleading with not only her - but her coworker beside her (I did not get his name) - I asked that either one "please come to the room to smell the odour - and you will see - we are not able to stay in the room" - they then spoke Spanish to each other ...laughed...and the gentleman looked at me and said "I will not be going anywhere with you ma'am" in a VERY sarcastic manner.    I WAS MORTIFIED....this is a 5 star resort - and we paid EXTRA to be within The Reserve section.  And to be treated this way - I couldn't believe it.   
It was at this time - a concierge came over - understanding I was upset at this time.  He spoke to them and it was only then that we were told they would "try" to help us get a different room.   Three hours later we were shown to a room in Pyramid 4 and settled there - being told we could keep our "Reserve" wrist bands so we could still receive the benefits of paying for The Reserve upgrade. 

After speaking with many of our business associates - they also had the same experience with ALANDRA - she was rude - unwilling to help with concerns that were brought to her attention.  On more than 1 occasion (myself included) we were told that even though we paid the upgrade to be in The Reserve section of the resort - since we booked with a group - we were considered "lesser" (Alandra's words) and we would not receive what the website stated were "perks" of paying for the upgrade in The Reserve section.  Shocked to say the least.

On top of Alandra being so unprofessional:
- the food was...at best...a 6/10 - most of the time coming cold to the table.   
- for being an all inclusive - there were many things that you still needed to pay for if you wanted to take part - food on the menu's / seating at the pool / certain alcohol's
- Spa credits - as part of paying for The Reserve were not honoured because we were part of a group
- MiniBar/Snacks were not replenished daily (for our Reserve business associates either)
- Front Desk - Customer Service - if concerns were brought to them - they also would tell us - they could not help because we booked as a group.  

I just want to make this very clear - when we booked with our group - I am very diligent at researching the resort and pricing myself (I just want to know what we are paying with the group vs. booking ourselves) - I went on Expedia - the exact same dates - in The Reserve - for a OceanView Suite - was $1,500.00 cheaper than what we paid for with the group - so to continually be told we were "lesser" somehow because we booked with a group - we paid $1,500.00 more than if we would have booked ourselves AND we would have not had an issue what-so-ever receiving the "perks" of being a Reserve Guest.   Unreal!

The service outside of The Reserve was great - poolside / waiters/waitresses / cafe's / bars - they were all professional and kind. 

The ONLY thing that deserved a 10/10 for this resort ...the Beach - if you are willing to forego everything I just mentioned above - the Beach is beyond gorgeous!  
White Sands - Turquois Water - Gorgeous!

reviews.author: Paula J
reviews.title: Nice hotel but could use some updating in the rooms
reviews.text: The resort is quite nice. I do love the vines hanging in the interior. I know they have been renovating the hotel and the rooms. Unfortunately we were in a room that wasn't renovated. Most of the plugs didn't work so it was difficult to charge our devices (we had to do some work while at the resort so devices were vital). Having said that the wifi worked well enough to run Zoom meetings so that was great! They were willing to move us but we decided to stay given the proximity to the pool. The staff were excellent - most were very friendly and genuinely wanted to make your stay memorable. I wish I wrote down the names of some of my favourites. There was one woman who seemed to be hosting at whatever restaurant we went to. She remembered that I was vegan which I honestly appreciated. Also, the server at lemon fish brought us our wine in an ice bucket and included two Coors Light as he remembered one of our party of four liked to drink it. He was great! He also brought us fries even though they weren't on the menu...so fun! The food I ate there (vegan sushi) was excellent! The food was was very good overall. I found something I could eat at every restaurant we tried. There was a separate vegan/ vegetarian menu at each place. There were a few times when the menu item was mislabelled as vegan when it contained cheese but overall I think they did a great job of catering to vegans. My only "complaint" was the buffet. I really wish there were some more options. The food I ate was good but a bit repetitive. Maybe a vegan burger for the grill or vegan cheese for the pizza bar (by the pool)? That would be amazing! I know we are in the minority and I really appreciate the effort made to include my preferences. I can't believe how deep the pools are and how warm. I loved it! I have found at other resorts that the pools are shallow and on the cold side. These were anything but! The property was under capacity but I still found that there were not enough loungers and not enough shade. Many of the loungers were also not working entirely - they did not allow for various settings - sitting upright or partially down etc. I do wish there were more swim up bars. I like to be in the quieter area and found that getting a drink was a bit cumbersome. reviews.author: meshellatl
reviews.title: Good for a work conference but wouldn’t pay for a personal vacation
reviews.text:
Mixed feelings about this all-inclusive but glad I didn’t have to pay since it was a work trip. The good: nice private beach area, a couple of good restaurants (Lemon Fish was definitely the best… Flora and Blue Agave were decent… Malva, the buffet, was average) and the overall grounds were nice and well kept. The air conditioning in the conference area was great and they did a good job accommodating all of us (almost 500 people) during lunch.

The reason I wouldn’t pay…. 1) Made sense that the communal areas didn’t have a/c bc it’s a big lobby - would be a nightmare to keep cool. But the room a/c was minimal at best. Luckily, I requested a floor fan and they brought me one so that saved the trip… not sure how I would’ve been able to sleep without it as the room temp with a/c at the lowest setting felt like 75-80 the whole time. 2) Request to get more bottled water took 2 hours and 2 calls to get 3) it just didn’t have the 5 star feeling. The room was dated, there was duct tape holding one of the elevator panels on… for $450/night for their basic room (I extended my stay) it also seemed tacky to charge $5/usd for each room service delivery (and you had to call them to pick up the dishes after). 

Recommendation to the hotel: get Melia to update your app so customers can order through it and stop charging room service delivery. Invest in updating rooms so there isn’t rust around the faucets, better lighting and air conditioning

reviews.author: Musicjaime
reviews.title: Average facility. Good food, excellent breakfast servers.
reviews.text:
I was at the Paradisus last week for a work conference and decided to extend my visit by a day to relax end escape New England winter. I had stayed there last year for the same conference as well, and also extended. The hotel has good and average aspects to it in my opinion. I never wrote last year but meant to so I’ll make my one gripe from that now. I spent 2 nights in the “adults only” Reserve and there were kids running around and screaming constantly in the atrium area like it was their playground. I asked reception about it and they did nothing. At least if they made an exception to allow them with their parents they should have controlled the noise for the benefit of those of us who paid extra for a quieter experience. This year I did not bother with the reserve. The Sante restaurant was good, I thought Sel was average. 
This year I was very specific that I wanted a room with two beds when I made the reservation. I was told that that was noted in the reservation. When I arrived, the “gentleman” who checked me in was not friendly or helpful and when I was specific about the two beds he said the room that had been reserved for me had a king bed and if I wanted a second there was a pullout couch. I pulled up my reservation confirmation to show him the two beds and he didn’t care. The rooms are definitely outdated. Mine smelled musty, the floor was dirty (needed to be polished) and while there was a balcony (I only paid for lagoon view) there was no furniture on it. I wanted to dry my bathing suit a bit with the hair dryer before leaving and it didn’t work. In the gym, the equipment is sparse for a hotel of that size. There were free weights, maybe 5 treadmills and 3 elliptical machines. I tried one elliptical and it didn’t work. I tried another and it worked but only for 10 minute intervals, after which it needed to be reprogrammed. To me, all this combined equals average, not a 5 star “luxury” resort. I don’t need 5 stars personally, but when it is billed as 5 stars and priced as such, I expected more.
I ate in the Mexican, the taco (Blue Agave) and the breakfast restaurants, plus group lunches and dinners for the conference. The restaurants were good overall. The highlight for me was the two servers who took care of the outside space for the breakfast restaurant (definitely sit here and not inside…it is far more pleasant with good music and great views). Manuel and Anatola (I may have gotten this name slightly wrong) were both excellent, remembered me and my colleague every day as well as what we like for beverages and laughed and joked with us easily. We had fun with them and service was excellent, which made breakfast a great start to the day.
I’ll go back again next year if the conference is there again and will likely extend my stay by a day or two again, but have a realistic perspective of what to expect, and not. Maybe two beds next year…

reviews.author: Enrique G
reviews.title: It used to be a very good place.
reviews.text:
Congratulations to Stelian my concierge and the pool/beach restaurant team at The Reserve including Gaby, Valeria and the boys in black. Yes, much of the staff does everything they can to ensure you have a very good experience. Here are some of the points why I would seriously consider returning to this hotel that I have been visiting for several years:
ROOM: On the wall at the head of the bed there is an LED strip which is a good detail. However, in my room they didn't turn off completely so during the night you had light in your face. Despite having reported it repeatedly, maintenance did nothing during the entire stay. Quite uncomfortable. Likewise, a report was made of a problem in the shower which was mediocrely repaired.
RESTAURANTS: For specialty restaurants, someone had the idea of eliminating the reservation system. Now, one must sign up at the time of consumption, to which the response is to return within an hour and a half!!! This is not ideal, is it? In the case of “Cielito Lindo” the hostess's comment was that, despite there being tables available, she only had one waiter and one cook so she could not assign tables.
RECEPTION: Being 2:50 pm they tell me to go eat and return later since the hotel's policy is to deliver the rooms at 3:00 pm. Really? I waited right there until three o'clock struck. At that time I had the comment that “there is no certainty that the room is clean” and that there is no communication with the corresponding area. Indeed, Housekeeping did not answer the phone.
ROOM SERVICE: I called to request more Nespresso capsules (there are four in the room), I received the response that this was my daily allocation and that they would not take them to me, which they did. I mention that in four days I only consumed: two light cokes, some peanuts, a package of Oreos and yes, a lot of coffee. It seems that there is a new definition about ALL INCLUSIVE.
EVENTS: I attended a talk in its main room. Food was served at the end of it. The dishes could be said to be “minimalist” not to mention scarce, and if something other than water was required, one had to leave the room to get the desired drink.

CONCLUSION: In this location what was paid was well worth it. This time it wasn't. The reason for my visit was an event of an institution. I did not pay the event fee but registered normally paying the “full” rate at The Reserve so there is no pretext that I had a reduced rate. Anyway, I received comments from the executives of the organizing institution that we will most likely not return next year, with good reason and it is a shame. When I commented here that I would not return to Melia Nuevo Vallarta five years ago, of course I fulfilled it!!!

- Attitude of the waiters and concierge is very bad.
- They received a large group and it couldn't be that they didn't prepare with enough supplies, in all the consumption centers they didn't have what they offered on the menu, if we asked for certain dishes their response was "oh no, we don't have that one" until They said they didn't have water of the day.
- In the bar on the 1st floor we requested a snack (peanuts, since most bars offer them and being an all-inclusive hotel we assumed they had them)
and the response from the waiters and bartenders was "oh no, we don't handle peanuts here, sometimes we take the leftover snack from a quarter of the ones they put in the rooms) what answer is that?"
Minutes later when we tipped $100 pesos, they were able to get a snack and brought it to us.
- There is no good communication between the staff, they gave us the wrong timetables at the consumption centers, they said that the last sitting was 10:30 and once you arrived at the restaurant they told you no, it was 10:00 pm

I don't know if the employees don't feel motivated by their bosses but if I ask them to improve the service, I was quite surprised by the negative attitude of the staff being a hotel in Cancun.

reviews.author: Tam N
reviews.title: Whatever you do, do not book here!!!!
reviews.text: This place is absolute horrible. Front desk staff has zero clue about customer service or being proactive regarding concerns from guest. Everything is simply ignored and pushed off to the next shift. No issue I brought to this staff was ever addressed and even when it was it was 2+ hours for any kind of resolution!  And to be clear they never resolved anything without prompting. I wouldn’t suggest booking here if you’re looking to have a restful and relaxing vacation. Now if you want a vacation where  you’re constantly arguing for basics like towels or even having a room with  working plumbing (literally no water in the suite and couldn’t flush the toilet)  this is the place for you. Water dripping from the ceiling outside the room for two days. When I reported it to Johnathan he said they would have to investigate…I said no need let me show you the video! It’s like this place opened yesterday and everyone in management is clueless! Literally everyone! They offered a spa service to accommodate us for our troubles…this is after three days of fighting but at that point why would I trust you all to do ANYTHING! Now the wait staff worked hard and as best they could but I certainly see why they went on strike a week ago! Do. Not. Book. Don’t waste your money!

reviews.author: jamesV8732NO
reviews.title: 3-star, not a 5 star property
reviews.text: Needs a renovation. Property calls itself a 5-star; it is three star at best. All areas including guestrooms need a renovation. Very worn looking. AC was LOUD in the guestrooms. Some of my associates had rooms that would not cool down. No AC in open lobby areas - very hot and humid. And this is not open air - these areas are separated by doors to the exterior. Staff was very friendly and food was ok. Lemon Fish (Paid restaurant) the food was great.

reviews.author: Amadea N
reviews.title: ABSOLUTELY AWFUL AND I WILL NEVER VISIT MEXICO AGAIN
reviews.text:
EVERYTHING is wrong with this place. To be clear, I stayed at the Reserve side of Paradisus Cancun. This means $500USD/night. My company then had an offsite at the regular side of Paradisus Cancun. This is  day 3/10 and I’m already close to tears. 

Service:
They love to talk the talk, but won’t walk the walk. Everyone here is trained to be super nice and accommodating, but when push comes to shove, it’s still a no no no. 

Day 1 - Check-in:
On checkin, they found two bookings as my company  booked through the reservation desk and there were two overlapping nights. My company confirmed with me they had not booked the overlap, but the front desk kept insisting I pay the additional cost. They did this “pleasantly” by showing me a piece of paper with the amount due repeatedly. I insisted no, and they
 kept going back and forth/calling people/checking with managers until after an hour or so confirmed they would not charge me the overlap and cancel it on their own. Given the mishap, which made me miss the sunset/ability to go to the pool or beach, management said we could keep our Reserve wristbands throughout our whole stay. 

The Reserve room, Junior Suite Ocean View:
The room was nice upon arrival, the view was really nice. But the room felt “new” and it’s hard to explain until you experience it itself but once again it was like the service - empty promises. Things were broken, super cheap, lights wouldn’t turn off, TV only played cable and couldn’t connect to anything despite having all the right cables. 

The Reserve concierge experience:
As part of the Reserve, you get a personal concierge that communicates with you via text and is supposed to book things for you. Great! Don’t get excited, it’s just a texting buddy. Because they don’t onboard you - they don’t tell you what parts of the resort require reservations (that they help you to book). Why does this matter?

Things that require a reservation here:
1. ALL restaurants except the Mexican place and the buffet place. This means if you do not reserve, you will NOT be eating at any of these restaurants. We arrived on Saturday, and everything was booked upon arrival. ??? 
2. Bali beds by the pool AT THE RESERVE SECTION THAT YOU PAY FOR. All beds are booked, they remain unoccupied for hours but you can’t have them unless you actually book them through your concierge. The service staff will tell you to leave nicely though LOL 

So yes, we paid the Reserve price but could never use any of these exclusive things LOL. 

CALCULATIVE to the tee:
Forget hospitality here. It’s all about what they can overcharge you for. Spent so much time negotiating with the front desk that you are right up to your checkout time? $50 an hour if you want to have a late checkout. 

Bring your own stuff because the cheapest small bottle sunscreen here is $27USD. My boyfriend bought one and left it at the counter of the shop, we came back the next morning for it and they said they’d have to check the cameras and it would take 3-days. Made us buy the sunscreen again. 

Coconut water? $10 each coconut 

Daybeds? $250 each. 

Food:
The Mexican place is dank, and I think it’s because it does exactly what it does without trying to pass off as a international cuisine. All other international foods were subpar. WITHOUT MY CONCIERGE’S HELP, because she had told me it was impossible, I managed to get into Sal. Sal is a steakhouse included in the Reserve experience, but reservation only. We got there right on opening and waited an hour for the host to see if he could fit us in. Despite the restaurant being 40% empty, they gave us a table. Food was ok. 

If you don’t drink alcohol, which we do not, this resort is not worth it. Their regular drinks are bad, their fruit juice is all canned and not actual juice. I’ve only been drinking water and while writing this seated at Senta, I have purchased a $10 coconut.

Check-out/Switching rooms:
Despite having already booked me for the second room AND not granting me a late checkout, the Reserve front desk said my next room would not be available until 3pm. On checkout, they said we would have to return our Reserve wristbands, even though they had said we did not need to as a courtesy. Seeing that this was another empty promise, I insisted and they obliged. This band only gives me access to the Reserve pool, no food or reserve desk etc. 

TLDR: ABSOLUTELY NOT. I could be paying $500 a night at a plethora of other hotels and being perfectly satisfied. But no, I’ve been on the brink of tears since arriving and today I finally cracked.

reviews.title: Conference Stay

reviews.text: The Paradisus Cancún is beautiful, warm, it has a heart! Lunch at Lunch Box, dinner at Lemon Fish  served by the most efficient waiter ever- Alejandro Camelo. Alejandro deserves to be commended and he needs to share the secret to his amazing skills. He is a thoroughbred professional. Fernanda Paola at reservations was so kind, patient and helpful as our trip neared. She supported with all information. She is a leader. reviews.author: Traveller & Foodie
reviews.title: Back to this hotel after five years - third visit in fifteen years
reviews.text: I came here for business meetings again, not by choice. Five years later and I get an outdated room again. Maybe some rooms are renovated but don't be fooled by the website pictures. My friend's room ceiling collapsed while she was in the room because of water damage.   She was lucky not to get hurt.   The hotel changed her room and upgraded to the V.I.P section.   My room had two queen beds.  The balcony overlooking the lagoon was not very appealing; the chairs were dirty, and so was the balcony, but great views. I also called to complain I had no hot water; the receptionist told me to let the water run longer. I took cold showers during my whole stay.   The buffet restaurant had a good selection of food. The wine in the all-inclusive package was horrible. We could order wine; however, if it is all-inclusive, please have decent wine for the guests. The restaurants were ok, not fine cuisine but acceptable. The pools and the beach are lovely; come early to find good chairs. The lobby where you check in is charming, then the main area in the middle of the hotel is a central jungle of plants; that produces too much humidity. In fifteen years, I have been here three times. I think it's time they change this look. Although the hotel seemed short-staffed, most employees I ran into were always pleasant at the bar and restaurants. I have to add I appreciated the coffee shop at the exit to the main pool area with muffins and donuts. I tried to change my room, but because it's a group reservation, the staff told me it was impossible. The best part of this hotel is the ocean view rooms, pool area and beach views. Depending on which room you get once you check in can change your experience.

reviews.author: TimeForATrip
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Food was great! Japanese style dishes. Rafael gave us such great service. The atmosphere of the restaurant was very nice and it provided a relaxing meal. If I were given the chance to come back, I would definitely take it. Thank you!

reviews.title: Amazing food at Agua Marina!
reviews.text:
Agua Marina restaurant in Paradisus Cancun is amazing! Francisco, our server, and Chef Ventura created the best dinner because we wanted it all: marlin tacos, chips & guac, a dozen oysters, THEN our entree was customized with lobster tail, octopus, and filet mignon with potato, risotto, and grilled vegetable accompaniments. The best dinner EVER! Cheers!

reviews.text:

reviews.author: Usman B
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: After visiting 6 resorts and numerous restaurants I can honestly say Lemon Fish has been the best experience ever and special thanks to Jorge & Miguel who were our servers along with Mario & Karen the chefs! I can not emphasize enough how amazing they all were and making our dinner the best night so far! Hands down they deserve a 10/10!!!!!

reviews.author: Dianie C
reviews.title: DO NOT Recommend!!!
reviews.text:
Worst experience ever! What a rude environment! We spent almost 2 hours to check in. During that time we asked 3 different customers service reps to help us check in perhaps at a different counter, and they all said that we needed to wait for assistance at the counter we were at, because that was the only one available at that time. After it was finally our turn the girl at the counter told us we needed to go to a different counter because we were part of a group that were there for a convention and the other counter had all of our information and she didn't (but all counters have the same system, so how come she wouldn't be able to see our info?). I refused to go to another counter to start another line after waiting almost 2 hrs for them to tell me that, and after 3 people from their staff had assured us that's where we needed to check in at. After I firmly told her a few times I was not going anywhere else, she decided to check us in.
Also, when I was making the reservation online their system refused my card 3 times telling it declined. I checked with my bank and they confirmed the hotel never ran it through, therefore the bank never declined the transaction, so their system was acting up. I then decided to use the PayPal option they had available at their site. The transaction went finally through. Going back to the day we checked in, the girl at the counter decided to tell me that she was going to have to reverse the transaction because I used PayPal and it was under my business name and not my personal name (so why take the payment in the first place?) What the heck is wrong with this people??? After arguing for a while we were finally able to get our room keys... THE ROOM: Hot as hell! The entire hotel is hot. There is no way to get the AC pumping in your room, they control it. There is not enough lighting either. The phone didn't work. And the wall outlets have all been closed so you can hardly find where to plug your phone or even your flat iron!!! Some of our friends had problems also from lights not working AT ALL to even being getting someone else's room! Imagine being changed from room to room 3X and going into one and finding someone else already there. SHM!
We went into one of their restaurants and when one of my friends went to go serve herself she was told in a very rude way to put the serving spoon back, wait 5 min and come back, because they weren't ready and they were doing us a favor by opening a few minutes earlier. Ahh! And be ready for only bottom-shelf spirits. I mean, we supposedly are at a 5 Star Hotel (not cheap at all!!!), so you would expect some sort of better customer service and come on! Better maintenance too! I DO NOT recommend this place to nooo one! Cancún is beautiful and their people are nice, except for that inhospitable place!!! Very disappointed.

reviews.author: Ms. Young
reviews.title: Attended a business event at Paradsisus Resort
reviews.text:
The    Paradisus is a beautiful, all inclusive resort in Cancun. The staff in all areas of the hotel were #1. They were sweet, easy spoken, helpful and polite. They took the time to take care of all of your needs. I ate at the Malva Restaurant most days there. I came in the next night and the waiter remembered me and told me that I had lost an earring there the night before. I couldn't believe it. The guest services rep, Raul was really nice and held conversation with me while I waited for security to bring my earring. 
The room is large but a little dated. The junior suite does not have enough electrical outlets and some of the lights did not work. The property it self is absolutely beautiful and I would highly recommend it to anyone traveling to Cancun.

reviews.author: Robert B
reviews.title: Best place for a conference ever!
reviews.text: This was the most memorable experience we've ever had at a resort. We came with 42 people for a conference. The resort was clean and beautiful. The staff we incredibly helpful and regularly going above and beyond our expectations. The facilities and amenities were perfect. There are only positive things I would say about the whole thing. We will definitely be going back and recommend 100%

reviews.author: Belle W
reviews.title: Beautiful space & great service
reviews.text: We held an industry retreat at the Paradisus Cancun and the space was stunning! Beautiful views, and lovely amenities. Our service was fabulous and the team we had taking care of us (go Diana and Nataly!) were extremely helpful. Definitely recommend :)

reviews.author: Jordan R
reviews.title: AC Retreat
reviews.text: Nat and Diana went above and beyond for our retreat.  Can't say enough about them both.  The resort was fantastic.  Great staff, wonderful food, and amazing atmosphere.  Highly recommended for biz or pleasure

reviews.author: Amber
reviews.title: Boujee
reviews.text: Don’t believe the negativity. The resort was very clean, the staff was amazing. We had a private check in since we were there for business but the staff went above and beyond to make us comfortable: beautiful drinks when we arrived, our room was ready on time and we loved the key bracelets! So much nicer than plastic neon ones. We spent most of our time on the adult side so I can only speak to that: the restaurants were fabulous, the buffet always had something to eat even if your picky, we also had 24 hour room service and a fully stocked mini bar with 3 different kinds of beers; chips, peanuts, candy, all the things so if you really aren’t happy with the food.. you can’t blame the resort lol. There was gorgeous solariums and decor all throughout one of the most lovely entrances I’ve seen. There was no pressure for tips (of course appreciated) we found transportation easily off the resort and overall just had a 10/10 experience. This is my 5th time to Mexico and I’ve been to a few different resorts in my travels. This was by far the best. Sadly I didn’t take too many photos because I was too busy having an absolute blast and enjoying the beauty and serenity of the resort.

reviews.author: Britnee O
reviews.title: Princess house
reviews.text: The staff at the hotel paradisus has the best service/staff BY FAR! Truly the best experience ever. The staff goes above and beyond. We got to meet Alfredo, Alberto,Rafael& didier ❤️ Can’t wait to be back !

reviews.author: Marnae L
reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: Axcel was great playing volleyball with us. We played on the beach and in the pool. Then we also did pole dancing with Gina and Axcel. Pool food needs to up their game. Nothing even remotely healthy. Need better options. Beach service was good though

reviews.author: Dan B
reviews.title: Lemon Fish Service as Food
reviews.text:
Alejandro Camelo really looked after us. He was amazing,he suggested all the best menu items and kept the food and wine coming. 
We had all the sushi and Nigri abs were not disappointed. We also had the shark tacos which were very tasty. We finished off with the spiced pineapple dessert which was the cherry on top! 
Make sure to visit Alejandro at the Lemon Fish. You won’t be disappointed.

reviews.author: Julie C
reviews.title: A taste of paradise
reviews.text:
Beautiful area and wonderful ocean however it was an added extra touch to have such thoughtful and kind servers- Samuel Sosi and Martin.  

Regardless of what time I came down, Samuel Sosi and Martin  remembered me and my drink preferences and made sure to say hello even though I'm sure there are thousands of guests.  

I'm just going to suggest that their manager, Rafael, give them a paid vacation and a raise. ;) 

Mucho gracies!!!

reviews.author: Randy S
reviews.title: Those who served us this week at Paradisis Cancun were awesome!
reviews.text:
Atilano and Orlando were amazing servers in the buffet restaurant! They treated us like family!

Laura was an exceptional server it by the pool. She got to know us throughout the week and was so kind and attentive!

reviews.author: PacmanSanDiego
reviews.title: Do Not Think Twice
reviews.text:
Literally blown away! We have a medical company and we came here for our 10 year anniversary. I was so nervous because usually the service, food options and alcohol quality can differ so much from resort to resort in Cancun. 

However Paradisus Cancun blew it out of the water for our company trip, I can’t think of a single complaint. If you are considering all-inclusive for a company trip or a family reunion, look no further. 

Also so many people I could shout out but our group host Nataly was amazing. I would hire her to work for our customer service department if I could. Nataly, thank you so much for making our trip, our company event and even the beach party. This hotel is lucky to have you.

reviews.author: Excursion635709
reviews.title: Excellent service oriented resort, with or without kids 😊😎
reviews.text:
This resort is geared towards service and making sure you have everything you need. A great all inclusive resort.
Tonight was the best experience of all. I had a package delivered that was essential for work. The bell hop David Hilario was so very kind and helpful and then I went to guest services and Wen Wagner went out of her way to get the package. They went searching at 9:00pm!!!!   To my enormous relief, Wen came back with my package after going out of her way, she had to get into the package area that was closed and then find it and she ran with purpose!  Icing on the cake of a fantastic work (and a little vacation) Thank you so much to Paradisus Cancun for your commitment to taking care of your guests.  Wen Wagner and David Hilario, I am grateful for you both.  
Thank you!

reviews.author: BoardingPass562625
reviews.title: Precious Moments has excellent customer service!
reviews.text: Guendoline Flores Navarro with the Precious Moments  department really helped to arrange and surprise my wife for Valentine’s Day. She helped to surprise my wife with sunflowers, champagne, and a massage. Guendoline was very responsive, creative, and she followed through with everything we had discussed in a timely fashion. I would highly recommend working with her!

reviews.author: ReneeW
reviews.title: 2nd trip to Paradisus is paradise!
reviews.text: Excellent service and lovely well maintained resort. Food is really good. Not all restaurants were open but there was enough variety to enjoy many different options. Beach is beautiful and private. Guest services is amazing and will work hard to make special requests a reality. Thank you to Luis and Daniella!

reviews.author: Siri R
reviews.title: FUN Relaxing Stay
reviews.text:
Came to Paradissus for Business trip ended up coming with my wife a few days early.  

While lounging by the pool met a fun group of people played some awesome games beach volleyball and pool volleyball.  

 Agustin AKA “Tequila Guy” was so much fun and hilarious.  He  kept the games going, recruited people and made our stay fun, relaxing and enjoyable.  

Thanks Paradissus and Agustin “Tequila Guy” for the great memories 👏

reviews.author: Ashanti
reviews.title: Liliana @ Yhi Spa
reviews.text:
Liliana is amazing! I got the relaxation massage and she was so great I had to come back the next day! 
Highly recommend her to get out those knots and kinks . She was also very kind. Thank you Liliana!

reviews.author: Janiceraneross
reviews.title: Lemon Fish Restaurant
reviews.text: After a long flight and chaotic airport experience we were greeted with a refreshing beverage and clean beautiful room.    We did not read the fine print requiring a reservation to eat at the “fine restaurants but showed up hungry at Lemon Fish.   After much pleading we got a seating       Rafael our waiter was superb.   He detailed the menu and made excellent suggestions on the food and drinks.      In addition Rafael gave us traveling tips on the resort, pesos and nightlife at the resort.    Lemon Fish was a 5+ and Rafael will see us again before we leave

reviews.author: Alberto G
reviews.title: Ginger Bar 2
reviews.text:
Mi más sincera felicitación para Wendy Morales del Ginger Bar 2 (siempre pensé se llamaría Sports Bar o algo similar) si bien todos al momento de brindar el servicio que les corresponda Wendy se destaca sobre todos por su amabilidad, vocación de servicio y platica amena.
My sincere congratulations to Wendy Morales from Ginger Bar 2 (I always thought it would be called Sports Bar or something similar) although everyone at the time of providing the service that corresponds to them Wendy stands out above all for her kindness, service vocation and pleasant conversation.

reviews.author: Emily H
reviews.title: Wonderful trip!
reviews.text:
What can I say about the last 8 days to sum up our experience??! 
It was awesome!   The service is wonderful, the food was amazing! Views spectacular! 

We stayed in the reserve side.  A definite if you can swing the extra $$.    We loved that there weren't kids on that side so all you hear from your Bali bed were conversations and the ocean.  I'm glad the party and daily DJ were on the other side, we could join that when we wanted to.  We had 2 concierges that split our week.    They accommodated every request.  Dinner reservations, room change requests etc. Big thank you to Ceci (Ce-CHI!) and Violeta! 

Sante restaurant was our favorite for breakfast and lunch.  It's in the reserve, so quiet and wonderful. Amazing food on the patio under shade with an amazing view.  (see photos) The menus are at this resort are creative and wonderful.  We noted at the pool that those complaining about the food didn't even try anything!  They didn't recognize anything on the menu and would leave!  What a shame.  If you are looking to eat American food all week and hotdogs, go somewhere else. We were NOT disappointed with anything we ordered the entire week.  (And we are foodies and travelers) Everything was cooked perfectly from lamb to steak to fish.  They are extremely accommodating- anything you want, they will do it so just ask.  We would combine favorite menu items together etc.  Hats off the chefs here.  It was great!
Pool service on the reserve side was unbeatable.  Thank you to Lucas, the pool concierge,  for getting our bali bed everyday with a smile!  Because we were there for 8 days we had different wait staff at Sante for breakfast and for the pool.  A huge shout out to Valeria, Ruben, Moises, Joel, Julio, Josue, Yamil, and Maria!  And to Oscar for sharing your love of Tequila, the amazing history lesson and taste testing!   We appreciate Tequila now!  They were ALL fabulous.   Seriously, thank you everyone. 

The absolute only thing I can complain about is it is definitely hot in the lobby.  It's structured like a botanical garden so beautiful and unique, but humid like a greenhouse.  I don't know if this is on purpose or something needs to be fixed.  It did make dining at the buffet during the day uncomfortable (its fine at night) and the Italian restaurant, which is located in a side part of the main lobby, is very warm in there.  Some restaurants have outdoor seating only so make reservations about 8pm when the sun is down.  It's pleasant and they have fans.   Sals and Blue Agave have great air conditioning as well as the sports bar in Ginger lounge.
We did have to call for a fan in our room which helped tremendously.  If you like it cold when you sleep, the rooms do not get colder than 70/71, a common theme among those we met also.  The Asian restaurant is under construction in the middle of the lobby.  
No place is perfect and this would not keep us from coming back!  We miss it already.  Melia has not disappointed us thus far.  We enjoyed this as much as Spain and Orlando.

reviews.author: Kindel
reviews.title: Amazing Staff
reviews.text:
We had a lovely, relaxing time at The Paradisus Playa del Carmen for a corporate event September 16-20, 2021. The staff was exceptionally polite and helpful. Everyone always had their masks on and could speak very good English. Lots of cleaning being done all the time and it was super convenient to have COVID testing on site. We felt very safe here. 

Special shout out to Ivan who served us at the Market Restaurant, Luis at Fuego and our favorite Jose at the Water 💦 Park for the incredible and personal service. 

Mil gracias Jose para el servicio rápido y amigable. Nuestros mejores deseos a ti y tu familia.

reviews.author: Renato D
reviews.title: Bana sushi paradisus
reviews.text:
Bana restaurant was so good and Rafael and Guilherme  gave us a really nice service during our dinner.
Great experience, from the start to the desert. The restaurant was beautiful and good vibes around.

reviews.author: richi671
reviews.title: Accountant
reviews.text: My experience at Paradisus Cancun was a delicacy among the choices available in the hospitality business. The staff is caring, the food is delightful, and the activities and amenities are pristine. Best value for an all-inclusive so far.

reviews.author: Shelby Richardson
reviews.title: WONDERFUL SERVICE
reviews.text: We came to Fuego for breakfast and enjoyed our visit so much that we came back for lunch the same day. Both meals we were taken care of by Atilano, Eddie, David, and Arnulfo and they were spectacular. I wish we found them sooner as we probably would’ve come here for every meal. Thank you for the best service and your kind gestures. We will be back!

reviews.author: Ramon Zapata Sirvent
reviews.title: Excellent service and great people
reviews.text: Everything great. Hostess: Tete; Capitán: Guillermo Cuenca; Mesero: Moisés; Chef: Ángel. Thank you very much, excellent service and food. Thank you again. A number 1; excellent; come and enjoy this excellent service

reviews.author: Kaden K
reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text:
Stayed here for a week on a company trip. There were some stand out employees! Salvador is the best bar tender ever, he was crazy busy but made you feel important and was creative with drinks and remembered you each time you would come up. His team was very helpful as well of Karina and Sofonia were making sure the drinks were passed out and collected so the area remained clean. 

Also my wife and I had a couples massage and Anna had as our masseuse. She gave the best massage I’ve ever had, I would highly recommend getting a massage by her to anyone who stays here.

reviews.author: MATTHEW SCOLES
reviews.title: VP SALES AT KNIGHT WATCH
reviews.text:
We had our company trip here. The staff went out of there way to make us feel welcome. The resort itself was beautiful. The food and restaurants were aesthetically very classy. The rooms were very nice. The royal service butlers and maids were off the charts. Daniel and Rosanna were so accommodating.
Melia is a first class company. The wait staff for banquets

reviews.author: Salvador C
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text:
Excellent installations , location and management down to waiters . Starting  with Mr Martinez , Mr Ascencio , Sonyia , Mr Palesti , Iran , Mario , Alex, Daniel , Nachito , Christian , Sandra , to mention some . Not to forget the cooks ( Angel , Hector , and the others ,,,, ex relent team .
Will send everyone I know to Paradisus Cancun ! See you guys soon .

reviews.author: Sanyam G
reviews.title: Very luxurious
reviews.text: Superb all inclusive resort! Great private beach, amazing drinks, good service. Resort has everything you would want, multiple restaurants, bars, pools, a club, casino, golf course, spa and everything that you can think of. A must stay place if in Cancun.

reviews.author: Hugo S
reviews.title: Great!!!
reviews.text:
Business meeting with  partners of US /MX /CAN very nice hotel with a lot of garden. Clean beach!!! Excellent food. Comfortable alocations. Several pools. Very nice environtment. Friendly guys.
Reccomended!!

reviews.author: Sherri
reviews.title: HOT & FILTHY
reviews.text:
Arroved Tuesday August 12th....  The lobby was an inferno.  Not a little hot, but Mayan  Aztec "you aint made for this heat" HOT!  Its the hottest Ive ever been INSIDE a building I literally sweated all my make up and eyelashes off while I waited to be checked in... LITERALLY! ( the lobby wasnt hot like that everyday but Friday morning at 8 am in the morning is was back to blazing HEAT hot in the lobby.  I came in sweating and they sent me off in a sweaty mess as well.  

So lets talk about my 5 star resort room.  My first room was FILTHY!  Walked in the door and the odor of mildew and the sweet scent of past quest sweat wafted into my nostrils.  I looked around the room which had obviously outlived its youth and tried to mentally move past the dread that was now seeping through me.  I went into denial.  Hey I was in Cancun, like how bad can it be.  Just unpack I said and go to the pool!  So I threw my suit case down opened it up and thats when I got a good look at the couch.  Not only was the frame OBVIOUSLY broken and you couldnt sit on it,  it was stained in a way that only people with small children or drunken relatives would understand.  Looking at the couch mad me start to scratch and itch like I had become allergic to it.  I thought it was my imagination and then my roomate started slapping herself and screaming....  the room had gnats, lots of them!  Oh by the way the outlets in the room didnt work as well.

FInally I accepted I was not going to make it to the pool to cool off after I had literally melted in the lobby the first time and went back to request another room....  hours later we got another room after the manager tried to convince me to sleep in the filthy stankin gnat infested room and he would upgrade me the next day.  I told him to get me transport back to the airport and explain to my company who was paying for this trip why I wouldnt be able to attend the functions.  By the way the pictures of hanging frabric is actually from the box spring in the 1st room, so its fair to say the bedding was less than desirable.

So the second room was clean and defintely more updated...  I still wouldnt call it luxurious but I didnt feel like I was sleeping in a cest pool.  However,  workers from the hotel begin to use the room directly next door from mine as a staging area for their spray painting projects  LITERALLY.  There were all out on the patio  and had the door to the room open because apparently they were chocking as well from the industrial spray paint machine they were using.  Unfortunately they didnt give us mask as well so we started to choke. So back to the inferno, im sorry I mean Lobby I go so we wait for another room....  rooms they initally said THEY DID NOT HAVE!

Its past 10 pm when we get a decent room...  we are still in the clothes we flew in and having been sweating profusely in from the moment we walked into this Hot Box of a resort.  No pool...  no nothing but back in forth to the lobby.  We never had a chance to fix ourselves up for the company dinner and arrived over an hour late.  Did I mention I was suppose to give a speech?  Anywho I was happy to at least sleep in a clean room that night.  I expectactions had been drastically lowered.

Oh by the way.... they owe me a new IPHONE.  My phone would charge sporatically on and off and sometime not at all.  Then the second day I took the cord out of the ipone and literally found soot around the connection like it had been burnt. Now my phone wont charge at ALL!  I checked with other people in my group who experienced the same thing.  Then the last day I overheard the people at the front desk say that its not an AC problem its and electrical problem  that they are working on that is affecting the AC.  Which makes sense im sure my phone took a power surge and was fried.  

 There are multiple people from my group with their own individual horror story.  I will let them share that independently.  Believe me whoever at corporate who booke the hotel is about to catch some heat from some VERY UNHAPPY top producers!

Please puruse the attached pictures at your leisure!

reviews.author: dbaird2019
reviews.title: Make sure the A/C in your room works.
reviews.text: Our overall experience was positive, with the exception of the service for the a/c in our room, and the inability of front staff to make decisions on their own to provide a “problem fixed” experience.

reviews.author: gsolo
reviews.title: 5 star prices for 2 star quality of food
reviews.text:
First impression at checkin is excellent, great service, attentive, good bilingual communication. Lobby and central patio are impressive and certainly attractive. So is the pool and beach area.

Hotel was built in the 80's and needs significant remodelling. Rooms are aged, only one working electric outlet in the entire room, none next to beds, other outlets were used for TV or nightstand light. Air Conditioning never dropped below 78F (24C) even at 3am.
Very small step into bathroom can be a killer at night. Mirror is rusted and at checkin water was out, it came back an hour later.
Fully stocked refrigerator, but another member of our convention drank the chocolate milk and got food poisoning, later realized it had expired a while back.

Breakfast at Naos is excellent, lots of options for adults and kids. Service is good.
Other restaurants have great presentation of food, but very poor quality, wine is very cheap, I was unable to drink it, and meat is tough, after trying meat dishes at three restaurants, I went to chicken and pork for the rest of my stay. Drinks are served to the minimum, and had to request refills often, rather than giving you a good amount.

The entire hotel has an air conditioning problem, most rooms are warm, even the conference rooms. In a city that is so hot, you want a convenient 72-74F (21-23C) room temperature to cool down.

reviews.author: FlashLosAngeles
reviews.title: Great room and beach, forget the front desk
reviews.text: I was in Cancun on business.  When trying to check out the night before departure -- I had a 4 AM pick up for the airport -- I realized that there were errors on the bill and they could not run the final bill since the last night would not post until later that evening.  While I believed that we resolved some, but not all of the errors, and was not completely pleased before going to bed late, I did expect that I would receive a copy of the bill when leaving the hotel at 4 AM.  At 4 AM they could not give me a copy, I was told to leave my email, which I did and that they would email me later that day.  Well, now more that 2 weeks later no copy of the bill, which is critical for travel reimbursement.  Not only that, but in calling the hotel they could not provide me with a bill.  Perhaps it is ok for a vacation but not for a conference in Cancun. In addition, I came back ill, which I believe was from the ice.

reviews.author: Jim S
reviews.title: Great Experience @ Paradisus
reviews.text: I stayed at the resort for 3 nights for a business conference.  Hotel was very well maintained with beautiful public areas and expansive pool(s) and beach areas.  Rooms were nicely appointed and the conference facilities were very good.  What really stuck out for me was the great employees.  I have stayed at a number of all inclusive resorts in the Caribbean and Central America and have always been very disappointed in the attentiveness, professionalism & attentiveness of the staff.  I can say without a doubt that Paradisus was the best experience I've had hands-down.  Everyone I encountered was polite and very helpful, from the porters to the servers to the front desk personnel.  Had a wonderful time at the resort and plan to come back with my family for a vacation.

reviews.author: Macnhoz
reviews.title: Only love
reviews.text: We went here on a huge group trip. Wow . The service is over the top. Extra nice on everyone’s part. The beach was clean and cozy. Pool and bar rocks. The hotel was alittle hot even for a southern boy . The food was ok but the display was great. I caught fish from the shore of the hotel. Great place and I would go back.

reviews.author: Adventurer652895
reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.text: Second time here and will be back for a third. The whole food, hotel,beach is perfect. Staff is very attentive and helpful to guest. The Adults Only Royal Service is the way to go if it's an option...

reviews.author: Crdbl
reviews.title: Work Reward!
reviews.text: Visited Paradisus as a reward for my jobs 2018 accomplishments. First time we went out the country but we were sure to make the best of it for how hard we worked. The Hotel made that easy. We spent days by the pool and he service there was great. They made sure we had a good time. Michael, Sergio and Rene helped us each day even when it came to getting the Cabanas for the day. At night we had reservations at different restaurants but the food was always good. Fuego was my favorite. This trip was so good, the views, the pools, the beach. I have to bring my family back next time.

reviews.author: Marvin Theodore
reviews.title: My home for unforgettable experiences
reviews.text:
Paradisus Cancun took the word paradise and turned into an experience to be remembered. 

I'll never forget the warm authentic greeting that I recieved right out my airport transportation. Then there is an entire rainforest jungle integrated into the facility that is the size of an entire shopping mall!

The view of the beach and the ocean are clearly seen from just about every window. The service is led by people that actually WANT to be there, a crucial factor that must not be ignored. 

The food quality, the waiters and the view while eating all combine to an unforgettable experience.

The area is clean and there's always technicians discreetly working proactively on the maintenance of the facility. 

Introverts will especially love the huge quiet area if ever in need of some introspective space to breath and just be. 

There are front desks everywhere to serve you and solve any issues with breathtaking decor at every angle.

reviews.author: 2SunsetSailors
reviews.title: Guacamole Workshop
reviews.text:
What to do after a long luxurious breakfast and a morning basking by the pool?

A fun, informative and delicious Guacamole making class where you literally get to eat the fruits of your labor! 

Chef Diana & interpreter Angel Avel guided us effortlessly through the process of customizing guacamole to our own tastes. They took the time to offer additional ideas of ingredients we may like to create our own custom recipe once we return home. 

I highly recommend skipping (or delaying) your siesta to take this  short workshop hosted by knowledgeable and personable staff at Paradisus Cancun.

Angel Avel, interpreter & Diana, Chef

reviews.author: Quincy S
reviews.title: Beautiful Property / Poor Communication
reviews.text: Visited Cancun for a long weekend on a company trip. The property is beautiful. The staff is friendly and helpful. BUT....check in and check out are long and involved. Communication is poor as to exactly what services are included in the upgrades, how check out works, and group dinner reservations were difficult. There was no communication as to shows and activities going on at the property so we missed a lot of fun. BUT...the property is beautiful and the staff are friendly. Overall it was a wonderful, relaxing trip.

reviews.author: TravelerForLifeNow
reviews.title: This place is a dump.  Don't be fooled by the reviews here
reviews.text: This is the 2nd year I was forced to attend a conference at this hotel by my employer.  The food is absolutely HORRIBLE.  The resort while having the appearance of being clean is filled with mold.  The resort burns incense continuously to mask the horrible smells of mold and rot.  The resorts is very dated and dark. And if you stay in the main town, they play blaring music well into the night.  I would NEVER bring my family here and hope I never have to stay here again.  If you like nice, airy, CLEAN resorts with good food there are so many other choices in Cancun.  Heed my warning

reviews.author: Shannon S
reviews.title: Had an AMAZING trip
reviews.text:
We had an AMAZING trip! All of the staff were so helpful and friendly! LOVED the energy of the dancers and the music playing all weekend. Would highly recommend and WILL be coming back. 

Rodrigo, Julio, and Saul were amazing!!

reviews.author: Rigotto
reviews.title: Need some SERIOUS renovation!
reviews.text:
Looks like this was a great hotel in the past.  It is falling in pieces. Everywhere you walk inside the hotel, there are white towels covering the floor due to infiltration. 
The rooms maybe are clean but you cannot guarantee as everything is a shipwreck, old and not working. 
The food is poorly prepared. 

The attention is the teams is good although at reception it looks like they treat you badly to create a disappointment and then you finally see some good service from the others. 

I guess there might be several other places in Cancun to stay that would provide a better experience. 

Have to admit again that the crew at hotel restaurants and bar are well trained and carefully. It is just the place that needs some SERIOUS renovation.

reviews.author: StephTheGray
reviews.title: Royal Service and the pool conscierge, Degnar are the BEST!
reviews.text:
Here for my husband's annual sales meeting, staying 6 nights.

Arrival was a rough start.  Our flight arrived early, so we were on site trying to check in at 11:30am.  What else are you gonna do?  Fully-clothed, luggage, been up since 3:50am... but alas, our room was not ready yet.  We waited.  And waited.  And waited.  Colleagues were being placed in their rooms... not us.  Finally at 4:30pm, my husband blew a gasket and was speaking with Roberto, one of the front managers, and he took care of things right away.  We upgraded to Royal Service for $100 extra per night, ocean view, room 5608 and it was the best thing we could've done.

Once on site we found the Royal Service to be quiet, no kids, and nearly unpopulated.  Every day you have to reserve a Bali Bed if you want one (awesome, canopied beds around the pool and beach.  Degnar ALWAYS was kind, courteous and professional.  He always tried to accommodate whatever needs I had.  I hope the hotel will consider giving that man a raise.  He arrives every day at 5:00am and works hard to create a clean, inviting space for guests, including me.  Thanks, Degnar!

*The gym is excellent, I used the elliptical machine, treadmill and free weights.
*Room service is excellent.
*La Palapa (Royal Service exclusive restaurant) is excellent.
*Beach service food and drinks are excellent.  Be SURE TO TRY THE SPRING ROLLS.  
*Surf is beautiful aqua blue and is very, very rough with RED FLAGS always up.  There are only a couple of yellow flags further downs the beach in sections wheret it's a little safer to swim.
*Lots of easily accessible bathrooms.
*Waitstaff speak pretty good English and they helped me with my fledgling Spanish.
*Nespresso machine in my room... YES!
*Nicely stocked room refrigerator (chips, M&Ms, beer, water, juice, etc).
*Weather in January is incredibly wonderful, not nearly as hot as Punta Cana this same time of year.
*You get your own personal assistant while you're here (Royal Service only).  We didn't use him much, but others seem to use theirs a lot.
*Clean, clean, clean!!! (at least in our RS area)
*Plenty of well-located beach chairs.
*Aqua - World is across the street inland and it's fun and free to go watch people in the surf machine.  Or you can pay and try it!
*Tipping is optional.

I'm going to visit the Myan Pyramids tomorrow (Chitzan-Itza)... $89 for a Royal Service guest.  It's an all-day (7-7pm) excursion, I will update when it's over.

So... come here.  But DO get the Royal Service.  You won't regret it.  It's crowded and noisy in the other sections.  Building FIVE is great.

reviews.author: Al K
reviews.title: One of the best
reviews.text:
This is a pic of the interior of pyramid three .
You can enjoy fine dining in the Japanese restaurant located in the middle
This is a large resort with a boutique feel. This is because there is wide selection of restaurants and eating areas. The service is superb. The staff are always smiling and so helpful. Housekeeping was five stars . Overall a wonderful experience

reviews.author: work2travel991
reviews.title: warm getaway
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel both inside and out.  Beach was large and spacious.  Plenty of chairs, large pools and ample bars.  Food was not the best that I have experienced.  Making reservations was a joke unless you are willing to eat at 10pm.  Not a place with much night life or entertainment which was fine with me.  Good place to stay and enjoy the wonderful weather.

reviews.author: Sheri L
reviews.title: Not Impressed
reviews.text:
We had a nice stay.  The ocean view is beautiful.  Staff was excellent.  However, I would never stay at this property again.  

Food is below average for a property of this type and price.  The food was just not good.  I didn’t realize nacho cheese sauce could be like water until I ate here.  I did not think nacho cheese sauce was something that could be ruined but it was literally LIQUID.  Very disappointed with the food.  

Restaurant reservations are a joke.  I think they want you to book reservations and tell you nothing is available so you eat at the buffet.  

The main areas of the hotel are hot and humid all the time.  It is hot and muggy inside the main area at all times of the day and night.

There was only one elevator working for the side of the building (8 floors) where we were staying on.  We had to always use the stairs and because the main area is always so hot, we could not even go to dinner without sweating.  

Steps?  OMG...you don’t need to work out while on vacation when you are staying in this resort.  There are steps, steps, and more steps to go around on this property.  If you have a family member who cannot walk well or is in a wheelchair, do not stay at this resort.  

To get a beach towel you have to get them from people selling trips and excursions.  If I wanted more than a beach towel, I would go see the concierge.  I just want a towel to go relax by the beach or pool.  

I will no go back, and I would not recommend this resort.

reviews.author: PaddyGMurphy
reviews.title: Cancun could
reviews.text: The Paradisus Resort was a very good holiday venue. Bit worn and weary with a couple of restaurants being rebuilt nonetheless despite the many stairs up and down the place was good and the beach lovely. Above all else got to say the staff were most efficient and friendly.

reviews.author: Deshayc
reviews.title: Worst stay of my Life
reviews.text:
This was the WORST hotel I have ever stayed in! Do no I REPEAT DO NOT STAY HERE. For an all inclusive hotel at $440 per night + tax It was terrible. Where do I begin: 

Check in: they could not find our reservation and you CAN NOT book at the front desk so I had to go Via Expedia (God Bless them) and book another room. It took us 3 hours to check in. The entire process was SLOW!

Food: I tried all the restaurants including room service and NONE of it was good. I mean barly etable! The eggs where pink and the pasta tasted it came out of a can. The pizza was bad I mean how do you mess up pizza. The cookies where even bad. I could go on but o don’t have enough time. 

Checkout: trying to leave the hotel in a timely fashion we waiting in line for 40 min to check out and you have to stand in the line because you need a check out card in order to leave the hotel. They literally would not let us leave because I needed to swipe my card they already had on file for the equivalent of $20USD. 

Positives: The staff - they are SUPER friendly and helpful and the service other than check in and check out is pretty swift. 

Unfortunately, I would never stay here again which is a shame because I am due back to Cancun 3 more times in the next year.

reviews.author: jenniferb_carson
reviews.title: Whoo whoo was awesome
reviews.text: Great trip & Service Wonderful experience staff awesome would come back, Red Lounge was fun enjoyed that ear phone thing never done that before great drinks with premium alcohol used; plenty of room at pool & beach

reviews.author: cazadorRolo
reviews.title: Excellent view, 360 degrees of the best in Cancun
reviews.text:
The hotel is located in the best corner of Cancun. To enjoy it you have to have enough time for your excellent services.
What we liked most was the center of convections and the views from each habilitation with exclusive terraces with total privacy.
At breakfast time you see a sea with 7 colors, which only invites you to visit it and rest on the beach.

reviews.author: Ramon Valencia Jr
reviews.title: Business trip with company exec's and others
reviews.text: Nice stay, included everything,  fitness center, all inclusive restaurants,  Japanese to Mexican and buffets. All you can drink also, nice Red Lounge on lobby floor, nice little club. Convenient meeting facilities,  good restaurants,  great 5 star service at all aspects. Saturday night buffet and pool show. Great room service, full of Pokemon Stops. Kid and adult friendly , although no special catering to them or section. Very friendly staff, except for 1 obnoxious waiter by the poolside buffet. 99.9% of staff were great. Great pools, nice beach, showers accessible, rooms awesome and spacious.

reviews.author: StreathamVoyager
reviews.title: Sub-par business trip
reviews.text:
Stayed here for 10 days for a conference in June 2018. It all went wrong as we tried to check in, as staff were giving contradictory advice about where to check in. You’d think it would be at the main “check-in” desks by the big front door. But oh no - we had to go down stairs, along a corridor, round a corner and then down an escalator to find another check-in desk for conferences. I was checked in efficiently and given a room number but no guidance on how to find it, so spent 15 mins walking round the hotel, dragging my suitcase, looking for the room. Suddenly no staff could be found for directions... Anyway, my room was tucked away in a basement level and if I leaned out far enough from its terrace, I could just about glimpse the parking lot. The room was large and perfectly clean, with a separate seating area down a small step. It’s what they called a “Junior Suite”. The light switches were a constant source of entertainment for the full ten days I stayed ... I still didn’t really work out which switch did what. They were like one of those logic puzzles where you have to align them all, in the right order, to get a light to switch on. In the bathroom, the towel rail and shower curtain rail were barely clinging to the wall thanks to a few loose screws. 

The hotel communal areas had a constant strange smell of rancid swamp. Some guessed it was the insecticide they use to keep the mosquitos down. If that was the intention, it was only partly successful. But at least being in the basement was good for my health - it meant using lots of stairs to get anywhere else in the hotel. As others have mentioned, the doors and windows (and on a few occasions, ceilings) leaked profusely whenever it rained, and apparently, it rains a lot in Cancun in June. Most of the bars and restaurants had their windows lined with towels most of the time. One lunchtime, a large part of a ceiling collapsed into the lunch buffet and water sprayed liberally over food and guests. 

A positive word for the staff, who were very helpful and friendly,and mostly spoke good English. Samuel at Coco’s bar by the beach was very helpful. 

This was my first experience of staying in an all-inclusive resort hotel, so I’m not sure what I was expecting from the restaurants. Having to book a table the day before you wanted to eat was strange (unless you want dinner at 6.30 or 10pm, that is). I’ll review some of the restaurants separately. 

Summary: I was travelling on business.  I wouldn’t spend my own money on coming back here.

reviews.author: Coni812
reviews.title: Gorgeous View! Mediocure Food
reviews.text:
Was here in April for a work conference.  The resort location was beautiful!  Pool and beach well maintained,   Lots of chairs and palapa's.  Our room was on the first floor overlooking the pool and ocean. The room itself was disappointing.  We were missing a bathroom door.. which is a little awkward when rooming with someone you work with and don't know well. But the view was so wonderful we decided not to request another room.  Our lighted mirror and coffee maker didn't work though the front desk was quick to have someone come and fix them.   

We were with a large conference and on the all inclusive.   Food was very disappointing.  I survived the week on dinner rolls and chips and guacamole (the guac was fantastic though) and some fruit.  Most of the meals were barely warm. (that scares me)  The night we had Mexican was good.  Other nights there was Thai and Italian etc.  The pool food was much better - pizza, chicken wings, chicken sandwiches.  Also many in our group raved about the Sushi restaurant.  (I don't care for Sushi so didn't go).  There were also a few other restaurants that I didn't try because of time restrictions and wanting to spend time at the pool or beach.  Feedback from coworkers were mixed, some good some bad.   The drinks are weak, I'm not much of a drinker so that really wasn't an issue for me.  The meeting venues were really nice and the resort itself seemed clean though needing some maintenance (like our bathroom door, some paint touch up etc)  All the employees were very friendly and helpful. 

We have stayed at another resort twice that was much nicer but didn't have a view.   It wasn't an all inclusive and food and drinks were much better.   I didn't pay for this stay so I've given it an average score but probably wouldn't stay here if I were paying for a vacation.  I like to eat.   But the view and ocean was unbelievably beautiful!!!

reviews.author: Barski42
reviews.title: Comfortable spot in the Hotel Zone
reviews.text: Spent three nights here last week. Nice beach, good restaurants, Agave great tacos.Large, comfortable guest room, fridge and flat screen tv. Spaceous bathroom complete with a bidet. View of lagoon from deck was nice.Staff were all friendly and helpful, premium liquor available as part of all-inclusive.

reviews.author: DJ S
reviews.title: Extended business trip
reviews.text:
A group of us extended a business trip to add 
some personal time , the conference areas and areas we had group dinner and get together where great we had over 600 people for our event. We stayed a couple days later for some free time. We had great experiences everywhere we had great food great drinks and the service was amazing.  Edwardo and Edwin at the buffet took great care of us with a personalized meal, Hugo by the pool was there everyday and we made sure to sit where he was working . I would definitely recommend this resort for a business group as everything was great on the attendee side , for regular guests I would love to come back. Many restaurants right on property, areas for all types of family’s or just adults.

reviews.author: angiejennifer
reviews.title: My first time in Mexico :)
reviews.text: A few days ago I visited for the first time Cancun, Mexico. I stayed at Paradisus Cancun, the gorgeous and Magical Paradisus Cancun!! I will never forget that experience. The Hotel is amazing, the staff is awesome, so nice and so attentive!! the center of the hotel simply magical. I felt in love with Paradisus Cancun, the layout, the Beach, the staff, everything. I ate too much, best tacos ever!!!! can´t wait to come back with my mom and daugther... :)

reviews.author: Gloria M
reviews.title: Yoli Annual Incentive Trip
reviews.text: This was our Second trip to the Paradisus Resort and the experience was very memorable, From the time that the shuttle picked us up at the airport to take us to the Resort until the time we left we were treated with the utmost respect and attention to detail by a super friendly and very knowledgeable staff. We were definitely impressed with the quality of the food and the quality of the entertainment. In addition we were treated to a very special Dinner cooked by Chef Eduardo Mukol,he was amazing with the presentation of our dinner and it was better than most 5 star restaurants that we have visited. The beach at the resort was beautiful and very clean and the waitstaff were extremely courteous and professional. We were so impressed that we also joined Club Melia so we can return more often.

reviews.author: Diana W
reviews.title: Royal Service Wonderful!
reviews.text: I was at Paradisus for business and was fortunate enough to stay in the Royal Service area.  The rooms are very spacious and views to either the ocean or the bay.  I had a butler - Rode as well.  He went above and beyond, always there for every request and was outstanding!  Thank you Rode!! Dinners in each of the restuarnts were very good.  We had a dinner on the last night out on the golf course that was outstanding.

reviews.author: 335tracyt
reviews.title: Horrible place to stay!
reviews.text: So many reasons why to pick a different place to stay!  Poor food quality, poor service... our room flooded from a blocked drain on the deck... poor clean up and did not offer anything for our inconvenience  Gourmet coffee bar not open until noon!  What!?  Wanted to exchange $100 for $20's.. We were told "no".  The language barrier was so bad that even when they could speak English you good not understand what they were saying.  Will NEVER go back and NEVER recommend!

reviews.author: TravelerForLifeNow
reviews.title: The food is HORRIBLE
reviews.text: Stayed at this all inclusive resort for a business conference.  The property is run down and dated.  The food is absolutely horrible, especially the buffet restaurants.  The remaining restaurants all require reservations.  I would NEVER stay here again

reviews.author: MissXTraveller
reviews.title: Great resort with all the expected perks, though inconsistent housekeeping
reviews.text:
I recently stayed here for 6 nights for a work conference. I stayed at the Jr Suite Lagoon View and had the "all inclusive" package. It was pretty special being able to go to most of the restaurants and bars on-site and have unlimited food and drinks. You did feel very VIP. 

The resort itself is lovely, large with many downtime options, including pools, bars, spas, the beach just at your doorstep, etc. Also, the staff were all varying degrees friendly and accommodating to very much so. 

The only main gripe was the housekeeping. I always find it quite disappointing when 5-star venues do not uphold consistent and standard housekeeping. Always makes me suspicious about what other standards may not be upkept. For instance, my bed was always made up differently, sometimes my toiletries were refreshed, sometimes not. Sometimes I got clean towels, sometimes not. Sometimes my toiletries items were nicely organized, sometimes they were left scattered. Sometimes the floors were cleaned, sometimes not. (You can tell by sand). 

Also, on my first evening, while I was in my room for a quick outfit change, I was almost instantly disrupted by very loud, ongoing knocking on the door - I had to YELL "one minute!!!" on the top of my lungs... And all it was, was a staff member asking if I wanted more bottles of water. He didn't even give me 30 seconds to respond before he kept incessantly knocking. I had to put the DND sign on my door every time I was in my room.

Also, the restaurants on-site to vary in quality, and aside from Bana (which I found to be very western, unauthentic Japanese, with sashimi not being fresh, and certain dishes very oily), all the restaurants were fine to very good. 

All in all, very good resort, adjoining the beautiful beaches with plenty to do on-site.

reviews.author: Stephen C
reviews.title: Awesome Vacation - set a new bar in Awesomeness
reviews.text: Stayed here for 5 incredible nights for my company’s annual sales conference and it was spectacular!  the food was phenomenal in all the restaurants, the service was top-notch, the views and the accommodations were absolutely awesome.  Will be heading back there for my own personal vacations very soon highly recommend place

reviews.author: Carlos Rodrigo O
reviews.title: Perfect Resort
reviews.text:
Very nivel resort. Five stars.
Food, room, staff are perfect.
Swimming pools are more than perfect.

Shows in the night is very nice
This is a very nice place for families.

I didn't like some rules.
The bars close to swimming pools , they close at 05:00 pm.
They should leave one of them open until later.
We left the swimming pool and tried to go to the restaurant. You have to take a shower and change the clothes.

This is a very nice place, of course I recommend it for everyone.

reviews.author: SamerDaher
reviews.title: All inclusive means all inclusive - almost
reviews.text:
Annual conference. Where else? Cancun.

Where in Cancun? The Paradisus...

I have mixed feelings about the place which is no fault of their own. The food is abundant but dietary restrictions are one thing they’re not sensitive to. I don’t eat pork or non-halal meat so it was quite a feat to convince the staff on the pasta station to use a clean skillet and clean utensils that aren’t tainted by ham. Not their fault I have dietary restrictions but they’re insensitive to it as well and will look at you like a Martian.

The beach is awesome. Fine smooth sand. Even on a cloudy and windy day, the sea is refreshing.

The restaurants aren’t that great. The fish has a funky taste as if it’s been in the open for longer than it should be. The sushi place is NOT recommended. It qualifies as the worst sushi I’ve ever had. Sincerely.

The Spanish tapas are good and yummy for a change but we ended up in Naos, the main buffet most of the time.

The staff are helpful, the views are amazing (see attached pics).
