My trip was disrupted by a visitor. The culprit was a cockroach lying dead on its in the bathtub. Apart from that, the rooms are clean.

Would I go there again? Yes. Overall it was a positive experience.

reviews.author: 357grgrgr
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: Friendly staff various restaurants and a great beach. The golf is tiny and seems a bit dangerous but ok for a pitch and put. Breakfast is great and the restaurants and bars are excellent. A special mention for the market grill.

reviews.author: kfheimer
reviews.title: Paradisus is Paradise for Smaller Meetings
reviews.text:
We hosted a smaller sales kick-off event at the Paradisus for a week and everything went perfectly. Claudia from the sales department was responsive and helpful in her response to our RFP. Apolo in the meeting groups department was beyond excellent, and was there every step of the way - from check in to check out and everything in between. 

The hotel is beautiful, right on the beach with loads of restaurants, food choices and is always immaculately clean. Our group was able to find small meeting spaces when we needed it, and the bars and clubs provided options for night time activities.

The conference center was larger than we expected, and although our rooms had no windows the set up was perfect and kept us focused.

Overall a great event, and we hope to go back!

reviews.author: 240garyo
reviews.title: woudl have like to spend everday in the ocean, but there was a rip tide
reviews.text: Hotel was all inclusive and very nice. But I would like staying not all inclusive to go and explore more of the area. Swimming in the ocean was not possible due to the rip tide. I had hope there would be snorkling there or near by, but it was not clear enough.

reviews.author: Jennifer K
reviews.title: Very nice place
reviews.text: We stayed with a big group and had a ton of fun.  The service no matter where you ate or even on the beach was great.  Our first experience with an all inclusive resort.  They are very organized and the resort was well maintained and clean. Market grill was our favorite restaurant.  Raphael and Manuel were so funny and we had a good time.

reviews.author: Andy Z
reviews.title: Sales Reward Trip/Meeting
reviews.text: We had a great time for the 4 nights we were here.   The staff were all great, friendly and attentive.  In particular Sofonia and Hector were great keeping us fed and watered.  Lots of places to hang out and eat.   We ended up using the Enos restaurant for morning meetings and it worked well by just using multiple laptops.

reviews.author: dlw240
reviews.title: Loved it!!
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful! We have never stayed at an all inclusive place before and didn’t know what to expect. My hubby and I went as part of a work conference so we got to see how they do two large dinner events in addition to the normal day to day activities. Staff and service were amazing. The food was delicious...everything from the conference buffet dinners to the buffet to the many restaurants. We didn’t have time to try them all! Everything was clean and comfortable. The pools are huge and gorgeous. Lots of beachfront with cabanas and lounge chairs. There is a lifeguard and the staff walked the beach keeping it clean. There was a lot of live entertainment, which was all excellent (and we are disappointed we missed the jet ski in the pool with some acrobats doing a routine!). We are thinking about going back with our kids and grandkids. We did see they had a kids indoor play area but didn’t go inside. It is showing its age in some places (some ripped/broken beach chairs and cabana cushions, for example). Although we were supposed to get our in room mini bar restocked each day, that wasn’t done, nor did they give us more coffee or water for the room after we used what we had been given. I feel certain had we brought this to management’s attention they would have fixed it, but it wasn’t important enough to us to bother with. Don’t expect great TV in English - there was only one channel with English-speaking shows...reruns of CSI, NCIS and Criminal Minds. We we’re too busy enjoying the resort to care, but this is something to keep in mind if TV is important to you. As other reviewers have mentioned, bring cash to tip the terrific service staff. All things considered we had a great time and would definitely go back.

reviews.author: OK_Traveling2014
reviews.title: Poor hotel
reviews.text:
Exceedingly poor hotel for the money.

I booked a lagoon view suite only to have a view of a wall. The light switches are cracked and broken, there is only one working power point, the floor is dirty, the safe in the room was locked when I arrived, etc. 

Additionally, the staff couldn’t seem to care less about issues. When I went to check in, they insisted my company had not paid for the room despite my having a confirmation number. They said they would take an imprint of my credit card but wouldn’t charge it until we could sort it out in the morning. They of course charged it immediately.

Additionally, when I went back with the booking confirmation form showing the credit card imprint from the travel agent, they insisted on seeing the bank statement to confirm the payment had gone through. 

My EA emailed them 4 times without response, and I have been to reception 6 times now without resolution.

reviews.author: Francisco P
reviews.title: Nice looking hotel, great Beach, not an all Inclusive
reviews.text:
Just stayed there last week because of a Congress. The hotel is beautiful with great scenery and landscapes, beach is outstanding! However to be sold as an "All Inclusive" when you have to pay extra to get a bed by the beach or by the pool, then is not really an all Inclusive. We had to pay from $105-$150+ to get a bed by the beach (and of course, you get a bottle of champagne and food delivered), but the mere fact that you have to pay extra to get the better things of the hotel is definitively a bad thing. I have stayed at many other All Inclusive type of hotel, and when you say All Inclusive, is really all. Don't advertise like it if you are not ready to deliver... 

The other bad thing that was although my room was very nice, my mattress had an inclination on the head side. I didn't realize that for a couple of days, and as result, i had gastritis and reflux. When i noticed what created the problem, i tucked in the cushions from the living room under the head side of the mattress and problem solved. Good sleep (actually the mattres could have been better), but the best of it, gastritis and reflux were gone. 

Bad place to stay if you are an smoker. I don't really care that much about that, but certainly having to walk outside of the hotel to smoke or just having one single area for smoking by the beach is not a good thing if you want to relax and enjoy a cigar.

reviews.author: SMETIN
reviews.title: Nice hotel but staff are not so kind!
reviews.text: Hotel call its rooms suite but these are normal standard rooms .service are all inclusive it looks good but if you have guest from outside of hotel they want to charge you 120 usd for entering fee for hotel even your guest want to drink coffee with you !it means it is not convenient for any kind of business stay in this hotel .we were there for conference which makes us uncomfortable ..they have some restaurants for dinner such as japanese food service(it is good) and far east restaurant (taste meals are not good),fusion latin restaurant (i can not advice for my friend) and open buffet ( every day foods are same which is not convenient also. Generally it is good sea side hotel

reviews.author: Atti S
reviews.title: Big hotel in CAncun
reviews.text: This is an ' all inclusive ' hotel but that is a bit misleading because not everything is included. Good beach and pool and average food. Rooms are good especially the ones facing the ocean but the registration, checking in/out is a disaster, be prepared for long waits.

reviews.author: Caldeira Bertoli
reviews.title: Very good if you are on vacation mode and mood
reviews.text:
My stay was pleasant and you cannot complain about the all-inclusive fare. The food is quite reasonable, the drinks are server non-stop and the people nearby the pools are pleased to serve.

The inconveniences I found were on the instructions for the use of the  safety box - do not match with what you have to do to use it - and the not pleasant smell inside the drawers which prevented me from putting my clothes inside.

The pool and the beach are very pleasant to stay and I found it weird that the guest has to pay for the use of the bungalows by the pool.

If you are in a vacation mode and mood you will enjoy it.

reviews.author: naughty2000
reviews.title: All Inclusive in Cancún
reviews.text:
Just returned from Cancun where I attended the Alacero 58 Congress.

The large hotel complex has already seen it’s best days. The style and lay out (pyramid style) is outdated. Especially the lobby and the center of the pyramid are too dark and hot. The room (pyramid 4) was behind expectations. Bathroom boring, the room in white, average furnitures. However, the TV set was modern. 
What was really good is the beach aerea including two large pools. The beach very nice and clean.

It was my first time staying all inclusive but cannot understand the advantage of such concept. The lobby service was more or less missing. Especially during the day many outlets were not open but idle. Sometimes no chance to order an espresso or somehing else. Most staff had problems speaking English and/or were not motivated at all. Nevertheless tip exspectations were always evident.
May be for the many US tourists no problem but for many others.

The all inclusive concept together with many other things were not according to my taste and therefore do not plan to check again into this hotel or other hotels having the same concept. In my opinion all inclusive hotels should be excluded from common star ratings as it easily could be misguiding.

reviews.author: PitaRG
reviews.title: Great for a business conference
reviews.text:
Was there for 1 night as part of a business conference.  Since I arrived I was checked in at a special concierge then taken to my room.  Jr. Suite was clean and with enough space.
Service was good and friendly staff.  Had good lunch at the Palapa and breakfast at Naos, which is ok. 
Dinner at Tempo (not included in all-inclusive plan) was a great surprise!!
Even though I was there for a business conference, I saw a lot of families and couples.  The hotel is quite big so there is plenty of space for everyone.
Hotel and rooms in general are quite old but are decently maintained.  Not a luxury hotel but worth the price and type of business conference.
Would recommend and would return for a business conference.

reviews.author: armando v
reviews.title: Huge complex with lots of choices
reviews.text:
Stayed there at large convention.
The place is huge, many pools, restaurants, bars, very Long Beach, night clubs, activities.
Service was quite good for a place this big.
Food was good, not excellent; but with so many choices one has lots of possibilities; although since it is all inclusive, all the best places fill up very fast and one might end up in a large line to eat.
Rooms are quite big

reviews.author: Michael L
reviews.title: Average resort to enjoy the climate and beach of Quintana Roo
reviews.text:
This past weekend I had the chance to stay at this resort for work from Monday through Friday. The resort was fairly empty, I would guess around 50% occupancy. Upon arriving the people at that front desk were very nice and helpful, with the customary cooling towel. I was checked in and given my wristband, a sort of colored nylon fabric with a wooden token intertwined with the fabric. 

I was taken to my room with the help of the bellboy. The room was very clean and nice with a King sized bed. The air-conditioner worked very well, which was really helpful as there isn't a ceiling fan, which made me sad. The mini fridge is stocked with water, snacks, and a variety of malt beverages. There are no liquor spirits in the room at all. I am not a fan of this at all, though I didn't consider calling anyone to see if that could be changed. The bathroom is a good size, and is elevated about 4 inches off the room floor, which my big toe repeated found throughout the trip. The shower has great pressure and heat, but is also again elevated a bit off the bathroom floor. If you have arthritis, or bad hips, etc, etc, I would consider finding a different resort as you will have difficulties getting in and out of the tub. 

The property as a whole is a smoke free environment, save for a few designated areas, though I did see quite a few people smoking in various outdoor areas without consequence. The buildings are very pretty inside, but the common areas are either not air conditioned at all, or are so poorly done that they feel as though they aren't. The restaurants were all comfortable except for The Market Grille, which is outside so this makes sense. The restaurants are all next to each other, and in a few instances we were seated in closed restaurants to eat in in a restaurant that was open at the time. This is how close they are to each other, which made for some confusion. I never had the opportunity to make a reservation and eat at a nicer restaurant because I forgot pants and didn't want to break the dress codes. It didn't alter my experience at all I believe. The room service is actually some of the best I have ever had at an all-inclusive resort. It was also delivered about 20 minutes after it was ordered, which is far and away the fastest I have ever had. The gym was nice, A/C'd and a great place to get some exercise in with cable machines, free weights, treadmills, and ellipticals. I was very happy with this amenity.

The Pools are all nice and clean, there aren't any floaties and I didn't see too many people who had brought there own actually. The music was never too loud and a good vibe. The beach is kept very clean and is pretty expansive and deep for Cancun. I did not at all appreciate the bars near the pools closing before the pools close. Not a fan at all.

Overall this was a pretty nice place. If you are in decent enough shape to get in and out of the tub, and love the hot weather, this may be a good option for you.

reviews.author: Suzanne M
reviews.title: Last minute relocation
reviews.text: Thank you to Apolo Calderon Sanchez for helping us make a smooth relocation from Puerto Rico when Hurricane Maria hit. The group had a great time and Apolo was very helpful in arranging the last minute meeting space and reservations for the group.

reviews.author: charles R
reviews.title: If you love food one place to consider
reviews.text:
I have to say that the Cheff Manuel Martinez and Javier are Excellent. They know their kitchen back and forward.

The place is 31 years old but still looks great. The staff overall is friendly but in Hard Rock Cancun you get a more warm welcome. 

You know for me the food is a most because I don't drink alcohol or party. This is why when I find excellent food I don't hesitate to recommend and give you my feedback.

I hope this help.

Best regards,

reviews.author: Angel H
reviews.title: Great Hotel, Service and All Inclusive Meals
reviews.text:
Just spent one night in this place and I was very comfortable, slept very well and ate delicious.
This is a very well maintained resort with great service and attitude from people working on it.
Many options to eat and for snacks.
Rooms nice in all aspects.

reviews.author: DanielZl
reviews.title: Good hotel, all inclusive
reviews.text:
The hotel was very good, good service, lot's of varieties of restaurants and food, all inclusive. Ac couple of pools with amazing view, private beach, the rooms were very good as well.
The hotel is a bit old but you don't feel it since the decoration and everything is great.

reviews.author: RebeccaF
reviews.title: A Wow!   Service, interior, food, restaurants, timeous
reviews.text:
Service, interior, food, restaurants, timeous. The location and access to the beach is too good to be true. Shuttles and busses to the markets and shops as well as accurate and quick trip bookings by the hotel staff. 
Room changed due to inconvenient details and most of all lovely food and facilities.

Its on my wish list and I have wanted to go back ever since, I went for work and then again for a holiday and both ties just relaxing and exceptional.

reviews.author: Traveller & Foodie
reviews.title: Nice All Inclusive Resort however not perfect
reviews.text: I came here on business 3 nights.    Check-in was smooth.    The first room they gave us was on the third floor.   After a sleepless night because our room was right over the disco (3353) we called the reception the next day and changed our room to the 8th floor (3806).   Stay away from rooms on 3rd floor over the disco (Building 3), the noise of the music was very loud into the early morning.  However our room 3353 had a better view than the one on the 8th floor.    Once we changed room we had no issues sleeping.   The room is a bit outdated, and so is the bathroom however the service for room was very good and the room was clean.   The lobby area was a jungle so there was a lot of humidity because of the plants/trees.   Honestly I would get rid of the jungle and make this area more modern as it was a very hot lobby while having dinner in the Japanese/Sushi restaurant.     To me the jungle was a bit outdated and with the beautiful area on the first floor near the Concierge and Check-in area I see a lot of potential for this hotel to be a bit more fancy in that section, the trees and jungle have to go for a more luxury feel to a very nice hotel.    The are 3 pools, one with a bar in the pool area, another bigger pool with lots of chairs always available and the Royal Service pool which was for Royal customers only and more intimate.     The ocean view from the pool was breathtaking.    Beach chairs were a bit hard to find if you didn't come early, like before 8:30 am if you wanted an umbrella.   Restaurants, Naos: international buffet for breakfast, lunch and dinner:  breakfast amazing, lunch sometimes not consistent, first hamburger was delicious and the second time it was under cooked and so was their chicken. I must mention that the buffet had really good service, the waiters were very attentive and caring.   Market Grill was a Argentina/Brazil style restaurant which was actually very nice.    The house wine served from the all inclusive plan was very ordinary however they have a great wine list which we ordered from and enjoyed the wine with their grilled meats.    The Asian restaurant, not the lobby one near the jungle the one you have to walk over to through the rooms on the first floor was just ok to me.    The service was just ok too, and the food tapas was ok to me.    I would of liked to have tried Mole, Vento and Tempo however we did not have time because the dinners were sometimes in the area the company had chosen for us to eat as a group.    The last night we had a buffet dinner outside near the Royal Service pool area and honestly the buffet food was cold and not amazing like the food at the Naos buffet.   We were all very disappointed.   Overall a nice 3 night stay for an all inclusive.  This hotel has a lot of potential if they can change a few things.   I must add that they had live music near the beds on the beach was very nice.  The band was pleasant and the music was very good.     Again overall a 4 star hotel with a potential to me for a 5 with a few fine tuning in certain areas.  The disco and the bar lounge was amazing.  Every night during our stay they had different shows at the avenue bar, some were quite interesting.  The Red lounge disco was also very fun, the music was great.

reviews.author: GratitudeBryn
reviews.title: One of the best resorts/all inclusives we've ever stayed at!
reviews.text:
What a phenomenal experience from start to finish.  We were treated like VIPs and every thing we asked for was provided.  My wife has food allergies and eating abroad is always a challenge, but not at Melia.  We turn in her allergy list and every dining experience comes with custom dishes prepared just for her, and they are all delicious!  

The hotel is filled with "Wow!" and "Look at that!" moments from the design to the lighting to every little detail.  My wife LOVES it when I tell her we are staying at a Melia resort.  She almost doesn't want to go anyplace else.

reviews.author: Deric T
reviews.title: Worst customer service ever
reviews.text: We just checked in yesterday, somehow our reservation got mixed up at the hotel and they booked us for 1 person instead of 2. the price difference was $50 online and we were ok with paying it but at the counter they demanded $386 instead. We spent 2 hours at the front desk to get it resolved when they would not help us, we finally had to call the US and rebook it through a 3rd party and get the proper rate. Truly a nightmare experience, worst customer service ever.

reviews.author: TheRosses2014
reviews.title: Poor Service, Quaility and Follow thru
reviews.text:
I've been reluctant to post a bad review, thinking someone from the hotel would be willing to make the issues I had while working with them right.  Apparently that is no the case.  I host retreats around the world for women entrepreneurs, and am always looking for great service and willing to pay extra for it.  I contracted with the Paradisus not once, but twice to bring my group there.  The first time I visited with my group there was some mix up with the contract and the hotel ended up charging me an extra $5,000 Dollars, so to make it right the next time I brought a group the credited me $2,500.  I reluctantly said yes, as the service I received was not great.  This last trip was the worst.  

As the host of the group you would expect the hotel to be interested in taking care of you, they did the opposite.  I paid for a larger room, with Family Concierge and needed to be near my group.  I was put in a smaller room with my toddler (which DID NOT work) and when I requested them to make it right was given an OLD room with a roach problem in 4 pyramids over (it was a hike to say the least).  See the photo.  Per our contract the hotel still

reviews.author: Sunil S
reviews.title: All in ⛱ Resort
reviews.text:
Excellent suites , food , location, service.
Beach access from the resort and place to rest are great.

Downtown is just 20 mins away.

Access to ferry for traveling to isla mujeres is just 30 mins away. This island offers great options to enjoy with family. 

Do not forget to checkout amazing ocean view from this island.

reviews.author: Patrick F
reviews.title: Fantastic , friendly service
reviews.text:
We recently stayed at the Paradisus Cancun and had a wonderful stay. The hotel, located on a beautiful, white sandy beach, offers something for everyone. There are multiple, great restaurants to choose from and there is nightly entertainment.
The staff at the Paradisus Cancun is top notch, especially Eddie C. and Valerie at the LaPalapa restaurant. They were so friendly and attentive and made us feel welcome.

reviews.author: shailabs
reviews.title: I'd go back again and again!
reviews.text:
We spent 5 days and 4 nights at this incredible hotel. The view of the sea is breathtaking! But also the service was amazing: housekeeping spoiled us each day, all the restaurants have great food and the waiters are super attentive. The shows and activities were very fun. 
During our stay, we were able to meet Abraham Franco, who does a great job of room manager.
I can't wait to go back!

reviews.author: Ahtziri M
reviews.title: A fluid and sumptuos experience
reviews.text:
On this ocassion we visited the hotel for business matters. Although it seemed a rare choice for a business trip it turned to be ideal. During the morning we had to go out into town for work, and be back in the afternoon to report and analise. The efficient and exact labour force engine that make the place work smoothly is a great comfort and asset. 
Therefore we had very flui transitions between fieldwork and reflection time, knowing our needs would be solved immediatly, plus we could continue the work discussion in a very rich and unique enviroment that enhance our reflection time. Without a doubt this was a delicious working experience in a very relaxed atmosphere!

reviews.author: Shawnydrum
reviews.title: Beautiful Backdrop -- Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: This was a very nice resort -- also very large. There certainly are positives and negatives to that. Check in was fairly efficient, but different than anything I have experienced. (Beware the time share sell). We didn't have a King bed in our room (for my wife and I) and had to move rooms. The new room was in the oldest part of the hotel and needed a makeover. The hot tub water pressure and heat was pretty sub-par. The food options were great, but service was slow. Again, a big resort. All the common areas were beautiful and their beach was pristine. Although I have noted a few issues we had, we did like it there.

reviews.author: crokriguez
reviews.title: Pleasantly satisfied!
reviews.text: I stayed at this resort for a conference and I was pleasantly satisfied with my whole experience! It was fantastic! I would easily stay here again! The staff, property, amenities, food, and spa were delightful! I've stayed at many all inclusive properties and this one was great!

reviews.author: Teresa V
reviews.title: Carlos Valencia
reviews.text:
Carlos was wonderful to are entire group my husband had his Birthday and the two Carlos brought him a cake it was wonderful 
He always was happy and attentive , we have had a wonderful trip the hotel is very clean and has a lot of restaurants to choose from

reviews.author: Carmen C
reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text: The food, the service and the room are amazing.   We took clients there and from the moment we arrived the service and the room were amazing.  The room with access to the pool are the best ones.  Make reservation for the Sushi hotel.

reviews.author: Allie T
reviews.title: Great waitstaff, item was stolen out of our bag while hotel was in possession of them.
reviews.text: The hotel was clean and the wait staff in the restaurants were amazing. The individuals at the from desk were very rude and not helpful. Our flight got cancelled and we had to spend an extra night, the hotel was not at all helpful in helping up book another room. They made us go online to book it and then check in again. While we were doing this, our bags were with the bellmen because we were expecting a shuttle. When we the bags were brought up to our room we were missing our Nintendo DS, it had been replaced with a little girls hair clip. The front desk was not helpful in this matter and when I contact the hotel once we got home I was told there was nothing they could do. I was shocked that something like this would happen at a resort of this size. I would not go back.

reviews.author: Magnús O
reviews.title: Reservation hell in paradise
reviews.text: I was at this resort for a conference and as a conference center this was a good location.  I had one day off at the end of the conference and was looking forward to experiencing something else than the buffet.  There are several restaurants where a reservation is needed.  For some strange reason though those restaurants are half empty all the time and they are not willing to let anyone in without a reservation.  A total turnoff since the restaurants are booked out two days in advance.  Another disappointment was that I reserved a beach hut.  The morning was cloudy so I decided to clean up some work before noon and when I showed up at 1 pm by reserved hut had been assigned to someone else.  Apparently the fine print says that one has to arrive before 11.  There like with the restaurants the occupancy was about 30% on average.  So all in all keep your expectations low, unless your are extremely organised and strategic "booker" this resort is not for your.

reviews.author: Tara D
reviews.title: Butler service is the way to go
reviews.text: We opted for the butler service, which is in building 5, adults only.  I was phenomenal!  Our butler was Antonio and he was awesome.  Anything we needed he made it happen.  Dinner reservations, reserving pool cabanas, food, drinks, towels, you name it he got it.  Freddy was our personal trainer at the gym.  His workouts were great and we did one on the beach!  I highly recommend Freddy and Antonio when you visit.

reviews.author: BaseballDad17
reviews.title: Fantastic Getaway!
reviews.text: My wife and I spent 5 nights here for a business retreat last week. The room was beautiful and the service was excellent.      The food was good to excellent. Our friends payed for the Royal Service and we wished we had as well. The hotel is gorgeous and well kept.  I would definitely recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Lillianne G
reviews.title: Ups and Downs during our stay
reviews.text:
We arrived late at night and although I had requested late check in, were told that our room had been "given away" and we ended up in the lobby overlooking plants and listening to the employee's conversations while trying to sleep. The room's tub was so high from the floor that I had issues getting into it. 

We upgraded our room and were offered the Royal Service Wing. It took half the morning to do so and we ended up canceling our plans for the day and booked mani/pedi's instead. The ladies at the spa were very nice but by the second day of our stay my gel manicure peeled off. 

At the Royal wing, our butler Rossana was amazing and the details throughout our stay impeccable. However, we had a bad experience with one of the Royal Service employees who processed a currency change from dollars to pesos. We brought $140 and he told us that for $148 we would get 2400 pesos, so we owed him an extra $8. he told us not to worry about the $8 and gave us the 2400. Two mornings later we brought him $10 because we had no change. He took it. 

When at checkout we disputed the peeled manicure charges they pulled out an itemized charge sheet and we noticed that we were supposed to get 2600 pesos for $140 without the extra $10 we had given him to complete the $148 he said would complete 2400 pesos. To add to the lie, he had given us a form to sign that had my husband's name and no other information of the transaction and he said it was for the hotel to know who they did a transaction with. My husband signed it. When we requested to know why he gave us wrong information he pulled the form out and he had added that he had given us 2600 pesos, which was not true. 

So, be very careful when you make your currency changes. This employee ended up with 200 pesos and $10 dollars that belonged to us. Ask to see transaction details in writing before signing. The only contact from the hotel was his supervisor saying they would take measurements and apologizing and asking us to stay again, not to offer a refund of the amounts that were taken for us. 

A lots of positives but also lot of negatives.

reviews.author: julia_bickings
reviews.title: POWERdisus
reviews.text: This experience is amazing . The staff and power events team go above and beyond. This was my fourth time visiting this resort and  the atmosphere is just phenomenal. I can not wait to visit next year and see how they blow me away once again !

reviews.author: rcerpa720
reviews.title: Excellent Everything!
reviews.text: Very clean hotel, very good service, great food, great amenities, kind and caring staff, excellent atmosphere, will definitely come back again and highly recommend to anyone looking for a vacation regardless of family or honeymoon (get royal service) Paradisus won't disappoint

reviews.author: derek_lacrosse
reviews.title: 4th year in a row!
reviews.text: This was my 4th stay at Paradisus in consecutive years, and I only have had positive experiences with this hotel. The Hospitality continues to be just as incredible as the previous stay! Always recommend Paradisus Cancun to friends and family!

reviews.author: PHLchamps2
reviews.title: Time of my Life
reviews.text:
Staff was unbelievably accommodating. Customer service was 5-star. Resort speaks for itself. All around superb time!
I would highly recommend this resort to friends, family and colleagues. Thank you Paradisus!

reviews.author: 860rodneyc

reviews.author: 408carld

reviews.text: The experience at this hotel was really awesome. I've been telling family and friends about this place since returning home. The private balcony overlooking the ocean is quite majestic and breath-taking. It was really a luxurious experience that I will remember for a long time. I'm looking forward to returning.

reviews.author: wtravelinggirl
reviews.title: Amazing time in Royal Service!
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus Cancun for 2 nts - Nov 9th and 10th in Royal Service, if you ever want to get pampered, made to feel special, and enjoy fine dining, friendly staff and a nice clean All Inclusive high end experience, this is where you should go!! Don't hesitate for anything, this resort is great for couples, families and their Family Concierge is the best I have seen in 12 yrs of owning my own Travel Agency!  Our Butler Antonio was great and anything we wanted he made it happen, with a smile! I highly recommend asking for him! There is a wonderful restaurant for all Foodies, called Tempo, it is an extra charge, but it is a total dining experience with 11 courses and tastings with Wine Pairing - think of a Special occasion to celebrate there! The Bali Beds by the Adult only pool section of the Royal Service I could get used to! Very comfortable, the pool was a great size and never was crazy with noise or heavy partying - which I truly appreciated! And the restaurant for Royal Service guests La Palapa was exclusive to this area for breakfast and lunch, right on the water, couldn't have asked for better - ask for the Kobe Beef Burger if you are really hungry, it's Huge! But most of all, the Royal Service is well worth it, and the beach is nicely kept up and great waves! Enjoy! We did!

reviews.author: leethomag
reviews.title: Fabulous experience! Loved every minute
reviews.text: We all loved the Paradisus. It was a fabulous venue for fun and our business meetings. The meetings spontaneously and joyously continued in the salt water and around the pool in a very relaxed atmosphere. The night life shows were engaging.

reviews.author: Adrian C
reviews.title: Held corporate event, most staff were exceptional
reviews.text: We held a corporate incentive trip at Paradisus Cancun. Out main event contact Apolo was exceptional, superb attention to detail, made my entire trip as the head organizer extremely at ease. I had previously read many of the negative reviews prior to giving the hotel a chance. I'm glad we did. It appears many visitor came to this hotel expecting a to get a lot for as little as possible. You're not going to get superb service if you book the cheapest available option. This is a superb hotel if you are willing to spend a few bucks for complete relaxation. Our group booked royal service, and the service was exceptional. We took over a dozen room for the week, and not a single complaint from our travelers.

reviews.author: jtiran
reviews.title: Bad choice: Search for a better hotel for your trip....!!!
reviews.text: Overall service is limited. Everybody gives you a warming welcome, but are unable to deliver great service. It would seem employees are not so happy to work here, they appear over exhausted, but they still try to help. Rooms are old, beds not too comfy, TV and cable has many issues like bad image, lost signal, etc... and they are unable to fix it. Security boxes inside the rooms extremely old and don´t work properly. Food is average as also drinks, not good relation between what you pay and what you get. The best part is the beach as with any other hotel in Cancun. And don´t even dream in trying to speak to the manager, he or she will never show up or work to make your stay improve. We left several messages to address our problems, we never received any kind of contact back Even though there is great people working here, management is terrible.

reviews.author: 381Rosie
reviews.title: Food is average at best
reviews.text: We were disappointed by the food at several of the restaurants on site. The room is adequate but nothing special. The hotel staff are friendly and helpful. Probably not the place to choose if you prefer quiet and absence of crowds.

reviews.author: AvalonJoe
reviews.title: Outstanding staff
reviews.text: What can I say about this place. The hotel is very nice. Not 5 star but very nice.  The hotel staff is exceptional. We are staying in the adults only side for "royal service" guests and the service has been unbelievable.  Everyone is incredibly helpful and pleasant. We have a butler names Antonio who is a treat to deal with and has made the stay for my wife enjoyable arranging spa and other activities while I was in meetings.  Look forward to returning here with the entire family.

reviews.author: Carol B
reviews.title: NAOS Restaurant Service
reviews.text: The NAOS restaurant has two very outstanding staff who took very good care of us. They are Ignacio Vazquez and Reynaldo.  Over the week they remembered me and took exceptional care of my needs. The restaurant had a huge variety of food and options. And considering that this buffet style restaurant was often filled with hundreds of people, Ignacio and Reynaldo were amazing.

reviews.author: Doricel
reviews.title: Looking forward to my return
reviews.text: We had an amazing time. The staff are wonderful. The location is great. Clean beach, great food and drink. Clean comfortable room, with an amazing view. So many activities, yet we swam daily in the ocean, and took lots of walks. There is a museum down the road, you can walk under a tree canopy and see a pyramid. It was such a nice way to spend. An afternoon. We are really looking forward to our return.

reviews.author: francophileonthemove
reviews.title: Good conference center, average hotel
reviews.text:
I spent 10 nights at Paradisus for a conference. I need to preface my review by saying that this hotel has an unusual Tripadvisor presence because most of the reviews are from new reviewers with only 1 or 2 reviews and arguably little to compare their experience to. Unusually, they also mention lots of staff by name. Typically, I only consider reviews written by more experienced travelers. However: 

1. Check in was time consuming and laborious but when we eventually got to our Royal Service room we were happy with it. The hotel is older and could really do with refurbishment but it's fairly clean. The bed was great and toiletries plentiful. The coffee machine and free mineral water were great too. 

2. We liked the Royal Service lounge and food plus the private pool and bar. Definitely worth the upgrade and thankfully, kid free. The cabanas are lovely and the waiter service good, especially with lunch snacks. However, the promised butler service is non-existent, housekeeping can be very variable and the staff at the desk in the Royal lounge the most unhelpful I've ever met. The wifi is intermittent. 

3. We used most of the restaurants at the resort but they are VERY variable. For example, Fuego is excellent but Vento is beyond dreadful. My suggestion would be to check out the Tripadvisor reviews. Also, under no circumstances allow the waiters to con you into accepting the 'chefs recommended menu for tonight'. It's easier for the staff if you accept this but it's a disaster and just results in wasted food as how can a chef know what one wants to eat?! Some of the food is absolutely dreadful. The Avenue bar is a shambles. The furniture only fit for garbage as its so damaged and every night they run out of glassware. 

4. The tipping policy at this hotel needs to be made transparent. We were told not to tip and even that the 'problem with Americans tipping is that the staff now expect it'. However, we quickly worked out that unless we tipped we got at worst no service and at best surly and off hand service. It is within the gift of the hotel to sort this out. 

5. The conference facilities are excellent but the catering staff disorganized. 

Overall, I would cautiously recommend this hotel for a conference but it wouldn't be my choice for a vacation where service and food quality is more of a focus for me.

reviews.author: Oleebg
reviews.title: This is just an all-round happy place! And the breakfasts...
reviews.text: I was here for a few days for a work event, though don't get me wrong, this is a great place for a vacation - in fact what it was made for. It is very bright, and has everything - spacious settings, perhaps the most varied breakfast and buffet I have seen, with some great restaurants as well, like Blue Agave. It has is it 3 swimming pools (maybe it's 2 but large) and then that perfect Cancun beach. If you dive, they have a diving and watersports desk, and a fantastic dive center just across the road. Rooms are bright and comfortable (high resort quality). Efficient staff. An espresso place, and much more. Could easily spend weeks here.

reviews.author: Rajeevgopal
reviews.title: Nice all inclusive
reviews.text:
Large well managed and well maintained property. Staff is plentiful, unlike most Caribbean resorts, and ever helpful - unlike most American hotels. The property is huge, so walking can be excessive, particularly if you are in the Royal Section on one end. The royal section has its own breakfast and snacks place which is convenient.

The quality of food is good and the level of service very high. You don't get a feeling or being in a crowded place unlike some all inclusive destination. In summary this all inclusive didn't feel like a 'don't care, too busy to bother' all inclusive.

Cancun itself is amazing - 20 km of resort after resort after resort. All huge. 

The beach is great - large and wide and good waves. The absence of reefs makes the waves nice - unlike in the Caribbean island where the beaches are thin strips and interrupted by rocky reefs.

Pls find time to go to the town for at least one evening - most tourists do not. It gives you a bit of Mexican flavor. The local bus service operates every five minutes and charges Peso 11 or $1. Stops at each resort . So travel time is 45 minutes.

reviews.author: Amy B
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text:
This was my first time in Mexico and I wasn't sure what to expect. I speak NO Spanish. My friend asked me to go on the business trip with her but we had plenty of time on our own also. This resort is beautiful! The staff is amazing and super friendly!!! The food was excellent, the shows at night were really good. The wait staff were so sweet. The beach was very nice, there was a DJ playing music which I enjoyed a lot. They give you fresh beach towels at any point of the day. There are fresh flowers in the front lobby, water falls, coy fish , places to buy things you may need. I loved it so much I talked my husband into going there instead of FL this year. It is a family resort or a place for couples. We had a few small issues with our room but were dealt with. 

We were thrown a huge party on the beach the last night we were there that looked like a wedding. The people worked all day to put that together and it was a beautiful party with terrific food and service! I applaud all of the men and women that work at this resort. I didn't want to leave.

reviews.author: Graeme B
reviews.title: A wow experience!
reviews.text: A truly surreal experience. From the drive up to the hotel at night seeing the domes lit up in purple along with the other lighting, to the view from the room's balcony down over the main pool and beach and out over the ocean is really amazing. Great friendly staff, and a special thanks to Asuncion, Laura, Eric and Salvador at the Pool Bar, and Karina at Coco's Bar. We will never forget you guys! Thank you!

reviews.author: joev854
reviews.title: Fantastic Hotel and Resort
reviews.text: This was my very first time to Cancun, I was attending a company conference (7th-12th May) and I must say I don't think they could have picked a nicer or better hotel. The conference facilities were very good and all the staff at the hotel were very friendly. There were plenty of places to eat and no shortage of drinks. I would like to say a special thank you to Andres in the Nespresso bar for looking after me so well on my last day. I was quite sad to be leave and hope to visit again soon for a holiday.

reviews.author: 60Marg
reviews.title: Older resort but very good service!
reviews.text: I stayed at this hotel one week for a conference. This is an older resort but still with very good facilities and great staff. The food at the restaurant was above average for and all inclusive resort, but if you get tired of the hotel food, there are many restaurants in town that you can choose. The beach is spectacular as well as the surroundings. I would definitively return for a family vacation.

reviews.author: Marcus B
reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: Attended a conference at the hotel and overall it's a good hotel. The conference facilities were excellent and general hotel facilities very good. The hotel has some nice swimming pools and excellent beach. It is a huge hotel and very accommodating to groups, families, couples. My room was a double room overlooking the front of the hotel, it was fine, a little old school, slightly tired but pretty good. The food overall was good, huge buffet options and the taco place at the front of the hotel was great. Overall would I come back and stay here, probably not, but overall it's a good hotel.

reviews.author: joesingh
reviews.title: Great Family Friendly Place, with few recommendations
reviews.text: Great Family Friendly Place, with few recommendations. The environment was great, the staff was excellent, the pools were great, the beach access was excellent. We had our 12 year old girl with us and felt comfortable with the surroundings. Biggest feedback is that the Bed was very uncomfortable, check to see if they are going to replace them soon and the couch had a big rip in it. The menu could be improved a bit for the price! other then that we loved it.

reviews.author: Jeff J
reviews.title: Pardisus Resort - Cancun
reviews.text: The Paradisus is a fabulous hotel. It is conveniently located so the excursions off property don't take all day...but who needs to leave the property. The friendliness of the hotel staff is tremendous. I would highly recommend The Paradisus.

reviews.author: williamchuat
reviews.title: Must Stay in Cancun.
reviews.text:
The location and the Hotel is beautiful. After 14 yrs., it has maintained the charm and cleanliness. 
The Staff super friendly and hard working. Must give recommendation to Andrea Cardinas , a staff who works with passion and made sure we get the service due us.

reviews.author: rono207
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun review
reviews.text: In all areas the resort did a great job for our group.   Entertainment and food were excellent.  Staff very friendly. Convention space for the group was perfect.  Beach is beautiful.  We plan to come back with another buyout in two years.

reviews.author: Abrahamster
reviews.title: Fun and relaxation
reviews.text:
Thank you Paradisus. Be advised that you can walk across the street to Aqua World and use kayaks and paddle boats for free in the lagoon (hotel relationship). Also easy walk to Mayan Museum (wonderful!) and simple bus ride from the hotel to shopping areas.
Activity staff do a great job. A huge spectrum of activities to choose from, or put your feet up and enjoy being still.

reviews.author: 2tradergal
reviews.title: Very good with 2 exceptions
reviews.text: This is a great resort, with 2 exceptions. The service is super fantastic, the location is fantastic, the beach is fantastic, the food is generally very good, the rooms and facilities are very nice, and the price is right. 2 exceptions: the pools all close at 7 PM, and the buffet desserts are very low quality. I feel that a decent resort would have evening swimming possible, since even most cheap motels typically keep the pool open until 10 pm. And the buffet desserts were very low quality and not recognizable as any particular "thing." They were mostly blobs of tasteless gel/pudding-type stuff in all different colors, with a tantalizing sliver of dark chocolate on top. Beautiful, but not enjoyable to eat. Even the so-called cheesecake was made of the same stuff. But overall, this resort is very good.

reviews.author: colletti5
reviews.title: amazing resort
reviews.text:
I just spent a week there and have to say the resort is wonderful and would definitely come back.  I stayed in pyramid 3 and the humidity in the lobby area was awful though.  
The best part of my stay was using the poolside cabana's, they were amazing.  The pool concierge's Victor and Nurbi went above and beyond-great service!!  I felt like a queen.
All of the staff were very helpful with any requests we had.  The restaurants we ate at were wonderful, good service and good food.  We did try to make reservations for dinner for other restaurants and they were already booked, which was disappointing.

reviews.author: sn0rkers
reviews.title: Pyramid fun
reviews.text:
Our family stayed here at the end of April.  I was accompanying my wife who was attending the Abraham Hicks convention there.  I was making the most of enjoying the facilities and having a great time with my young daughter.  She enjoyed the pool, the beach, the evening entertainments and the extra attention from the delightful staff.  We had a room on the lagoon side which was perfect for our needs.  The only fault I had with the room was when the door to the mini bar fell off and landed on my bare foot.  Fortunately no lasting damage caused and the prompt attention of the maintenance staff meant that it was fixed within 10 minutes of reporting it.
The ambiance inside was made extra calming by the decoration for the convention - you couldn't fail to be in a chilled and happy mood!  We met some great people there and overall this was a really special and memorable holiday.   Thank you Paradisus Cancun.

reviews.author: Herbie J
reviews.title: Service Service Service
reviews.text:
I spent a week at the Paradisus Resort. I can't rave Enough about the Quality of the food at Every one of their restaurants. Not to mention the actual location and view of each one. They make it Too easy to eat well.  The coffee stop called "Nespresso" with hosts Anores and Yhoni was a must have daily. All of the wait staff were beyond friendly and attentive.  
The "Entertainment" staff were Just as Friendly. Fernando, Freddy, Rodrigo, Hugo and Chacho (*the DJ staff) worked non stop to bring the best of sound, lights and Talent to Coco's Beach and the Pool activites Daily. Werk. The Nightly Red Lounge entertainment was First class talent, Some of their Singers should have recording contracts they were that good.
The Paradisus Resort itself is Stunning,  The rooms, the views, and the "Piramides" (*all 5 of them.) I was always looking UP to catch the amazing lighting and flora. 'Highly recommended for all Family , Couples, (*sexy singles) and Business events.
I want to go back for sure.  Thank you all for makeing it memorable.

reviews.author: Tirzah W
reviews.title: Gorgeous property and attentive staff
reviews.text: our stay here was absolutely exceptional. the food was great at the buffet and all the restaurants. the landscaping throughout the hotel is gorgeously done. but what I really want to highlight is the service staff. they were so incredibly warm and genuine the entire week we stayed there; no matter what their station, waiters, bussers, hostesses, those washing windows or cleaning bathrooms, everyone had a smile for us and a hello. we particularly enjoyed Andres, Yhoni, Gonzales and Torres at the popular Nespresso cafe! And Pablo, Orlando, Abraham, Moises, and Gerardo on the wait staff!  Incredible attention to detail. Really really pleased!

reviews.author: ShellySantaFe
reviews.title: Terrific all inclusive resort
reviews.text: Many wonderful amenities here at Paradisus Cancun and the best is its beach and pools. Great beachside service, large towels and comfortable lounge chairs. Beds both on the beach and by the pool are available for a fee. I was with a group so we also had music and many activities like salsa lessons, workouts in the pool, and other entertainment. Rooms either face the lagoon or the ocean so both views are beautiful. Beds very comphy. Staff very efficient and friendly. Good selection of restaurants and delicious food.

reviews.author: Sharon P
reviews.title: A little disappointed
reviews.text: Bathroom lighting was so dark it was hard to see.  No one spoke enough english to be helpful.  Staff not very knowledgeable.  Spa was chaotic. Massage was nice but staff not helpful about signing us in and giving us guidance.

reviews.author: shari173
reviews.title: Paradise in Cancun
reviews.text: Everything about this resort was spectacular! The food was abundant and a wide variety of items to choose from. The entertainment was the best!! The crew at the pool had activities every day - shout out to the entertainment crew!! the best ever!!!

reviews.author: Sergio D
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Gourgous place and the rooms very clean and the differents restaurants good taste, however i recommend improve the service of the waitress they look anger all the time, pools are extremely cleans and the different kind of activities are very funny. You really going to enjoy your vacations

reviews.author: criss994
reviews.title: Not my top choice
reviews.text: The resort is ok.  The food is par for the course and there are only a very few workers that are top notch.  We stayed in the Royal Service area which was nice but they burn incense every night and day so your clothes will come back with this smell.  One night was ok but every night was a bit much.  The elevators are extremely slow and the concierge service needs a lot of improvement for the price you pay for this service.  If you go to the spa make sure and bring cash or CC because they WON'T charge to your room.  They forget to tell you this if you book this at the pool and then you have to go back and get cash or cc and will lose out on your massage.  We ended up canceling our massages since it took 30 minutes of our hour massage to get the paper work filled out etc.  Had to get the late charge taken off due to horrible service.  We also were to receive a butler and we only saw him 1 time in 8 days.  A waste of money.  Pool are is great and the service in the Royal area is the best on the resort.  As for Moses of you want the most amazing service EVER.  He will take care of you.  We had a romantic dinner on the beach and he was our server.  The food was amazing.  We didn't go to the other area for the swim up bar so can't review this.  Plan on a long time to check in as well.  They could get better in this area.

reviews.author: Maggie T
reviews.title: Cox winners circle
reviews.text: I came here as a guest for my husband job. All the restaurants were delicious. The service was fantastic. Everyone e was so friendly & attentive. We really enjoyed our stay here. The different excursions that were available were many and fun.  We caught a taxi to 5th Ave where the shopping was much cheaper than the stuff at the hotel. The shows & special dinners provided by COX were delicious entertaining.. Thank you for a great time.

reviews.author: Bridget C
reviews.title: Nice but could use some updates
reviews.text:
The resort is nice but a few things are showing their age.  The brick pavers around the pools are starting to fall apart. I can't tell you how many times i tripped on them.  
The hotel hair dryer burnt my hair the first night we were there. I couldn't get any help from the manager on that night.  I wanted the hair dryer replaced (it was shooting out sparks) and asked for some conditioning cream for my hair from the salon.  I was told that they would just give me more conditioner that is already there. Not good enough. My hair was still falling out and my scalp was throbbing. Finally had the woman who was in charge of our group to go and get it straightened out. That next afternoon, I finally had a new hair dryer and a small container of conditioning oil.  The manager of the rooms, Abraham came to my room and apologized for the mishap. He said he wanted to make it up to me. I told him I didn't want it to happen to the next person who gets the room. I just wanted to condition my hair so it would stop falling out and help my scalp feel better and not peel. He offered me a free service at the salon, which was very nice but I didn't take him up on it because I wasn't looking for free stuff.  He was very nice and because of Abraham, I would come back. Knowing that someone was concerned for me and my well being, makes me happy. I only wish that the manager who I first spoke to could have been as accommodating. She never did any of the things she said she would do.  Anyway, enough of my story...
The food was pretty good. The service was great everywhere we were. They really hustled at the pools to get you drinks.  We brought a bunch of singles to leave as tips for the servers. The more you tip, the better service you get!  
The beach is beautiful! Water was great, warm and clean.
If you are looking for night life, this may not be the place for you. We found that for the week we were there, everything became very quiet after 9pm. Only one night club in Pyramid 3.

reviews.author: Alex M
reviews.title: Great Beach and Food
reviews.text:
This all inclusive hotel was very large and therefore provided many different areas allowing one to choose from in order to just relax or have fun. The beaches were beautiful and the water was clear blue and warm. Strong winds made ventures into the surf a bit challenging. The pools and pool bars were very nice but the availability of lounge chairs were limited making it difficult to sit back and relax. 

Food choices and the number of different restaurants were extensive and the quality of all food was very good.

My room with an ocean view was clean and lived up to my expectations. I suggest ensuring a room on or above the 3rd floor and with an ocean view. 

There are many options for sight seeing ranging from ancient temples, dolphin encounters all the way to scuba diving. Although this is an all inclusive be prepared to tip for excellent service.

reviews.author: wareagle2013
reviews.title: Great Food and Service
reviews.text:
For an All Inclusive Resort the food and service was excellent. 
Daniel, Eddie, Juan and Cesar all went above and beyond to make sure all our needs were met. 
Excellent Staff!  We will return to the Paradisus.

reviews.author: Sdccowen
reviews.title: Never mind your blow drier...bring your own robe if going to the spa bc one size does not fit all
reviews.text: If you have never been to an all inclusive, you would probably give this place a 5 but we have been to all inclusives in Riviera Maya, Cabo San Lucas and Puerto Vallarta before that far exceed this place. The hotel is huge (really too big)! The breakfast and lunch buffets both inside (Naos and Bana) and out were both cold (sausage, French fries, hot dog, pizza, etc.)...there were very few things at breakfast or lunch that I would consider good bc most was cold. By the time we left , I longed for a hot meal. We did have a good dinner at Vento (tapas) but they brought out things so fast that you couldn't enjoy the experience of trying new stuff. The same at Enso and the Market Street Grille. The rooms and bathrooms are ok (standard room) but we have had bigger/better/nicer elsewhere. They have huge balconies on the rooms but nothing else on them (no chairs or tables; you have to ask for chairs). The spa is ok. Again we have been to nicer ones. Not all the jets work in the spa pool. The room with the couples spa pool is not very appealing (black walls and panes above beds with either paint or bird poop on them). The robes at the spa are small. I put on mine and thought that, having been to other spas were you normally have to roll up the sleeves. The men's robes were REALLY small for the average American male. You have to make reservations to eat at most places but you cannot do it more than 1 day in advance and before 11 am. Their computer system cannot accommodate earlier and if you wait until after 11 am the day before, you are unlikely to get into most places. The ocean was rough. The pool on the right is not heated and if you want a drink before 11 am at the pool you have to go get it yourself. If you like sushi/sashimi you probably will like Bana. I did not, the wait staff there at dinner was the most friendly and funny!!! The red lounge (disco) is awesome if for no other reason then to people watch!! They played great music!! We watched part of a show in the Avenue Bar...could not see well...for a place this big they show have a big enough area to have chairs out front so all could see. It rained the day before we left and many rooms, hallways and stairways had towels thrown on them that were still there the next day.

reviews.author: hcmcb210
reviews.title: Fun, Fun, Fun
reviews.text: The service was great, for and drinks were awesome. The room was good for the price. Could use a little updating, but I would love to go back!! The hotel staff was spectacular. We were treated like royalty. The food was pretty good. The restaurant Agave had amazing quesadillas. The pool bartender, Salvador, made our trip. He was so much fun!!!

reviews.author: jfbf2015
reviews.title: Great Resort
reviews.text: Would have given an excellent rating except for a few areas that need addressing--for whatever reason the used bath towels in our room were taken to be laundered but not  replenished. Also, it might help to control the number of beach towels given to any one guest so that there might be access  to a towel everyone. I don't think it be too much to ask your guest to return their towels to the towel hut when they are leaving, so that you can tell what lounges are  available. I would recommend that you get to the beach or pool area early in the day.  Other  than those glitches, the food and drink are plentiful and the staff is outstanding!

reviews.author: E6859HPjohnw
reviews.title: Excellent Service from the Royal Service Section and the Restaurants on property
reviews.text:
Sandra, Sergio, Omar, Alberth, Daniel, and Lazaro all in Royal Service were the keys to such a wonderful experience this year at the Paradisus.  This was our 5th visit to the resort property and we cannot wait till our return next year.  The housekeeping staff too made sure the room was kept properly and arranged for comfort.
Sandra in Royal Service went above and beyond in making sure we got a room like what was originally PAID for AND confirmed by FunJet and The Travel Haus in St. Louis.  FunJet did step up to the plate in assisting us to get back into the Paradisus but I would NEVER use Travel Haus again for any reservation

reviews.author: M M
reviews.title: Work trip
reviews.text: The resort is excellent. The conference services manager was exceptional. She worked non stop to ensure every detail and request was completed. The grounds are beautiful and well maintained. The food is excellent with a lot of variety. The one area of improvement would be in the dining room service. Two encounters were; one, being charged a wine sommelier fee without warning and, two, attempting to be charge for lunch on the last day when we paid separately for 2 group dinners and not dining in the all inclusive restaurants. Otherwise it was an excellent trip with outstanding staff and facilities.

reviews.author: Kirsten
reviews.title: Great Beach but property needs to be updated/upgraded - disappointed
reviews.text:
I had a room in tower 2 near kid zone with parking lot view :( which I did not mind since I was here for work purpose and not on family vacation. 
The thing that really bothered me was there was no hot water at all in the shower - it was only lukewarm - no matter how much time I let it go to get hot water. I guess because my room was at lowest level. 
Another biggest disappointment was there was a hole in the bathroom roof which had a leak, yikes…

Do I need to say more?

Also heard from my other friends who had room in the main tower was that it was very loud even at 4am and they could not sleep.

I will never choose this place for family vacation.

reviews.author: brickhockey
reviews.title: Simply Spectacular!!
reviews.text: Spent 4 days at this wonderful resort.  Everything was top notch.  Beautifully set on the best part of the beach.  Only downside was restaurants use this sharing type of service, and I was sharing food from the same bowl with people I just met so that was a bit awkward.  Sometimes there wasn't enough food brought out either.  The Grille however was a very good Brazilian type restaurant where this did not occur.  I suggest the buffet and the Brazilian Grille, but forget the other specialty restaurants except for Bana which I did not visit but looked great.

reviews.author: yaroslav2016
reviews.title: Nice resort!
reviews.text:
I really enjoyed staying at this resort! Staff is very friendly. 
Every time when I go here I visit Yhi Spa. Receptionist Cecilia is very friendly and she is always open to help.
Manager Omar at the Yhi Spa was very helpful. He is a very nice person.
Massage therapist Veronika is the BEST massage therapist ever!!!!

I recommend this resort!!!

reviews.author: carrie2play
reviews.title: Not my jam
reviews.text:
I will preface this review with sharing that all-inclusive resorts aren't my thing. My standards are VERY high if I were to find myself needing to be at one, think One & Only is almost all I could stomach but not sure my bank account would appreciate that! I was at the Paradisus for a large work event, which absolutely needed to be at an all-inclusive resort, which I understand for efficiencies and ease of use so to speak with so many people - so that's my context.

All that said, I will start with the good news. Folks that work here couldn't be more gracious and sweet. Customer service is EXCELLENT.  There is no dig or knock on them!

Now, for the bad news. I'll start with one of the most important things for me, food. I could write a whole review on that in and of itself. There was no Mexican food to be found (a few sad tacos and some guacamole at time scattered around the resort buffet options) for the majority of the day's meals. I love Mexican food, so this was disappointing. There are a few nice restaurants for dinner, but otherwise, you're doing the all-inclusive thing, meaning lots of pre-made greasy food for unhealthy American tourists - fries, hamburgers, random buffet things, you get the picture. I love food, and when it's not good, it doesn't make for a great trip. 

Unfortunately the accommodations weren't all that either. I was in the 'regular' part of the resort, not the fancier part so take that into account. My room was huge, which is nice for spreading out and feeling spacious, but the lights weren't easy to use and were annoying (I like dimmable lighting). The light outside the patio door could not be turned off, so there was no leaving the doors open for fresh air and the sunrise all because of a glaring fluorescent light right above the sliding glass doors. Bathroom lighting was also terrible (all downlights) which don't work well for putting on makeup or really seeing your skin or face (probably more important for most women).  There is a fire alarm right above the beds that flashes a bright lights sporadically throughout the night - not sure how anyone can stand this?

The shower took 10+ minutes running to get hot. No joke - it really did. I took cold showers until one day I figured this out somehow, but I'm a conservationist, so this is just not acceptable. 

Every chair and table or desk in the room wobbled.

There was no patio furniture for sitting outside. Really?  I'm in Cancun, I'd like to sit on my patio.

The doors on the TV / entertainment system furniture were falling off the hinges. 

I could hear people loudly walking down the hall at night b/c the floors are so hard and the sound just goes right under the doors.  I was woken up multiple times by folks coming back to their rooms after being at the bars or clubs.

All in all, as I said, not my thing, but even if it was, this wouldn't be where I would return to spend my money or my time.

reviews.author: Donald M
reviews.title: Noteworthy staff!
reviews.text: Martin Sanchez is a very friendly server at the Market Grill!  We also had a fantastic meal at Vento (tapas restaurant).  We missed Blue Agave (closed for construction). Special thanks as always to Lizeth Escudero who makes sure our group was well taken care of!  We loved our room and the attention to detail.

reviews.author: Sarah B
reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.text: The staff is always amazing- pleasure to talk to and always looking for ways to better serve their guests! We have stayed here for the past two years and the service is always the same- perfect! The resort is beautiful and clean and for such a big resort it is also so peaceful!

reviews.author: lbowen833
reviews.title: Great place to stay!!!!!
reviews.text:
This is my second year coming back to the Paradisus hotel, and each time the staff was welcoming and accommodating to our large group. Everything was done to perfection including the cleanliness of our room - they even left a chocolate on our pillows after cleaning! 

The restaurant options were hard to chose from because they all sounded delicious. We picked to eat at Mole and enjoyed being serenaded by the mariachi band and having fine authentic Mexican food. I was very please with the service and the atmosphere and the guac is excellent!

reviews.author: jesshh81
reviews.title: Amazing, effortless, stay
reviews.text: Enjoyed every aspect. The beds were so comfy and everything was well maintained. Friendly staff. Huge resort. One of my favorite parts was the amazing greenery on the inside. It was definitely paradise.

reviews.author: pd215
reviews.title: Great Resort
reviews.text: Everything is top notch from the rooms, to the facilities, and the decor. The Staff is friendly and extremely helpful. My only criticism would be that the food was not very good at all this time around, it was definitely a step down from my first visit to Paradisus. Other than that, it was terrific.

reviews.author: duncan_macqueen
reviews.title: Great Room
reviews.text: The rooms, views, grounds, pools and bars/restaurants were amazing! just be careful when plugging in your chargers, both my wife and I were shocked trying to plug them into compatible outlets on a couple of occassions.

reviews.author: AshleyMcMurray
reviews.title: Only place to stay in Cancun
reviews.text: This was a great vacation. It was warm, and only rained briefly. I was captivated by the real feel of the rainforest upon entering the main pyramid. Easy to get lost in this huge 7 pyramid resort. The food was authentic and delicious.  Every worker greets you by saying "Hola". Love it. Can't wait to come back next year. Enjoyed going Para-sailing

reviews.author: jkaliner
reviews.title: Several visits
reviews.text: I've been to many resorts for vacation, some corporate, some family.  Paradisus is on top of every detail.  We felt so pampered and special.  We just returned for the 3rd year in a row.  They make it difficult to go anywhere else.

reviews.author: J662MFcharless
reviews.title: Powerdisus
reviews.text: The staff is outstanding....and the property extremely well maintained....the ocean views from the room and the dining areas are breath taking and the condition of the beach is immaculate...plus the avalability and assistance with booking quality off site excursions consistently makes this my first and only choice when visiting Mexico....this was my 4th visit in 4 years and I'm already planning my 5th in December 2016...

reviews.author: rlm152015
reviews.title: Breathtaking !!
reviews.text: This is my 2nd time here and I'll gladly go again! The staff is very helpful and gladly assists you for any of your needs. From the lobby to the details of the rooms and the outdoors it it is beautifully decorated for a lovely ambiance.

reviews.author: Nicholas R
reviews.title: Christmas Party!
reviews.text: The staff was amazing, attentive, and didn't miss a single detail! Thank you Paradisus for making our holiday event unforgettable! The many dining options made everyday unique. The Royal Service w/ private butlers on each floor was so convenient and Yhi spa was worth every penny!

reviews.author: rcerpa720
reviews.title: 3 year staying here before the holidays
reviews.text: Each year take a trip to the resort and 3 years in a row still nothing negative to say, stayed in Royal Service pyramid this year and a nicer upscale elegant feel, the staff is very friendly the restaurants have great selections and great food, the hotel is extremely clean and maintained. Plan to return again in the future!

reviews.author: ytfhjjkb
reviews.title: Good Value
reviews.text: Everything was A+ except the food which I would give a 6.  The resturants on site were very good but the lunch Buffett outside at the pool was not the best - I would rate lunch as a 3.  Everything else from staff, cleanliness, etc. was very good

reviews.author: charleshL4088PY
reviews.title: Great trip!!
reviews.text: Everything was amazing. The staff was friendly, we never waited for a drink and the food was great. I also loved how clean everything was. Another small detail that was great were the bath towels... They are the biggest towels ever which is great. Thank you for such a wonderful trip

reviews.author: Lizzie F
reviews.title: Amazing hospitality
reviews.text: This clean and super friendly destination offers an excellent level of service, beautifully kept beach front grounds. The service is efficient and exceptional. Bed was comfortable. Food and its services wonderful. Definitely will return for leisure.

reviews.author: jaimetis
reviews.title: the best  place in the zona hotelera, all inclusive, great stay
reviews.text: This is one of the best deals in Cancun. All inclusive with lots of places to eat, drink, relax, etc. Lots of pools and water activities. The staff is very friendly and helpful. I never saw anybody who did not say hola or buenos dias to me. The beach can be improved a little and it was windy and cloudy sometimes but this is the weather.

reviews.author: Abraham S
reviews.title: Beautiful beach, great hotel and friendly staff
reviews.text: The ambience of the hotel is great for families and romantic for couples, beautiful beach, several restaurants with good food and great service. The rooms were renovated and are ok, but could be better, but everything else is wonderful.

reviews.author: TravelersChoiceGirl
reviews.title: Very friendly staff
reviews.text: Check in by a very nice staff. Common areas are well kept and seem nice but not luxurious. Rooms are dated, small and need an overhaul. I have stayed at much nicer hotels. Very poorly lighting in the rooms and the resort in general. Good enough but not top of the line. Staff is extremely helpful.

reviews.author: Motadean
reviews.title: Huge Resort
reviews.text: This place was huge!!! I spent 5 days here this past week and I can definitely suggest it to other people. It has direct ocean front and numerous restaurants. I will let you know that all but two restaurants require a reservation for dinner so plan out your meals and get those set maybe your first day there. But if you don't Blue Agave is freaking awesome and they do not require a reservation. At night there is entertainment in the Avenue bar so please do not miss that. I think that was the highlight of my stay there. At night the Red Lounge is very popular as well so check them out. Waiter Roger was the absolute best!!! We did have some air conditioner issues in our room but the staff was on it and corrected the issue. The only complaint I have is the incense that burn through out the hotel. For people that do not smoke and aren't around smoke much it's to much. But other then that it was great!!!

reviews.author: Patti S
reviews.title: Catherines President Club
reviews.text: I wanted to take a moment to compliment the amazing service that Ernesto and Oscar provided.  They both worked at the Royal Service Pool bar.  They certainly went above and beyond for all of their guests and always had a smile on their face when doing so.  Both of them could work for me - love the 'can do' attitude and exceptional service.

reviews.author: Rajarshi C
reviews.title: 5 day in Paradisus Cancun, May 2015
reviews.text:
It was more of a Business w/ Leisure Trip. Winning "The Global Circle of Excellence Award" I went to attend this event hosted by my organization which was hosted in Paradisus Cancun. It was a 3 day event by due to flight schedules we checked in on Sunday (May 17) around 1:30 am and checked out on Thursday (May 21) around 10:30 pm.
Coming to the resort/hotel... Amazing is an understatement. The resort blocks replicates the structure of a pyramid. We were checked in to on of the rooms in the Royal Service segment and they lived up to the name "Royal Service". Got great Hospitality from the friendly staff. Great rooms specially the ones in Level 0 (we were in Pyramid Block 5).. Room # 5009 to be precise. Spacious studio unit. 24x7 butler service. Keep in mind its an All Inclusive segment, so you pay an All Inclusive fee (Mandatory) and you do not need to pay any dues while checking out (except - Spa facilities, laundry services, certain water activities). 24x7 room service for F&B, Minibar refilled at regular intervals, separate Royal Service Swimming pool, complementary butler service by the pool. 
Great ambience, great service, even you stay back at the resort you wouldn't be bored. You can book you own "Palapa" by the royal service pool. A DJ playing House Music adds on to the mood.
They have a tennis court, and beach is accessible (onsite). There are quite a few in-house clubs and restaurants. I strongly recommend Ibana and Mole restaurants.
Beautiful property to boast of.
Visit Market 28 (not on Sundays, mostly closed). There are lot of things to do around - Rio Secreto Caves Exploration, Tulum & XelHa, Chichen Itza, Catamaran Sail, Dolphinaries, Salvatica Zip Line and not to forget be sure to have advance table reserved in Coco Bongo (the most happening club which is approx. 7 mins drive from Paradisus Resort, Cancun).
For travel to and fro airport and and travel within I strongly recommed "Amster" services or you can even hire any car rental services from the airport like - Hertz, Avis, etc.
To conclude, a resort with amazing service and ambience, you would just love staying here and would long for more. None the less amazing place for couples and you can make excuses to be here to celebrate end number of Honeymoons ;)

Bon Voyage--
Regards,
Rajarshi (Rishi)

reviews.author: Locarte
reviews.title: Review: Royal Services Staff
reviews.text:
