If you're looking for upgraded and premium amenities, the "Royal Services" pyramid is for you. This smaller section of the hotel is more  private and quiet than the general public area. It has a completely different feel than the rest of the hotel. (The rest of the hotel is great, but this section is REALLY great.) We especially enjoyed the special nightly entertainment and hospitality bar as a way to begin our evenings.

Our personal butler was ROSANA. She was on hand throughout the day to make our reservations, answer questions and take care of every detail/errand we needed. The purpose of the butler is to keep the guest care free.This was certainly accomplished by Rosana.  We were given a special phone to reach her during the day. Each night after dinner, when we returned to the room, we would find a beautiful display of fruit, mini desserts and a hand written note arranged for us by her. It was a very nice touch. We found Rosana to be excellent at her job.

There are other members of the Royal Service staff that stood out during our stay. DANIEL in the pool area, was very helpful in making arrangements for a daily Bali Bed. (Bali Beds are not guaranteed - you must have a reservation and the location can change each day.) Most impressive to me, though was the way I witnessed him handle a VERY difficult guest who was reserved next to me. Also, Daniel was training a new employee who was very attentive and friendly to our group. I regret that I did not get his name. He was one of the people who constantly checked on us, answered our questions and tracked down the busy gentlemen food/drink servers for us.

Also by the pool with exceptional food/drink service on our very first full day was GUADALUPE. She took good care of us when I know the heat and the large crowd didn't make it easy. We were never thirsty or hungry though, with Guadalupe.  During our stay, she also worked inside the Royal Services breakfast/snack area. Again, top notch service with a friendly smile. 

I also visited the spa for a 50 min relaxation massage with YURI, who gets 5 stars for technique. She worked out the kinks without causing residual soreness. DONT MISS THIS.

Housekeeping was spotty. Sometimes they restocked the mini refrigerator and sometimes they didn't.  We had to request bottled water one day because we didn't have any. (This is a big deal in a climate that is hot and humid.). Washcloths were another problem; on three occasions we had just one. These are minor things that were cleared up, but they should have been non-existent to begin with. HOWEVER: I accidentally left my wedding ring on the dresser and went to the pool where 4 hours later I realized I didn't have it.  When I raced to our freshly cleaned room, there it was, just as I had left it.  For this, housekeeping gets. 5 stars.

SUMMARY: I was constantly greeted by friendly staff who were willing to help me any way they could.  The people I have named were just the ones that I had the best interaction with, but you can expect to have contact with 10-15 helpful staff members per day.

THE PROPERTY: The property is beautiful and a bit dated in areas however it is constantly being cleaned and maintained. I saw workers in the gardens, painting, dusting, sweeping etc... The public bathroom areas were pristine. 

The view/: 5 stars excellent
The service: 5 stars excellent
The property: 3 stars good

reviews.author: Heeva A
reviews.title: Average hotel overall
reviews.text:
Stayed here for 5 nights in late October and enjoyed our stay. I've stayed at better all-inclusives in Cancun (Excellence Playa Mujeres), but this hotel did a good job. The pool is nothing special, but it's very clean. The staff was very nice (for the most part), but the most disappointing aspect of this hotel was the food. The food was pretty awful actually. I only truly enjoyed one meal and that was at the Market Grill for dinner (Brazilian BBQ). The staff and food were amazing. Our server (Efratin) was super helpful and accommodating. 

Now let me tell you about our rooms. At first, we were given rooms in building 4 (which is quite a far walk to the main building where all the food and activities are). We were there for a couple days until my wife (she's 7 months pregnant) noticed they were applying paint thinner and other chemicals to all the floors in our building. I immediately asked to be moved due to the tremendous health hazard (esp for someone pregnant) and I was moved 3 hrs later. They apparently only had 1 room available, which I highly doubt since they were only at 40% capacity. That was annoying (not having more options) and we lost our ocean view since there were no other rooms available (or so they said).

I wouldn't come back, but wouldn't also say it was so terrible that I would deter people from going. I would simply suggest a different all-inclusive.

reviews.author: Rounsie
reviews.title: I think I got the bad room
reviews.text:
I'd love to score this higher. The staff were beautiful. Nothing too much trouble, I hope they are well looked after. 
The food was really good. Considering the volumes they did an amazing job. The individual restaurants were faultless. 
Now my room! Above the disco you can't get to sleep. Friday night was the worst, but here for a conference and it was exhausting. The room thumped all night. Wireless internet was useless in the room, we had to go into the lobby to get it. The shower didn't have enough pressure or hot water to be comfortable or efficient. On the last day we decided to watch a movie after dinner to find the tv didn't work. There is a gap across the top of the door, and we're adjacent to the lifts, so the noise is straight in. We certainly didn't sleep well. So yes, love to give a better rating, and I think it was just our room, but not at all good.

reviews.author: Larry S
reviews.title: Wonderful Mexican Getaway!
reviews.text: Great food, great service and the rooms are fabulous with great views.  Many rooms have a hot tub on the roomy patio!  They treat you like a king in the restaurants.  Ask fior Jeremius, Bonilla or Dorwin, Chorono at the restaurant Ibana, you will not be disappointed!

reviews.author: imventarza
reviews.title: A place to came back with better wheather
reviews.text: The Hotel is very well located and very big. All the staff is very friendly and the try to help you with every details. Rooms are very nice and big. You have everything that you need even the beach towels. The swimming pool is very nice but was very difficult to use because of the weather.  The views are very nice but my room was located very low and I did not have any view( room 5002)

reviews.author: SapphireBoston
reviews.title: Nice but Inconsistent
reviews.text:
I stayed here 4 days for a business conference. It's a beautiful hotel in a great location on the beach. It presents itself as a luxury property and in some ways it is but in other ways, it's not.

The pros:
Close to the beach
Great pools and lounge areas
Beautifully designed rooms and common areas
Nice big room layouts and amenities
Really good food at the restaurants especially for an all inclusive. I was very pleasantly surprised by the food. (But room service breakfast was pretty horrible by contrast, rubbery eggs, and the turkey sausage was actually just a gross hot dog.)
Comfy bedding and towels
Room was very clean
Staff is very friendly and tries hard to please
I had a Zumba class with Alfonso and he was a fun instructor
Go to the Passions restaurant - even if you don't stay at this resort. Passions was one of the best dining experiences of my life. The chef there is a genius!

The cons:
Although they are trying hard, they mistake many simple things. For example:
They give you a special card if you have dietary restrictions. Present this card at your meal and they will adjust your entree to accommodate your diet. I did this, the waiter indicated he understood and even talked to the chef. They got half the restrictions right but still put ingredients in my food that are listed on the card as allergies. So I had to pick through the food and take out the problem ingredients. 
The activities they offer are automatically canceled if only one guest shows up. So I came for a workout class by the pool and the instructor was there but he refused to do the class with me because I was the only one.
They have a live Latin band on Saturday nights and offer dancing - but only for one hour. That's hardly enough time for a dance party. It's over as soon as it starts. It's not really appropriate for a vacation resort to only offer a party for one hour on Saturday night.
If your room is near the nightly activities, you'll have to participate or wait until it ends- for example I had to wait out the opera concert before I could go to sleep. (That's also probably why the dance party only lasted one hour).
There were other odd things like each day I got a different combination of towels - sometimes I'd get face cloths sometimes not. Sometimes two bath towels, sometimes one. It was random.
They were working on the power while I was there and although they said it would be off for 2 hours, it was off for much longer. And that meant no air conditioning. People were burning up. I didn't understand why they wouldn't run a generator.
During my September visit, the ocean was doing some weird ecological thing where it dumps massive amounts of sea weed on the shore. The smell was disgusting and of course there's no way you would swim in it. It was so gross I couldn't tolerate a short walk on the beach. I was there for a conference, so someone else made my reservation and it didn't ruin my trip, but I wondered if the regular guests were informed of this before reserving. Someone was having a wedding at the beach and I felt really bad for them.

Overall, it seemed like the staff training and management wasn't up to the level of quality they want to represent. The staff were trying hard but delivery was inconsistent. There were many mishaps. If you can deal with that, it's a beautiful hotel in a great location.

reviews.author: Denny2701
reviews.title: Great time in Cancun
reviews.text: Had a great time and fun experience. Beach was nice and vast. Pool was great. Will make sure to make reservations i earlier as this became a bit of a bother if we wanted to try a different place to eat

reviews.author: MGIson
reviews.title: Huge hotel with staff that could care less about the guests
reviews.text: Overall, this is a huge hotel with lots of options and a beautiful beach.  The staff is the weakest I've ever experienced at a hotel.  From check in, to solving details, to care at the restaurants the only consistent thing is that not a single staff member cared about the guests.  They have lots of staff but no one ever seems to do anything help the customer.  I had a problem with my room key and after 4 visits to the front desk and a "security officer" nothing worked.  I demanded a manager come solve the problem and new keys magically worked.  It should not have taken so much to solve such a simple problem.  Even though the staff saw me back in the welcome lounge, I had to wait until they finished with all the customers.  Every simple problem that was raised by me or any member of the large group here for a meeting, nothing was solved simply.  You have to wait for towels to be told they have run out.  You are told you can't be seated in one of the restaurants without a reservation - but after throwing a fit magically we were seated in a near empty restaurant that always had a free table during our visit.  You have lots of choices in Cancun - my only advice is to pick another hotel!

reviews.author: Y5909QJcraigs
reviews.title: Awesome Trip
reviews.text:
We attended a conference at Paradisus Resorts in Cancun last year.  We all had such an awesome time that we requested that the conference be held there again this year.  It was as great the second time around.  

We did the royal service and it truly was the royal treatment.  The food and entertainment was fantastic!  The service was great!  The staff was very helpful and friendly.

My husband and I went together and we stayed an extra few days. It was very romantic and relaxing.  We would recommend this resort to anyone that wants a wonderful, relaxing vacation.

reviews.author: Ayeletb
reviews.title: Excellent experience
reviews.text: I came here to speak at a conference and loved the hotel, the people, the service and variety of food. The place has a great spirit and it is a great place to go write a book, with breaks! There is a ton of options for food and every experience was great. The staff wanted to make sure we had a great experience.

reviews.author: Khanh N
reviews.title: Awesome butler service
reviews.text: My family and I were here for a conference in December and really enjoyed the butler service. We had Ramon and he really catered to my 8 yr old. He was able to hook me up with a few amenities which would have cost extra if I did not have him. we stayed in the Royal service 1 bedroom suite. The room had a nice ocean view. Although the planters outside did not have any plants in them, the room was really spacious. Mt favorite restaurants were the Japanese and the Brazilian grill.

reviews.author: Michelle K
reviews.title: Nice hotel
reviews.text: I was at the Paradisus Cancun for a work trip so I didn't get to take advantage of many of the amenities. The meeting was off peak so the room rate was extremely reasonable. The food was pretty good and the hotel was not crazy busy. It's difficult to make reservations for the restaurants so I recommend calling at 9 am when they open or even a few days in advance. I stayed in building 4 because I heard building 3 was too loud. I had no noise complaints and a beautiful view.

reviews.author: tntraveler1
reviews.title: First Time at All Inclusive Was Awesome
reviews.text: ITEX had our national convention in Cancun this year at the Paradisus Cancun. We were used to going to Vegas but got really tired of it. This was a great trip. The flight from Atlanta was direct and only about 2 hours. The hotel was awesome. We had a few hiccups in the beginning but all was good. The air conditioning was not working very well but they had someone there in short order and got it fixed. We stated for 7 days and had a great time. The food was good and consistent. We moved around several of the restaurants and sampled several different cuisines. The pool was fantastic. We had great service and enjoyed the cabanas. It is well worth the $50 to get one for the day. The pool bar food was good and easy to get to. They are in their slow season and that's when they do a lot of their repairs and renovations so don't be surprised if some things are closed or not available if you go this time of year. I wasn't a big deal for us so we don't feel we missed too much. The interior lobby of the hotel is not cooled as you would normally expect in the states. It was quite warm and humid. Tropical if you will. But you get used to it quickly and don't really notice it much. At the time of our trip the sea weed was thick. Not the resorts problem but they seem to have that problem quite often in Cancun. The staff was great. Anything we asked for was handled quickly and with a smile. We did tip at dinner and tipped the wait staff at the pool and the assorted bars. It does get their attention. We always were asked first if we needed anything. It's nice to be king. Overall the hotel and the trip was fantastic. We will be back next year.

reviews.author: gsmariags
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel
reviews.text:
Beautiful hotel, great facilities and overall a very nice experience. The only complaint I had is that the last 2 days of my stay they were fixing the roof and the noise went on until 11pm. I think that was a bit too late for being working on something. Also the paint smell was quite strong inside the room. Nonetheless, when I call front desk to let them know, they offered me to switch rooms. Also the wi-fi was pretty bad...
Regardless, I will definitely go back to this hotel.

reviews.author: Ioana T
reviews.title: Good service, but quite expensive, feel somewhat captive within the hotel property
reviews.text: I stayed at this hotel for a week (Sept 5-11, 2015)---so off-season, while attending an industry conference that took place at the hotel.  While the quality of the room, service, food were OK I don't see how they delivered the value for money, at a room rate of USD315/night, and I stayed in their executive/special reserve area.  While there is a diversity of restaurants on site, it is quite difficult to make a reservation (they seemed booked all the time), so I expect during the season is almost impossible.  The food at the buffet is OK but nothing special.  The entertainment throughout the hotel was average quality (lots of loud singing) and could have done without.  Prices at the boutique at the hotel are ridiculous (a regular sun lotion Banana Boat was 24 USD).  Concierge staff was very helpful and friendly.   The beach/ocean water had lots of algae so in some days was quite difficult and unpleasant to swim (despite excellent water temperature).  The conference room facilities could have been a lot better (no windows in any of the conference rooms, air conditioning was either freezing cold or not working at all and logistics support was mediocre at best).

reviews.author: Arthur
reviews.title: This place is Great!
reviews.text:
We stayed in building 3 on the top floor overlooking the lagoon. We had a nice big balcony and the shower was awesome! 
This was the 1st time we did all inclusive. There were two restaurants that you did not need reservations and 5 more that you did. There was also the Sunset Grill by the main pool where you could have lunch. The food was always good and the service amazing! 
The place was always clean and the beach was was wonderful! Make sure you stop and see Carla at Guest Services near the elevator on the 1st floor and she will set you up on a catamaran trip and snorkeling to Isla Mujeres!
We would definitely go back to this resort!

reviews.author: mayrametal
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: I had to pleasure to stay in this resort and I can only recommend it. The service is fantastic, all very friendly and polite. Very nice fitness room opened from 6:30AM to 9PM. Excellent restaurants! Great swimming pool as well. Fantastic sea although not really for kids (strong waves). You can also take a kaiak and do a tour at the Lagoon (the Hotel provides that to guests, the so called "Eco Tour"). Many activities for kids and sports for adults as well. Live music in the evenings. Highly recommended!!

reviews.author: mariacW5397KT
reviews.title: Very good Experience specially first time in Cancun
reviews.text: The resort has everything but I would have loved to explore other areas in Cancun but our company was very protective of the participants and we were discouraged to do so. maybe in the future the resort will be the one to create trips or excursion outside resort just to see the other areas in Cancun.

reviews.author: tvlgem
reviews.title: Fantastic!
reviews.text: Great location, clean, excellent customer service, very attentive staff. Would stay at this location again! Resteraunts were not my favorite food- but good assortment. Nice beach area and beautiful pools!

reviews.author: Maurizio G
reviews.title: All included at high level
reviews.text:
but still without spending all your money
good position, close to the city but in front of a nice beach
good options of restaurants but need to make reservation for a la cart restos because they are easily without places!!
a good stay globally

reviews.author: Fan S
reviews.title: 5 Star Service
reviews.text: The service, room view, amenities, restaurants, bars and event venue truly live up to Five Star in Paradisus Cancun.  It was a pampering experience and great memory to have. Wish to be back one day in the future.

reviews.author: Timothy M
reviews.title: Excellent value for money
reviews.text:
Enjoyed the stay.  Food excellent for an all inclusive.
Rooms very comfortable... would go again if I did not have to travel for 18 hours!
Beach was very pleasant - almost deserted in May.
Staff very pleasant as well.

reviews.author: jessican132
reviews.title: My fave resort in Cancun
reviews.text:
This is my second time staying here for a work conference and I love it here.  The first time, I had heard the hotel got bought out and I think the staff situation was questionable.  2 years later I'm back here and they seemed to have fixed their situation, as all the staff were amazing.  For many reasons this is my favourite resort I've been to so far; great customer service, great buffet and food (and I'm a foodie) and my favourite thing about this place is that you step out of the hotel and you're right on the beach.  The nightlife is pretty tame, but there's a neat lounge with beds everywhere and they have live entertainment there.  Then there's the small club called The Red Lounge.  

Because we were here for a business trip with clients, we also joined an even bigger event with our Latin America division of our company.  The service we had from the conference staff, even with a huge event going on with 600 plus people, I still felt the conference staff were on point.  They were always available when we needed them.  I must warn you that planning the conference from afar proved to be a challenge, as they do not respond very quickly via email.  But when you arrive, you soon realize it's because they spend their day running around the resort getting things done.  When I arrived, the staff were so attentive to all our needs.

I was most impressed when we had a scheduled dinner for over 600 people on the golf course and they put out cushioned chairs on the course during the day, but then it rained a lot, causing all of the chairs to get soaked.  The staff informed us that the dinner would be delayed an hour and when we arrived, everything was dry and set up.  They hustled so fast to replace the cushioned chairs with folding chairs with seat covers, it was amazing.

Highly recommend for conferences!

Rooms are great, especially when you have an ocean view.  Showers have a rainfall option and a hand held option.  Pretty clean to my high standards.

Late at night, the taco restaurant is available for snacks, with a limited menu.

reviews.author: benny_decock
reviews.title: Paradise in Cancun
reviews.text:
Great hotel Paradisus , Great service !!! Nice pools, cocktails bars, resto's.
Every class can be handeld, Family, adults only, Royal Service.
Even for your wedding is this the place to be, there is a very nicy wedding chapel with a view on the beach.
For a vacation without worries. If you look for a piece of paradise you will find it here !!!

reviews.author: karen g
reviews.title: Excellent stay, would recommend it.
reviews.text:
My husband attended a conference held at the hotel so I went along with him.  SO glad I did!  The resort was very very nice, picture perfect in fact... well maintained and everyone seemed very friendly and willing to help.  From the white-sand beach, to the turquoise-colored water, to the immaculate grounds and pool area, to the well-stocked buffets and restaurants, I really have nothing to complain about.  Perhaps they could add a few more palapas or umbrella areas so you don't have to be out in the sun, I could see that being a problem in more crowded conditions.  We found our shaded area early in the day, beating the afternoon crowd.  We did leave our towels, sandals, iPhones, room key, etc., in a bag [hidden from view] on our chairs and never had a problem with anything being taken.  We also utilized the in-room safe for all valuables and never had an issue.  

The housekeeping service was excellent, beds made fresh daily and with a turn-down service and chocolates on the pillows every evening!  Nice touch.  [Altho' friends in the room next door did not receive chocolates, kind of odd!]  The mini-bar is included, which was unexpected but really nice.  Our room was made up early and always every clean!

The resort had many restaurants to choose from, however reservations are needed at most of them and they must be made before 5 pm the day you want to visit.   It was odd as many didn't seem 'full', but it was the rule and they didn't made any exceptions unless someone cancelled a reservation.  There were two places that were not part of the all-inclusive and required an extra charge.  We did not eat there.  

As part of the conference we had a few nights where staff had to serve around 150 people and they did so without problems, and with a different theme for each of the nights.  We felt the food was great, lots of authentic Mexican food choices along with healthy options and food made-to-order.

A couple complaints I have regarding the conference accommodations... a couple times there was a cocktail hour that was held in what seemed like the basement of the building [however with views to the street].  The room echoed a lot and seemed a bit 'cold', not much decor and lots of white tile.  It was loud and not a nice place for the conference attendees to mingle and network.  I would think there must be other places within the resort that would have been a much better fit for that purpose.  Also, the last night we attended an awards dinner and it was held at the same time another group had a dinner/meeting and the other group didn't seem to know where they were to go-a bit of confusion.  They were a much 'louder' group and during our meeting they could be heard yelling and playing their loud music.  Again, I would think some of that could have been avoided given the size of the resort.

reviews.author: Jamie M
reviews.title: Amazing Stay!
reviews.text: I stayed at this property for a corporate event and enjoyed every minute of it. The property itself is beautiful and the rooms were very nice, clean, and well maintained. I was lucky enough to stay in the Royal Services area and the level of service was fantastic! The staff was so helpful and friendly and really made us feel special during our stay. Its a beautiful place to relax, unwind, and enjoy great food and drinks by the pool and beach. A special thank you to Edier, Octavio, Elizabeth, Juan, and Axel for taking such amazing care of our group. Thanks for everything!

reviews.author: Lori H
reviews.title: Nice place Butler no so much
reviews.text: The facility is nice and has restaurants and Bali beds to use for the  residents .  The food is delicious .  The butler was a disappointment. The Bali beds are supposed to be scheduled by the Butler. The extra service promised was not done.  I reported the poor Butler service during my stay.  It did not get better.    Make sure you understand about making restaurant reservations and Bali bed reservations to ensure the benefits promised.  Hopefully your butler will explain the services and provide services offered

reviews.author: polymerizer
reviews.title: Nice Resort - average food
reviews.text:
The Resort is nice and has a beautiful infrastructure. Pools, beach access, rooms, lobby are all outstandingly beautiful. People are really friendly and helpful.
What wasn't so fantastic was the food, and even less the drinks. The all - inclusive philosophy has clearly a negative influence on what's being served. Eating from a buffet is always a difference than being cooked for individually. Places in the a la carte restaurants were unfortunately so scarce that it was almost impossible to try the Mexican specialties or one of the other smaller restaurants. Fruit juices and cocktails were all instant and sugar taste... anywhere else in Mexico you get freshly squeezed juices and wonderful margeritas for very little money... so it shouldn't be a problem in a 5 star resort. Also pity that the pools close so early, a late evening drink at the pool bar would have been highly appreciated. A little more outside seating restaurants wouldn't harm either.
Temperature in the lobby area is way too hot, aircon in the rooms works well.
Avoid rooms towards the lobby area, as it is very loud at night. Definitely book an Ocean View room away from the busy central pyramid area.
All in all a great place to stay for some days, so still 4 stars for me.

reviews.author: Ted S
reviews.title: Be Treated Like You Didn't Spend $300+ a Night
reviews.text: Absolutely horrific service. Nice Rooms, Pool and Beach, but the common areas are terribly hot and service is so bad. If you are a male, expect to be ignored by bartenders unless you tip every single time (not so all inclusive).

reviews.author: Valquir C
reviews.title: Wow moments!!!! Full of that in this amazing Resort!!!
reviews.text:
They call "Wow moments" and I can ensure that is very accurate.

So many time they surprised us! So many incredible moments which made our moment in this hotel unforgettable!!
You have to see with your own eyes!!

You feel a very beautiful and kind environment in this hotel! They take care of you all the time. I really start to get used to this kind of treatment!!

Thank you Sandra Blum and Ana Rosa for those amazing special moments!!!

reviews.author: KellyG57108
reviews.title: Treated like royalty!
reviews.text: A MUST stay property!  Beach was so clean and well maintained.  Staff was awesome! Food just kept getting better and better!  Will definitely go back!Everything was perfect!  Next time however I will request ocean view!!

reviews.author: World Traveler
reviews.title: Not such a great resort
reviews.text:
I had not very good experience at Paradisus resort in Cancun Mexico.  Most reviewers stayed at this resort paid for the all inclusive price.  I didn't not so my experience is from a non-all-inclusive point of view.

The resort was nice don't get me wrong.  The lobby was nice and the staff tried to great everyone as they come in.  I had to catch a cab from the airport to this resort since the resort  did not offer any free shuttle service.  I was on my own since I wasn't one of the guest who paid all inclusive price.

The AC from the resort couldn't keep up with the humidity and the Cancun hot weather.  There were sand on the floor in my room.  

Checking out was interesting:
1)  I had to leave the resort very early in the morning (like 5:30am) and there was a person at the lobby checking to make sure that I had a ticket which showed I paid the room.  They must have people stayed there and not paid???  This was the first hotel that I had to experience this level of 'trust' as I left the resort.
2)  Since I checked out the hotel so early, the person at the front desk told me that he couldn't print out the receipt showing zero balance and that he will email it to me after I wrote down my email address.  I need the hotel receipt for business trip expense report.  I noticed that the resort added some 'optional fees' to the bill without telling. I found out because I asked them to explain each line item.  I had to ask them to take it out.
3) Once I arrived home, I didn't see any receipt from the resort for a few days.  I had to make several phone calls; wrote several emails and finally received the official resort receipt for my business trip expense report.  The part that I found strange was that the amount listed in Mexico Pesos and not US Dollars.  The other thing I found strange was that for each restaurant I ate, instead of showing the final amount (price + tip) the bill had several lines.  From a business expense report, it looked like I ate at that restaurant multiple times during the same day.  I had to explain that to my company.

BTW, WiFi was terrible.  Try to do a speed test and see what you get from your room (not in the lobby of course)

Overall, it's an expensive resort.  It's not a good resort if you're not paying the all inclusive price.  It's not a good resort for business traveler, in my opinion.  I have been too multiple hotels outside the US and this was the very first place where it wasn't pleasant to do expense report because of the things I mentioned above.

reviews.author: WorldlyTravelers
reviews.title: Its ok, good value and nice location
reviews.text:
I spent 3 nights here before moving to the Secrets property, it was not to bad, its is strangely set out and easy to get confused in here, rooms are a little outdated.

Service and checkin was smooth but would much prefer and all inclusive property as this hotel is quite a distance from general touristy area.

reviews.author: Busyjo
reviews.title: Staff exceptionnal
reviews.text:
I stayed in the Royal section and enjoyed every moment of my short stay.
The staff in this section is exceptionnaly good.  They go above and beyond to make sure you have what you need.  And always with a smile.
I have to mention the excellent service and the smile and happiness of 
EDGAR FIGUEROA at the Royal buffet.  Thank you Edgar for your wonderful service and dedication.
Hasta la proxima vez.
Johanne

reviews.author: Mark L
reviews.title: What an amazing two months.
reviews.text: I have had 7 programs at this resort since Jan 2, 2015.  So many people to acknowledge.  Sandra Blum Resident Manager is AMAZING.  Ana Garcia Conference Services Director, probably the best in the industry, Abran Front Desk Manager, Lazarro, Royal Service Manager, Reyes, Family Concierges so dedicated.  Thank you all for the most amazing two months serving over 2000 of our attendees.  The food was amazing, the hotel staff incredible and the physical property AWESOME.  I got bumped off my flight the last day (well I volunteered and stayed at the OMNI for one night).  Anyway, NO COMPARISON.  You guys rock.  Looking forward to coming back again this summer.

reviews.author: robinp562
reviews.title: Staff are Top Notch Professionals
reviews.text: We took our customers to the beautiful Paradisus, Cancun. An all-inclusive resort. Amazing staff, spectacular views, excellent food. First and foremost, NELLY DIAZ, Sub-gerente de Grupos y Convenciones Conference Services Subdirector, without her soothing calm demeanor and "we'll get it done attitude", it would have been a different stay for our customers. Rafael Rodriguez- Banquet Manager, went above and beyond to care for all of us, Angel Toledo –Banquet Captain, another outstanding person who took great care of us, Abraham Franco- Front desk Manager helping us with all of the changes our customers were requesting. Daniel Amador- J&S Audiovisual, making sure our presentations went smoothly.

reviews.author: James c
reviews.title: Great beach and drinks, average otherwise
reviews.text: Went for a business trip, stayed for the weekend when joined by my wife.  Sun and pool and sand and drinking are great.  Keep you expectations in check for other amenities.  Food is OK but hit or miss.  Nine hole par 3 course is fun, bring your own balls and tees

reviews.author: Jerri B
reviews.title: Treated like Royals! Beautiful sight! Looks like something out of a magazine! A+
reviews.text: I was treated as a guest because of my work Windstream held our Windstream Idol competition and celebration here. We were treated as a royal customer which gave us our own "butler" and our own special section of the hotel only for us with extra activities with our very own restaurant just for us along with our very own pool and beach area separate from the other areas.  Our "butler" Tony was very nice and tried to be accomodating, I believe he was fairly new because the cell phone we were given didnt work correctly and we didnt have as much contact with him as we liked. Some of the other fellow employees has "butlers" that drawed them baths with rose petals. There was a little communication issue with some of the cleaning maids but all in all it was a beautiful place and we were treated like royals. We had a stocked refrigerator that was constantly being replenished. They had 9 restaurants with unlimited food and drinks. Pina Coladas were excellent. Be sure to ask for the coconut ice cream! It was out of this world. They had bali beds where you could lay outside. If you plan on going either work on some basic spanish words or download an app on how to translate. Also we downloaded an app that changed USD to pesos. It came in handy a lot! I very elegant and beautiful hotel,

reviews.author: Peter N
reviews.title: Very Clean, Very Friendly
reviews.text:
My wife and I stayed here as part of a corporate event.  We stayed 9 days and was all-inclusive.  The restaurants have good food, and there are many options.  The wait staff is fairly aggressive at pushing the "extra charge" wine, ranging from 700 pesos to 3,000 pesos per bottle and up.  The house wine is above average for a house wine and it worked fine.  Beware the Market Grill for lunch, it's extra for lunch, but included for dinner.  This was not clear to us.  Lots of beach and pool seating, but get there early (10am) as it filled up quickly during our visit.  

Directly in front of the hotel you can catch the public bus into Cancun and to the shopping areas.  For the two of us it was 21 pesos each way ($1.68 USD for two).  The bus is the way to go.  There is no apparent schedule, but they run continuously and frequently.

We found the facility to be spotless and in good repair.  It's a beautiful resort and we had only good experiences with t he staff.  All the desk and wait staff spoke English.

I rated it a high value, but in all honesty I don't know the true cost because we were part of a 195 person group on a group rate.

reviews.author: daed1524
reviews.title: Rooms close to the entrance
reviews.text: Better avoid accomodation in the rooms (Lagoon view) close to the main entrance (2-5 floor in the middle).  If you nonetheless do prepare to 24h noise and diesel aroma from the buses  and cars which arrive all the time.

reviews.author: JennO
reviews.title: Great Place, Great People, Great Weather, Great Beach
reviews.text:
I am a Meeting Planner and coordinate many Sales Meetings and Executive meetings throughout the year and the meeting I most recently planned at Paradisus Cancun from Jan 12 - 15, 2015 was by far the best location and meeting in my many years of doing this. 
The resort is absolutely beautiful and spotlessly clean. As a meeting planner I was very impressed with the level of service we (I) received since it was an all-inclusive resort. 
Our group was given a private check in area which made group arrivals quick and easy. We were also all handed a delicious drink upon entering which was much appreciated after a long travel day. All the rooms in my room block were clean, well decorated and well stocked. Those of us that had an ocean view couldn't have been happier. 
Lorena Gonzalez was my Conference Sales Manager and she was beyond amazing. Everytime I needed her she was right there, very friendly, helpful and knowlegeable. I wish every CSM was as great as she is. Large meeting groups can be picky and hard to deal with pleasing and she did such a wonderful job of accomodating my group. She really helped make my life much easier on-site as well as making me look like super star to my group. 
The A/V company that Paradisus uses (JSAV) was also top-notch. All equipment was provided and for a reasonable cost and was also in good working condition. They also had someone outside the meeting space for the entire 3 days of our meeting so if there had been a problem (and there wasn't) they were there to help immediately. I was impressed by this. 
There are many different food options on the property that were all good so there was no reason for people to leave the property if they didn't want to. There were also ample bars inside and outside so people could find a social place to hang out. 
The beach is simply amazing with plenty of lounge chairs, umbrellas and even a bunch of covered canopy ceach beds. The beach also had volley ball, soccer, etc... which we as a group took advantage of during some free time. 
All the staff I encountered was incredibly friendly and ready to serve you. My drink was never empty and if I was seen sitting outside the meeting room by a Paradisus employee I was greeted with a smile and warm Hola and offered a drink, food or dessert. 
I visited the AMAZING YHI spa for a massage and for that hour I was in heaven. The spa facilities are very impressive and the services were incredible. 
Overall - our experience as a business group of people from all over the US we loved our stay at Paradisus. I personally can not wait to get back there for vacation and hope I can have our meeting there again next year. I highly reccommend this resort to all meeting planners!!

reviews.author: camp708
reviews.title: Nothing Special
reviews.text: Visited Paradisus for a 3 day business meeting with the all-inclusive package. Nice facility, but not new. In fact, while I was out at meetings, they actually did some painting in my room which resulted in a very toxic smell, strong enough to require me to change rooms. I travel a lot, never had a hotel touch-up paint in the room I occupied. Overall, the food was just OK with the seafood being the highlight. The beef steak I had at La Perla was a very thin cut and therefore not tender. The Japanese restaurant sushi was tasteless. The hotel was relatively empty yet it was not easy getting in the restaurants included in the all-inclusive deal because of the small seating capacity. The buffet did have a wide variety, but again, only the seafood stood out, while the rest was very average. The highlight was the staff - very friendly, spoke English well, and always greeted you with a smile. Paradisus is nothing special, but nothing real negative either other than the untimely painting of my room.

reviews.author: Chris R
reviews.title: Loved it
reviews.text: I stayed at Paradisus for a business conference for a week and I can say my experience was absolutely great. My room had an excellent beachfront view with balcony, it was cozy and clean. I also loved the all-inclusive especially since the food at the restaurants was amazing. This was my first stay at a Melia Hotel, but I was pleasantly impressed. My only regret is that I'm only wishing I could have stayed longer after the conference was over! :)

reviews.author: Michael M
reviews.title: What a great vacation or meeting destination!!
reviews.text:
My wife and I visited the Paradisus Resort in Cancun, Mexico from 12/6/2014 to 12/14/2014. We signed up for their "Royal Service" and it was spectacular service!! We were there to attend a medical conference but stuck some extra days on before and after the meeting.

There are too many folks to thank and acknowledge but suffice it to say, we had a wonderful vacation holiday.

Some of the folks who stood out included:
Our Butler- Rodrigo
Our Pool side servers- Octavio, Rodgelio, Javier, and Francisco
Our Wine Somelier- Iran
Our Front Desk crew at Royal Service- Leticia, Flavio, Natalia, and Karla
The Resturant staff- Leonardo (Mole and Blue Agave Resturants); Rodio and Sonya.

Special thanks to the Chef from NACO buffet (I didnt get his name unfortunately). He prepared my freshly caught red snapper and trigger fish as I requested, "Mayan Style". My fisherman buddies, their wives and several other couples in our group enjoyed the meal that the chef prepared and some are still raving about it. It was the best red snapper I have ever eaten.

The rest of the food in the several resturants was also wonderful. I loved the Market Grill Rodizio and the Mole/ Blue Agave mexican resturants.  The food and beverages overall were high end and plentiful. 

We have stayed at all inclusive resorts before but this one was by far, the best we have experienced. The hotel is very spacious and comfortable. Our room faced the blue Caribbean Sea and was exquisite.

The management and resort staff have blended together well and have created a great team.

Best regards to my new familia at the Paradisus Cancun.
Mike Milner

reviews.author: John R
reviews.title: Friendly staff, clean, good food
reviews.text:
Friendliest staff of any place I've ever stayed!

The hotel itself was spotless, inside and out.

The food was plentiful and good, not great. We were there on a work-sponsored trip and everything was paid for in advance, so I was expecting "fill-you-up buffets" more than gourmet meals. So I'm not deducting any points. 

About the only complaint I have is that the wi-fi reception was poor. But that's okay. No big deal to me personally.

reviews.author: Rebecca R
reviews.title: Top Notch Resort!
reviews.text: We stayed for a week here from 12/8-12/13. Resort is gorgeous, VERY clean. All the staff was amazing, especially Hector from the Pool Bar/Beach. He was sweet, very courteous, ALWAYS got our drinks quickly. We absolutely loved him! Maid service is every day, although they didn't always stock the mini-bar, we had to call a couple of times, but other than that, and having to wait for a reservation in one of the restaurants, we had no issues! Beach is gorgeous and very clean, and well maintained. Dealing with the local merchants you walk up and down the beach can get a little tedious at times, because they can be very pushy, but we did see security shooing them away a few times, which was nice. Very safe! The nightclub and Hookah bar were great touches! We hadn't seen them at other resorts like this. We were a little disappointed that there wasn't more Mexican food choices at the buffet, but the food was great and top notch. We came with 2 other couples for a medical conference and we will definitely be back to this resort in the future. I was a little nervous about traveling to Mexico, but there was never a time that I did not feel completely safe. GREAT RESORT! And a HUGE thanks to Hector for taking care of us all week!

reviews.author: darleytravel
reviews.title: The potential for 'excellent' is there, but NOT present
reviews.text:
The first impression, the lobby, is breathtaking.  I was mesmerized.  For a moment or two.  Our group check-in was swift, and the usual string bracelets Paradisus is known for were quickly attached for our 'branding' and we were set to head to our rooms.

I was in a double-bedded room with a small sofa, table, 2 chairs, and ample closet and drawer space.  The bidet in the bathroom was a treat to see as I'd thought that nice feature was a thing of the past.  Bathroom amenities were minimal, but all worked.  Every toilet seat I'd used in conference center, public areas, and my bathroom all were incorrect sizes, and as such, would capture the pinchiest bit of flesh with each use.  OUCH!  I did see that staff tried putting rolled up hunks of TP under them to try to mitigate this pinching, but it was pretty ineffective.  To KNOW that this issue exists and do nothing more permanent to fix it is really two marks off their scores.

Food was mostly buffet, and the foods were not heated adequately.  This was a concern, and something I do check whenever I do site inspections of resorts/hotels.  Desserts were lacking (Jell-o cheesecake?), and food, in general, was average.   One exception was the Agave eatery.  I thought the drinks, service and food there were excellent.

Maid service was erratic.  Disco - a JOKE.  There is no dance floor, and the 'dj' played various versions of 'Blurred Lines' at least 10 x throughout the day and evening.  

re: the Conference Center, it was adequate, but the placement of rest rooms in relation to some of the meeting areas was ridiculously far.  Also, there is NO way a wheelchair-bound person could negotiate entrance to the conference rooms.  No elevators, and the strangest array of stairs/escalators and obstacles one can imagine.

reviews.author: kgitts
reviews.title: Great Time
reviews.text: Very Nice Stay. Service was great. Beds very comfortable. I was a little disappointed that the some of the buffet food was cold and they have no was to heat it for you. and The staff in the spa would let certain people in the spa area for a free trial day (use of steamroom and Sauna, hydro-pool)  and not let others in for a free trial day . Also the price for use of spa would change depending on who you asked.- Otherwise We had a great experience.

reviews.author: Maggiec1949
reviews.title: Nice Place!
reviews.text:
Neat place whether for business and/or pleasure. We were there for 6 days last week. Good food, & most waiters/waitresses very helpful & customer friendly especially when they spoke some English. Rooms are nice & large for a couple, but I would recommend the Adult section when possible to avoid screaming kids, otherwise, very good & comfortable. A truly beautiful setting.
We would've given it a 5, but the hollow, louvered room door to the room allows too much noise into the room, and there are NOT enough chairs at the pool unless you go out & get one at 6:30 am.
However, despite these, minor complaints, We definitely would go back for a return fun time! Enjoy!

reviews.author: mthighness
reviews.title: Paradise at Paradisus
reviews.text:
This is a great place!  Lots to do right on sight.  Mini courses (ie how to make sushi), entertainment at the pool and on the beach, beach and water were beautiful, staff was wonderful, rooms are great!  Our conference was all inclusive, no money needed for anything thing.  The food and drinks were outstanding.  Definitely do the restaurants for dinner, not the buffet. They are all different but excellent. Go to guest services at 9am to make reservations for the next night.  We did the speed boat/snorkeling tour - great/fun experience.  Also took the local bus to Playa Tortuga to catch the ferry to Isla Muerres...although we did not tour the island in a golf cart, what we saw in town was trinkets on steroids...unfortunately.  We found the best shopping on the second level of the Cancun airport!
Note: Entertainment in the Avenue Bar has very limited seating. Advise you get there around 8pm to grab a seat and have a drink.  And the nightly entertainment in the 'Cenote' is over around 10 so sleeping was never a problem...
We hated to leave.  The staff made us all feel like we were very special guests and went out of their way to make sure we had everything we needed.  Hope we get to travel back there again soon!

reviews.author: Danielle P
reviews.title: Very nice resort!
reviews.text: Stayed for a work conference and just arrived home yesterday. Great hotel, well maintained and amazing ambiance. Staff was welcoming at the desk, but they did not show us how to find our room which left us wandering around in the wrong "pyramid" for 25 minutes. Room was clean and warm. We only had one lounge chair on our balcony though. WiFi was very weak, but did work. The shows were ok, but need to add a show area with enough tables and chairs to seat your guests. Everyone was standing on the stairs making it hard for people to get in and out. Not ideal. Charged for the bali beds on the beach and most were empty, which I thought was dumb. Also, if you are eating at the buffet, I don't see any reason why you shouldn't be able to take your food to the pool area. There is a pool area grill and you are allowed to take hamburgers, hot dog, wings and nachos to your lounge chair but you cannot take any other food. Christian and Efrain from the Ibana bar were amazing. Very nice, welcoming and friendly. We enjoyed our time there. Rafael from the swim up bar is one of the best I have ever met! He would see us enter the pool and by the time we made our way to the bar he would have our shots and drinks all ready for us! That is service with a smile!!!! Karla did a wonderful job with the zumba, volleyball and games. I loved how the whole entertainment team kept the crowd involved outside. The beach is just amazing and beautiful. Able to walk for miles and miles. Food was amazing. Vento was fantastic and the buffet always had something for everyone. I plan to come back with my family the next visit. Very well done Paradisus!

reviews.author: randyh301
reviews.title: Excellent  Experience
reviews.text: During our stay we were able to witness the birth of the sea turtles. We were able to see the birth of the turtles to release of them into the water. This was a once in a lifetime experience to witness this and won't be forgotten.

reviews.author: Hector Sánchez
reviews.title: Great All-Inclusive, yet not perfect
reviews.text:
This review is after a week long physics meeting and is divided in three parts: conference, hotel and all-inclusive. We enjoyed the hotel a lot and would like to come back, but I was concerned that there was a lack of communication between the staff that led to some awkward situations. 

Meeting
Great place to hold a meeting. Del Prado room is amazing, the internet was easy and fast and the drinks and snacks for the poster session were delicious although they ran out very fast (I blame it on us, drunkards). The coffee for the morning break was delicious and water was always available. During the sessions, the AV were top notch, and we could hear and see the speakers and their slides very clearly from anywhere in the room. My only complain is that after the coffee break, no snacks were available so if you were hungry you had to go to the buffet and lose maybe 20 to 30 minutes of very interesting talks.

Hotel
The hotel is gorgeous with an excellent attention to detail. The room was spotless, with very fine furnishing and a magnificent bathroom. The pools were great, very fun and just the right sizes. The beach is INCREDIBLE, a lifetime experience, but it can be a little bit rough, just be aware. They kind of skimp on the towels though, although there are dressing rooms around where you can restock. The lagoon facing balcony was great because it's completely private, you can be naked in there and no one will see you, which sounds odd but happens more than once when going from beach to pool to conference and back. The beds were comfortable and the towels and toiletries resupplied daily. The minibar was not resupplied daily. The check in was drawn out. The concept of a checkout pass is uneeded and idiotic, they already have my credit card information! There are a lot of sites to just crash all around the hotel. It is definitely pretier at night. Didn't use a concierge or the other services of the hotel.

All Inclusive.
First I'll say the restaurants ARE not prepared for groups of people. We were a group of 7 to 10 people that wanted to share meals and only MOLE and BANA accommodated us. In all of the other restaurants, we had to split tables since waiters wouldn't join them, which seems odd since we were going to eat there anyway. 

NAOS. It's the only restaurant which is open early so it's your only option for breakfast and early lunch. Because of this, the line for the omelettes can get ridiculous even with two stations and you kind of have to wave your way around to get your food. Service was good to great depending on who waits you, but you do get tired of the flavors here although they are not bad per se.

MARKET GRILL. We were never able to eat here, eveb after trying 3 times. First time, they couldn't accommodate 6 people, second time it turns out they could but they thought it was not included. We checked and it was so we came back, third time, waiting time was 2 hours. We didn't try a 4th time. Waiters were kind of rude through all of this, never seeming to know what was available or included. Such a shame.

BANA. Waiter captain told uf the waiting time was 1 hour for 8 people so we went and had some drinks at the relaxing lounge. An hour later we went and asked and were told to wait more. We waited 2 hours after which we were so hungry that we decided to split our group. Food here was excellent.

MOLE. The best restaurant imo. The lady told us that they could accommodate 8 people in 60min but after letting her know that we would need 2 more chairs, they told us to wait 45 more min. No biggie really we came back on time and was told that "you should have been here at x time sir". Don't be rude to me, I'm following your instructions. Food here was AMAZING, everything we had was seasoned and cooked perfectly. The waiting staff was excellent and got away with tips from guys that are not tippers. Such a good experience after the reprimand. 

BLUE AGAVE. Excellent taco place which was surprisingly authentic. Opens late into the evening, which is great after some dancing in the red lounge. Service was slow but waiters very nice.

RED LOUNGE. Very fun little dancing bar with good music although the DJ doesn't really change the mix much so by the third day you know what song comes next. Not a bad thing, but you might consider going out somewhere else. It was not hot and very clean. Had an amazing time in this bar.

COCOs. Beach side bar was fun sometimes but the service kind of slow. It has beds where you can chillax and a ton of mixes. Daiquiries, palomad, piña colada, margaritas, huracan, blue lagoon, beer and other simple mixes are available well into the night. Sometimes they have music. On my last day, bartender was rude and would not serve me even if I extended my all inclusive. Decided to go to the pool bar instead where they did serve me. We had a feeling that american and european tourists where given priority before us. I know they tip well, but we also tip even though we are not white.

POOL BAR. AMAZING! Very fast serving time and the guys there are a riot. Never was my cup dry and they had a dirty joke for everything we ordered.

POOL SIDE SNACKS. They were good and on hand.

CHECK OUT. There is a communication issue in the hotel and that is clear. Not all the staff knows what bracelet includes what and I had to give my room number a lot of times. My flight left late and I wanted to keep enjoying the place so I did a late checkout for which you can pay $10usd per hour per person, which really is a good rate. I was told on front that it extended my all included but I had to explain that many times. Could have just added another bracelet so I wouldn't be bothered every 15 minutes for my room number. Even though I enjoyed the hotel I felt kind of harassed since I had to keep explaining that I had extra time.

reviews.author: travelluver1965
reviews.title: Birthday trip 2014
reviews.text: My review is late but wanted to take a moment to rate hotel.  View from our ocean view room was great. My only complaint was that on the balcony the plants were dead and weeds growing in their place, so I would say the place needs a little bit of renovations. However what made up for that was the awesome view and cleanliness of the beach. I also would like to THANK, restaurant manager Abraham for the Awesome birthday surprise. I was treated to a small birthday cake and sang Happy Birthday by the waiters. Attention to detail like this makes up for any shortcomings like the dead vegetation.  Weather was great and I had a ball on my deep sea fishing trip.

reviews.author: Ana Vega
reviews.title: Overpriced and very bad service
reviews.text:
It was a big hotel with nice rooms but very bad service. The first day I got there, the concierge took around 1 hour to take my luggage to my room and I had to call receptions. It seemed as if they had forgotten about it. I went there as a business trip and when leaving, the concierge lost the bag of one of my team mates making us run late to the airport. This happened on November 7th and till this date (8 days later), it has not been recovered. The fact that the suit case was lost made our whole experience very bitter. 

Another thing we experienced was that the staff would over charge without consulting. We all agreed as a team, that we will not come back or organize a seminar again in this hotel.

reviews.author: Ben G
reviews.title: Perfect setting
reviews.text:
stayed at the Paradisus in June 2014 - first time to Mexico, and Cancun. Despite the slow and complicated check-in process, the welcome was warm. Finding the room was complicated, at first attempt it's difficult to navigate the hotel room logic, but when I did get there it was fab. Fantastic room with a view of the pool and beach. The food and beverage situation was ok, not mind blowing, but fairly decent quality and choice

Highly recommended for couples holiday, but you will be left wanting for alternative F&B outlets, all of which are a taxi ride from the hotel

Would stay again

reviews.author: Louise E
reviews.title: Awesome Resort!
reviews.text: I stayed in the Royal Service building,Adults only,beautiful beach, swimming pools and loved it,butler service,champagne in my room everyday,bar in the lobby with top shelf alcohol,you can pour your own cocktail or a waiter standing by will mix it for you.It was the royal service.I stayed in the Royal service building,but was reconized in all 5 buildings and resturant by our wraistband.

reviews.author: Bobbi E
reviews.title: Excellent all-around!!
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus Cancun last weekend and it was phenomenal!! We had the Royal Service in building 5 and it was everything I thought it would be and more. The Royal Service pool was huge and the Bali beds are great. 

The beach was beautiful and extremely clean. Royal Service beach waiter service is great. We had buckets of water, glasses with ice, cold drinks, & food delivered all day long. (I think we had the Mahi Mahi everyday lol.)

The food is great at the Paradisus Cancun, especially the Mexican food at 'Mole' and the Latin food at 'Fuego'. I'm not a huge ceviche fan; however, the grouper was the best I've ever had.

For us the resort's top service came from Jose Luis & Ignacio at 'Naos'. Every morning we were greeted with coffee and a smile!! Its incredible service like theirs that makes me want to return!! Thank you Paradisus Cancun for a great stay, we look forward to returning next year!!

reviews.author: MyEscapeVacation
reviews.title: Awesome Resort!
reviews.text: I stayed in the Royal Service building,Adults only and loved it,butler service,champagne in my room everyday,bar in the lobby with top shelf alcohol,you can pour your cocktail or a waiter standing by will mix it for you.It was the royal service.

reviews.author: Dwest858
reviews.title: Very Good Stay!!
reviews.text:
I visited Paradisus Cancun from September 27-Oct 02 and stayed in the Royal Service section.
Pros: Very clean and well kept resort. 
Ample food selection which was also pretty good overall
Top shelf liquors with nice pours all around
Great beach
Cons: Aging resort (although well kept and clean), 
Food was a bit redundant, essentially the same food you can get at their buffet with a different presentation.
Ok, so here are my thoughts, I stayed at RS which I stated before and I am glad I made that choice. While staying in RS you are in a separate building which is at least 10 degrees cooler than the rest of the buildings, its very quiet relaxing and has a lot of ambience. There is also a small area for food and drinks which is not busy at all and allows for quick and easy snacks, drinks, ice and such. In addition, with Rs you get 2 days use of a bali bed which is great, in low season, you can also get additional days if they aren't reserved. I went to the beach and stayed at the papilla's which were also very nice. My room was nice cool and clean. Turn down service every night, never needed to call for anything.  I did not receive a phone from my butler Juan, but as I walked through the lobby each day he always asked "is there anything I can do to make your day special"
Pool Bar was very busy happening place, not my scene so glad I was in RS.
Bana- Decent sushi, good drinks, not my favorite
Vento- Very good food, nice overall experience
Blue agave- good quick snack or meal, margarita of the day made fresh were tasty
La Papala- RS- good for a poolside lunch or snack, limited selection
Naos- This is their buffet, I was super surprised with this one, Probably the best restaurant they offer.. I would recommend a walkthrough prior to eating at the ala cart places, see what they are cooking fresh, likely it will be more fresh and better tasting than the other restaurants with a "not as pretty" presentation 
Oh, and starting the week I was there it was a no reservation needed policy for the specialty restaurants during the remainder of low season. 
To just touch base on a few things I was concerned with prior to visiting..
I was never approached by a timeshare person, although I saw them doing the breakfasts.
There are 58 steps to the front door, but my driver bypassed them and dropped me off at the front door.
No reservations for restaurants
Good AC in my room with a great view
Was warm in the main building but I never found myself very uncomfortable
They will convert from USD to peso at a 12.5 rate with no additional charges
Overall, this is a great resort, with great staff.. Its aging but well kept and none of which effected my stay at the very least. Nicest place Ive stayed within Cancun
Oh and the Main pyramid is pretty awesome at night

reviews.author: Dominic Z
reviews.title: Nice stay but was stolen from by housekeepers
reviews.text: Overall the property and employees were very nice. Settlement to our experience was having money stolen by housekeeping. After talking to front desk and being questioned by "investigation team" of hotel employees we were never offered anything in retribution. We were told at checkout to contact their chief concierge. Due to this I would not stay or recommend this property.

reviews.author: Melody707
reviews.title: Tempo at the Paradisus Cancun is Outstanding!!
reviews.text: Our time at the Paradisus Cancun was Amazing!  From the time we checked in until we said our good byes, we felt like we were the most important people at the hotel.  The Outstanding service from the staff made us never want to leave. The highlight of our time at the Paradisus Cancun was our dinner at Tempo.  Chefs Ismael & Felipe prepared us a meal like no other.  We had the tasking menu with the wine pairing.  Each course was better than the next, there were 10 courses.   The presentation was out of the ordinary.  The flavors of each course exploded with flavors.  Carlos, the Sommelier brought out the pairing wines that complimented each course. Our waiter Raul was attentive to our every needs.  We will be back to Cancun, and I guarantee I will be back at Paradisus Cancun and Tempo.

reviews.author: AntilleanOriental
reviews.title: In a word... AWESOME!
reviews.text: I have been to Cancun several times... this time for work. The hotel is amazing and the staff makes it even better! the Mole restaurant was my favorite. I didn't experience Tempo but did tour the wine room... WOW!

reviews.author: GFR2011
reviews.title: Go for the "Royal Service". You can't go wrong.
reviews.text:
I have just been at the Paradisus Cancún for five nights, staying at the building #5, which is the one reserved for "Royal Service" guests. Though the hotel has been around for quite a while, it still is in great condition. Both room and bathroom were large and were generously equipped. The 10sqm terrace offered direct sea view and plenty of privacy. The room features an efficient AC, free mini-bar which was daily refilled, flatscreen TV, free safe, ironing equipment, Nespresso coffe machine, king-size bed, bathrobe, slippers and towels intended for the pool/beach as well as for the Spa.

I especially enjoyed the food. Outstanding quality and variety. I wouldn't mind to stay there for a couple of weeks more. But best of all, the service. All employees are extremely friendly and costumer focused. They made me feel home away from home.

Absolutely recommendable. As mentioned in the title, you can't go wrong choosing this resort.

reviews.author: bsaitow
reviews.title: Great View
reviews.text: I traveled to Cancun for a Convention and the hotel is amazing. First, I got a Junior Suite oceanfront. Waking up with that amazing view from your balcony is priceless. The food is delicious and the hotel offers many options. I called for room services several times and everytime the employees were totally polite and we happy to serve you. You could feel that! If you have the chance to stay at Paradisus... You won regret!

reviews.author: Sanjaya S
reviews.title: Nice Location, Average Staff and Food
reviews.text: The location is great but what wouldn't be on Blvd Kulucan. The rooms are a nice size. However, the service, particularly the poolside was unfriendly. The food was average and even at the special restaurant where we paid $50 pp extra it was not worth it. The desserts had so much sugar they set my teeth on edge.

reviews.author: Mary B
reviews.title: Excellent!
reviews.text: Everything about my experience at the Paradisus was excellent. The hotel was clean, the staff was amazingly helpful, and the restaurants were delicious. I had never been to Mexico before, and this resort truly exceeded my expectations. I would definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: Kristen S
reviews.title: Amazing place to stay!
reviews.text: My stay at the Paradisus was incredible.  Every part of the resort is breathtakingly beautiful.  The pools are great, and the beach is right outside the door.  The rooms were very clean, and I had a good nights sleep every night I was there.  The people at the resort were also extremely kind and helpful.  Im hoping to be able to make another trip to the Paradisus, and I would highly recommend this resort to anyone looking for a place to get away!

reviews.author: jrich2014
reviews.title: Paradisus was great!
reviews.text: Recently I stayed at the Paradisus hotel, and had a great experience. The food was amazing, the staff extremely professional and accommodating, and the hotel itself was beautiful. I would love to go back, it was great!

reviews.author: Lisa I
reviews.title: AMAZING EXPERIENCE
reviews.text: Hi friends! I am writing to let you know about the amazing experience I had at the Paradisus Cancun Resort. The staff went ABOVE and BEYOND in their service and the resort is beautiful with the rooms including breathtaking views of the ocean right outside. The food and buffet offered a variety of items changing daily and the gym was huge even containing an extra Pilates room with mirrors that was always available for your own use for exercises. I highly recommend visiting this resort, you will be extremely happy with your time spent at the Paradisus!

reviews.author: Tushbikinis
reviews.title: Thank you Paradisus Cancun!
reviews.text:
The Paradisus Cancun resort and staff were AMAZING! The hotels was very clean and always offered extra towels and snacks. The staff always made sure that their guests were happy and greeted at all times. The resort was huge and offered many options for families. Relaxing poolside, listening to the DJ at the other pool, excursions, spa and even a kids spa! Thank you for making our vacation extra special! 
Thank you!
Leigha Marie

reviews.author: locolos13
reviews.title: Solid Beachfront Option
reviews.text: Stayed here for a couple of nights while in Cancun for business. The property isn't huge in comparison to some of the other AIs in Cancun. Rooms were nicely updated and decorated. Try and get a beachfront room with a balcony. Definitely worth the view! Food was really good too. Lots of options for everyone. Beautiful pool area and great drinks to go along. I would stay here again if traveling to Cancun again.

reviews.author: Lisa F
reviews.title: It was amazing
reviews.text: I highly recommend this hotel.The staff was amazing nice fun friendly and they went above and beyond!!! Food was great the hotel itself is beautiful.  the beach is gorgeous Can't wait to go back!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Tory S
reviews.title: Paradise at it's finest
reviews.text: I had the wonderful opportunity to stay at the Paradisus Cancun resort this past month and fell absolutely in love with it. The staff were incredibly helpful and friendly. The environment was tranquil, making it easy for resort-goers to relax and enjoy their stay. If you have the opportunity, sneak over to the juice bar at the buffet in the mornings; their options are absolutely delicious! My group and I felt so welcomed and truly enjoyed our stay. I would recommend this resort to anyone interested in traveling to Cancun looking for a premier all-inclusive resort option.

reviews.author: Alyssa M
reviews.title: A trip to remember!
reviews.text: I absolutely loved the vibe of the resort. From the minute you walked in the doors, you felt a peaceful and relaxed feeling. The food was awesome with a ton of healthy choices along with some fabulous deserts. The pools were always really clean and the room service was also fantastic. They accommodated us with anything we needed and really were there to help us out and make us feel like we were on a great vacation. It was nice because there was entertainment and activities all day long but you could also find quiet spots as well where there was just some nice music playing and you could tan in the sun. I would totally recommend the paradisus cancun to anyone traveling there!

reviews.author: sheilaws
reviews.title: Nice All Inclusive Resort
reviews.text:
Let me preference my review by stating that I was a paid guess in attendance at a Travel Professional Training Forum held at this property. 
Upon arrival I was checked in, a cloth bracelet with wooden logo oval placed on my wrist and asked to return later as my room was not yet ready. I chose the time to get some breakfast, as I arrived on a night owl flight. The buffet selection was vast and the food tasty. The service was fantastic. When I returned to the front desk my room was ready and I wen to my rm where my luggage was already waiting. I had requested a King and my room was a Double. The front desk informed me to try in the morning and I would be moved if a King became available. The room and its amentities were fantastic and the view was beautiful. The free internet connection was wonderful. A fruit basket and bottle of champaigne were in the room upon my arrival and later that evening a lovely pastry amenity was delivered. I spent the afternoon exploring. The resort consists of 5 towers. Tower 5 is for Royal Service guests and has its own entry to the adult pool and beach areas. it appeared that all of the othr towers must walk to Tower 5, in order to get to the pools or beach(not a feature I would count as a +). I went to the ave bar that evening and got one of my favorite Tamarindo Margaritas. I ate that night at Vento the Italian inspired Restaurant (reservations) serving tapas plates. The service was so good they went to the ave bar to get a Tamarindo Margarita for me. 
The next morning I called the front desk and was told a King would be available for me to be moved to but it would be some time before it was ready (3 hours). Once ready, I was given the key and my bags were moved by the staff. This room was just as lovely but the internet connection was horrid. I had to stand out side my room or sit out on a sofa a few feet from my room to have a connection. I picked up my forum registration materials in the ave bar and ordered a Tamarindo Margarita. The bartenders in attendance informed me they have been out of Tamarind for a week. I informed them I had 2 Tamarindo Margaritas there the previous night. One of them went so far as to tell me he worked last night and i must be mistaken (I still dont undertand the reasoning of this except laziness). I was able to get Tamarindo Mrgaritas at the nightly receptions the forum hosted however. Each time the staff would retrieve the Tamarind just to make my drink. 
With only 1 beach entryway, I found a lot of walking to get to anything outside. The beach front wedding gazebo setup was lovely as was the palaba they use for receptions and private functions. All requests for service from my room were met with immedate response. The internet service in many of the areas of the hotel is non-existent, however. Nice array of restaurants andtypes of food hich tastes good. I as so bsy with forum events/receptions each night I did not get a chance to experience nightlife and events. My pet peeve is wristbands; I dont like tham and don't see the need. If many All Inclusive Resorts can do without them; hy cant they all? Overall a nice resort.

reviews.author: Brittany D
reviews.title: Amazing resort
reviews.text: The Paradisus Cancun Resort was amazing. The resort was so clean and the staff was by far the friendliest bunch of people I ever met. The pool and beach was outstanding. One of my favorite things about the resort was the relaxing feel and zen like quality the resort gave off. I always felt so relaxed when I was in the lobby. Also, the food was very good. The chiefs and cooks really made me feel at home, especially, with my weird requests ( no salt, oil, or butter). I really hope I can stay at the Paradisus again because it was a vacation I will never forget!

reviews.author: Tracy S
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun - INCREDIBLE RESORT!
reviews.text: The Paradisus Cancun is a paradise.  While Inside the resort you feel like you're outside, in a tropical paradise. Gardens, fountains. The food is delicious and so much to choose from. The staff is attentive, courteous, friendly; the service is outstanding. The pools are fun, the beach is picture perfect. The rooms are beautiful and spotless. We never ran out of things to do. e didn't want to leave! This was a business trip. I will absolutely return to vacation. BEST RESORT EVER!

reviews.author: cathytravels
reviews.title: Great Hotel! Luxury at a reasonable price on the CancunStrip!
reviews.text:
Paradisus has the right combo of beach hotel outside, luxury inside! The only small issue for me is the tub/shower combo. Anyone of a certain age, or physical limitations would find it extremely difficult, if not impossible to climb over the tub edge to take a shower. The shower is so complicated to operate, there are instructions on the wall, which help a little....The theme of the hotel is very zen, with incense smells difused throughout all public areas, pleasing to me, but not to everyone--anyone who has issues with scented product will have a problem here!
The food and bar is excellent all around, the night clubs awesome, absolutely an ideal spot for families, singles, honeymooners, everyone. Hotel has a family concierge as well as a well separated Royal Club for adults only. It is a large hotel, which you will really notice when you take a walk down the beach, takes 10 minutes or more to reach the hotel next door! Section of beach is wide, flat, lots of seating. Inside lobby décor is reminiscent of the south Pacific, lots of wood, tropical plants, fish, totally spectacular. What are you waiting for? Book your next holiday at the Paradisus Cancun!

reviews.author: Amandas12345678
reviews.title: Incredible week at the Paradisus!
reviews.text:
The staff at the Paradisus Resort Cancun went above and beyond my expectations.  Every level of the staff went out of their way to make sure guests were satisfied.  I was traveling with a group and the entire hotel did a wonderful job of recognizing us and accomodating our every need.  A special thank you to Gerardo at the Market Grill for always making sure we had bottled water at the table!

The cleanliness levels were definitely up to standards which is very important to me when choosing a hotel.  I would love to stay there again if I had the opportunity!

reviews.author: zadik_11
reviews.title: In contact with the wildlife
reviews.text:
Once again, I experienced the dichotomy between the people that work close to the guests and the bean counters somewhere in an air conditioned room somewhere in the world.
