From the modest house keeping lady, to the maintenance guys, the waiters and hostesses in the restaurants, all did a great job. They all let me feel welcomed.
So where is the problem?
1. Wildlife. The hotel might been built on a huge ant colony, since there is no way I can explain being on the 4th floor and having ants crawling on my desk, near the windows, inside the closet (yes, on my shirts, pants, socks, etc).
They guy had to come every second day to spray the room, but it didn't help much. 
2. A fish is not a crab!!!! Surimi is not crab. If you mention in the restaurant menu that you are serving a crab with the pasta, than serve a crab with the pasta. If you want to serve a crab imitation, that fine by me, just call it that way. "Surimi (Crab imitation) with fettuccini". 
Normally I wouldn't make a fuzz of this, but if you consider yourself a 5 star hotel, than at least treat your guests with basic decency and don't lye to them.   
3. Lack of Taxi service. The hotel doesn't provide transportation from and to the airport or any other destination. Ok, lets say that this is common in a 5 star resort. But when I asked them to call me a service and charge it to my room, they also said that they don't supply that service. I don't have pesos and I don't want to carry local currency, for a short 3 days trip.

reviews.author: MHB1971
reviews.title: Beautiful location, needs remodeling and new HVAC
reviews.text: I spent 5 days at the Paradisus for a business meeting. The price was certainly great for an all inclusive stay. However, food options are extremely limited if you have any dietary restrictions (e.g., gluten-free for medical reasons, thus cross contamination is an issue). While there are some restaurant options that could work, we were consistently told our only option was the main buffet restaurant. We had difficulty getting into the Japanese restaurant despite it being virtually empty one evening.  Overall, the hotel is extremely humid and air quality is poor - it smells very musty and moldy. Of course, that's hard to avoid due to all the indoor plants and water features. But, it was also that way in the meeting rooms in the convention center. And, it carries into the guest rooms.    It was quite strong in the bathtub area with the plexiglass bathtub shell moving under my feet, as well as in the toilet area.  Fortunately, the beach was nice so I minimized the time spent in the room. Since the Internet in the rooms did not work well at all (connecting for 2 minutes and then dropping all the time!), there wasn't much to do in the room anyways.

reviews.author: Regula_9
reviews.title: Lovely and very good
reviews.text:
The hotel is beautiful, the lobby very exotic with lots of plants. I attended a Forum. Too many steps to get to the convention center, first you can use a ramp, then go up two steps, walk a few yards, then go down 5 steps (why not keep it on one level and descend 3 steps??), then walk another few steps, another step down, repeat same and finally get to the escalator. My knees were killing me after doing this several times a day.  The single steps are not marked, if you are distracted you can easily miss it and fall.
The hotel lacks clear markings, very few places indicate room numer locations. Many of us kept getting lost, I finally learned my way around on the third day. Everybody was very friendly and helpful, housekeeping a bit spotty, out of 3 nights I received turn-down service the second night only.. Coffee in the room was replaced after I asked for it, not automatically. 
The food was good, some of it delicious. You have to be a good walker in that hotel!
I did not see a lot of installations for handicapped guests, except the one ramp going down to the convention center. Could stand some improvement in that regard.
The hotel gives a relaxed feeling, the music in the evening in the hallways is very soothing. The view of the ocean is breathtaking, the beach is OK, of course it has waves and can be rough, but after all, you are in Cancun. If you want calmer waters go to Riviera Maya. I hear Paradisus just opened a hotel there.

reviews.author: Irritant
reviews.title: Nice Beaches, Good Rooms, Ok Food
reviews.text:
I spent a week at a business meeting in this hotel.  The rooms are modern and clean, most with balconies.  The beach is well tended and pleasant, with plenty of chairs.  I saw no problem with people trying to "reserve" spots, and they have a policy against it.  They have a nice pool, and reasonable entertainment.  The staff does go out of its way to make the day pleasant.

The food itself was sort of classic All-Inclusive fare.  In that location, you're better off with the package than not with it.  One caution: if you are a vegetarian, selections are quite limited.  I didn't see any activities team for children, but that doesn't mean there wasn't one.  There is also a "Wet and Wild" park not far away, but I didn't try it.

For those who are in business, the Internet service is a bit slow and not 100% reliable, but it was free.

reviews.author: Denise O
reviews.title: Nice place on the beach!
reviews.text: I just spend six nights here for a business meeting.  The architecture is stunning; the main lobby is full of lucious plants and trees.  Given that the property is on the beach and salt water can make upkeep a challenge, management does a great job.  We were on a resort plan which included most meals.  The restaurants were nice; the wait staff quite good.  However, there is only one breakfast buffet which was always very full.  The best tables in the Brazilian themed restaurant on out on the balcony.  Two areas of concern - all the floors are glossy tile or stone.  They can be a little fightening if damp / slick.  Also several of my colleagues agreed with me that the in-room A/C units are very loud making it hard to sleep.  Overall, if you want a beach resort experience, you should be happy at the Paradisus.

reviews.author: Jose Adalberto F
reviews.title: Unforgetable
reviews.text: Nice atmosphere, excellent facilities, the employees at Royal services including the swimpool services are by far one the best that I have had so far. It is a resort that I would be back in the future with my family and friends.

reviews.author: Jose C
reviews.title: Difficult place for business
reviews.text:
I visited this hotel for a business trip where I was presenting as a guest speaker for a business convention. The experience was dreadful , the first night they would not let me meet with the organizer since I was not staying at the hotel and I was forced to pay $85usd for a night pass in order to meet with him in one of the locations of the convention center. Instead of offering a solution like meeting at the lobby or business center I was pushed to buy the night pass (bracelet ).
Once in the service was slow the cafe (indoors) was awfully hot and my drink was made with cheap liquor ( after 85 entry fee I expected something better ). The day of the conference everything was just a sign that this hotel time had passed. Terrible coffee service ( and old coffee pot bowling all day ) almost no electrical outlets in the convention center and noisy AC on the conference rooms. This might be great for tourists but not for business travelers and conventions

reviews.author: Amy S
reviews.title: Fun in the sun
reviews.text: The location was amazing, beach front and beautiful! Staff were helpful and always available. The food was awesome and dining variety tasty.  Safe, comfortable and good for couples, families and small kids.

reviews.author: Salvador C
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text:
Excellent Service , experience, value , etc.
Paradisus gave me what Zi was looking for , the opportunity to relax and at same time do business in the same city ,. Paradisus is no doubt the place to be all year round

reviews.author: WD27
reviews.title: Great Service, perfect location!
reviews.text:
If you're staying here and not paying for the Royal Service, well,........ You could always stay elsewhere.

Being that I'm madly in love with Hawaii, I was quite hesitant to be in Mexico and at first felt a little like I was cheating on my life's partner. Well,...... let's just say, taking a sample of a different menu can often be fruitful!

Seriously, this place is nutz!! Sooo beautiful! Soooo welcoming, soo inviting, near perfect.

Where to begin?,.... oh yeah... choosing your stay. The perks of the Royal Service outweigh everything else, so I'm glad that's where I was and can't imagine anything else. If you go to the melia website, you'll note that it states: Unparalleled. All-encompassing, Elevated, Preferential and Private specifically for Royal Service tower. This is no joke and I know because I was there.  

You arrive at this all-inclusive and if it's busy like it was when I arrived than sadly, you have to wait in line to check in. (4 stars because of a few little things.... this is one of them... little things do add up) Okay, so you check in, you get a cute little bracelet (signifying which bldg to which you belong), you get your butler and you're in heaven..... paradise.

Paradisus boasts a bunch of fantastic restaurants for any palate. It has a little store downstairs. A spa is great place to truly forget the bill you'll pay at the end of your stay and for some laughs, there's entertainment... At Christmastime, it was a special dedicated to MJ. Obviously, the music we all know and love and good dancers but the Michael they had..... boy oh boy.. waaaay too short to make you forget that your not looking at Michael (<--- even though he was wearing a prosthetic on his face to become MJ's twin). Anyways, it was an awesome production in a small space and definitely helped you to feel like you didn't need to leave the resort for a thing.

Later on, after dinner (secured by reservations), we even went dancing at one of the bars/clubs.... great music, crap dance floor but when you're at an all-inclusive, you take things as they come.

The room was very clean, there's English TV (watched a marathon on Big Bang when it rained one day).... And then there's the pool.

So, the beach in front of the hotel is incredible but if you can't convince your butler to carry you down there and you don't feel like schlepping your bumbum down there, well,..... there's the pool. First of all, order the Guacamole and Tacos. YUM!!!!!! Bring sunscreen or prepare to be baked and burnt and lastly, go get your chairs by the pool nice and early as much like at most hotel pools, seats will be gone and you'll be out of luck. Here's another tidbit, Royal Service folks have their own pool!!! No kiddies allowed! Sorry!!!

Honest to goodness, until I make it to Bali, Bora Bora, Fiji... I'll continue to do Hawaii every year, but without question, there's always room in a year to take a tiny jaunt to Cancun and should you make it so, Paradisus should be your choice. The room is definitely not the high end of luxury but again, that's not why people go to Mexico.

Happy travels!
WD

reviews.author: Harry__Hood95
reviews.title: Beautiful beach, average food
reviews.text:
Just got back from a week-long stay at the Paradisus Cancun.  We were booked at the Paradisus Playa del Carmen, but after the hour-long bus ride to Playa, we were told that they had over-booked and would have to send us to Cancun.  We weren't happy, but made the most of it because this is a very nice resort.  Nowhere near as nice as the resort in Playa that we paid for, but still more than adequate for our needs.

To start, we had an ocean view room on the 5th floor, and the view was stunning.  The room itself was nice but not special,  The fridge was stocked with beer and soda, but no liquor for cocktails which was disappointing as most resorts I've stayed at in the past provided whatever you wanted in your room.  Our TV went out one day and it took longer than it should have to get someone up to take a look at it.  And we only had one chair on our balcony, even though we could see plenty of other rooms that had two.  

The food was good...not great but I didn't have any complaints.  We ate at most of the restaurants and nothing stood out for being especially great or poor.  Only real problem was that it was almost impossible to get reservations at a decent hour.  Seriously, book your reservations EARLY if you don't want to be eating dinner at 9:30 or later.      

The pool was nice & big, very good swim-up bar and it allowed you to enjoy the sun almost all day.  Not even close to enough chairs, and no floats or anything to lounge around in the water.  Also, it's not a big deal but the pool was really deep (I think 5+ feet) with no shallow areas besides the kids area.  Not enough chairs is a pretty big negative.

Beach was very well maintained, which is a big plus for me. Again, not even close to enough chairs, but I don't mind laying down a towel in the sand so it didn't bother me.  I did a fair amount of walking up and down the beach, and it seemed the Paradisus's beach was as-well or better-maintained than almost any other resorts on that strip of beach.  

Service was very friendly, although things seemed disorganized.  We waited 2-3 hours to get our room, with very little input as to what to do in the interim.  There wasn't much of a map, or list of restaurants or spa services or pricing for excursions that I saw.  I was interested in either taking a day-trip excursion or getting a massage at some point; however it was near impossible to tell what desks were for what, who worked for the resort or who was a "tour-guide pitchman", or how much things cost.  

I would definitely stay at this resort again for the right price, and would recommend it to a friend as the resort was clean, the staff was friendly and the beach was gorgeous.  It's not a 5-star place, but you're not paying 5-star prices so as long as you have the right expectations you should have a great time.

reviews.author: Brent B
reviews.title: Hit and Miss
reviews.text: This hotel had some good points and also some bad points on our trip.  The facilities are mostly very nice.  They have 3 nice pools, one of which is no kids, if you upgrade to the "Royal Service".  The staff was nice and seemed to be very customer minded.  The rooms seemed a bit dated and in my opinion, need updated.  Every morning when we went to the beach and pool, it seemed there was not enough beach chairs with umbrellas and the chairs around the pool seemed to be in short supply.  We actually did not sit on the beach any because of not having enough chairs and umbrellas.  The spa was so-so.  Not the worst message but a far cry from the best I have had.  The food was ok for an all inclusive.  I did think the breakfast was not very good.  I would go back, but also would have my eyes out for something better.

reviews.author: Thomas T
reviews.title: Nice property on the ocean with friendly service
reviews.text: Recently returned from business meeting at this property.  Nice all-inclusive option with premium liquors and obviously unlimited supply.  Found food in Naos to be more of the same as the four days wore on - plenty of variety but not all that high quality.  Had a room in the 'C' Pyramid (main building) and found that the noise from loud music went fairly late into the night.  If you go to be early, ask for any rooms not located in 'C'.  WiFi coverage throughout the property is spotty at best but if you are there on vacation, this should not matter,

reviews.author: Zachary C
reviews.title: Great place!
reviews.text: Excellent place. I had a blast. The service was remarkable. My only complaint is that the place had a little bit of a mold/mildew smell in the main hotel and my room. In my room there were actually a few black mold spores on a picture hanging in the room. This is an easy fix. Overall great place!

reviews.author: Phil1200
reviews.title: Great Place to be
reviews.text:
I had a nice suite 1 bedroom , 1 living room , 1 bath room with view on the lagoon, 1 wc and 2 balconies (1 with jacuzzi)...

Just disappointed that I was there for business and could not really take advantage on it .. :(

But this will be a place I would go back to make holidays for sure...

reviews.author: Ray L
reviews.title: One of the Finest Resorts I've Ever Visited
reviews.text: Extravagant is the appropriate word to describe the Paradisus.  From the sights and sounds (the resort is all about 'the 5 senses'), to the excellent staff and the food (I highly recommend Tempo), you won't be disappointed if you visit the Paradisus on your next stay in Cancun.

reviews.author: Georgann G
reviews.title: Fun in Mexico
reviews.text:
My husband and I spent four nights at the Paradisus this December.  The staff was helpful and our room was clean and comfortable.  We enjoyed dinners at the Market Grill and the tapas restaurant.  

One note: If you want a hut on the beach, make sure you head there early as they fill up early in the day.

The wait staff at the beach were friendly and attentive to our need for cocktails.  Look for Miguel and Enrique on the beach- two great waiters who will take care of you and assure you have a good time!

We would definitely return- next time bringing the kids along!

reviews.author: David C
reviews.title: Best Vacation Ever
reviews.text: The company I work for took 1300 people to this resort for our Holiday Party in December 2013.  It was the best vacation I have ever been on.  I stayed in Pyramid 5, which is the Royal Service area of the resort.  You were treated like kings and queens.  My favorite part was meeting one of the workers, Francisco.  He was nothing but professional, kind, and took care of our every need.  I enjoyed talking to him about the resort, and they type of business we are both in, Customer Service.  It was truly a pleasure to meet him and be taken care of by him.  The resort itself was spectacular at every angle.  The food in every restaurant was far better than any other resort I have ever been to.  The smell and aroma of the resort made you feel like you were in paradise.  I would recommend this place to anyone, including families.

reviews.author: Michael P
reviews.title: Really Great Resort!
reviews.text: Had an incredible experience at the resort. Staff was amazing as were the rooms. Food was great and accessible. Would recommend this resort to anyone and hope that I can make it back soon in the near future!

reviews.author: Ramon R
reviews.title: Best Company Trip Ever!!
reviews.text: The company I work for (Power Home Remodeling Group) treated the entire staff to a four day paid vacation to Cancun, Mexico and chose the most incredible hotel; Paradisus Resort. We rented the ENTIRE hotel in order to accommodate 1,200 Power peeps!! The hotel staff was very hospitable and friendly. The food was great and the beach was amazing! What more can I say, it was an epic vacation thanks to Power Home Remodeling Group and Paradisus Hotel! We hope to be back soon....

reviews.author: Sarah S
reviews.title: Best Vacation I've had in a long time!
reviews.text: Best resort on the entire strip - Stunning decor with incense burning throughout the hallways making it a very relaxing environment. The rooms were beautiful and our cleaning crew made sure to tidy up the room each and every day. The food was average but there were tons of items to choose from so you can never run out of options. The entire resort staff was extremely accommodating from opening every door to carrying your plate from the buffet to your table for you. Great drinks and entertainment - Will definitely be going back!

reviews.author: Chris M
reviews.title: Amazing experience (PowerHRG Employee)
reviews.text: We had a company party of 1200 people at Paradisus. The staff was extremely nice and polite. the hotel was beautiful. the Pool was a blast. two minutes away (walking) was aqua-world where you can swim with dolphins , drive personal speed boats, snorkel, and jet ski. The water was as blue as the sky. We had the chance to eat at Tempo the food was honestly the best food i have ever had.  This Resort was a A+ experience.

reviews.author: Erica B
reviews.title: Best Vacation Ever
reviews.text: This resort was incredible! The service was amazing and the staff was always so friendly and helpful. The view and scenery was amazing, I would suggest getting an ocean view if possible. I only ate at the Blue Agave and of course the Naos/ buffet restaurant. Food was great, service was incredible. The staff was always around to make sure you were provided with everything you needed. If you are coming for a more peaceful and quiet vacation I would suggest not staying in Pyramid 3, that is where a lot of the bars/lounges are and can get a little noisy at night. I would recommend this hotel to both family and friends!

reviews.author: Crystal H
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text:
This resort is absolutely fabulous! My company was there for our end of the year celebration. With such such a large group, I could only imagine that the Hotel staff must have thought that our stay would have been too much to handle. Quite the contrary! The service was OUTSTANDING! The food was wonderful and the staff was willing to accommodate us in any way. I was lucky enough to have a brief conversation with the hotel manager. She was simply a delight. I would recommend this luxury resort to any friends!
-Crystal

reviews.author: Leo M
reviews.title: Best vacation of my life. Would love to visit again.
reviews.text:
This resort is simply amazing the staff is always courteous and friendly. There are so many different activities to do and the scenery is breath taking. 

I visited a few of the restaurant but I was very impressed with Naos for the simple fact that the staff was incredible. I showed up every morning just to see Enrique Zaval who worked the morning shift. He always went above and beyond to make sure I had a smile on my face and food in my stomach.  These guys made the impossible possible. Providing me with everything I wanted and always was around to check to see if I needed anything else. This was quite a experience for me the way I was treated. We love having breakfast with Enrique.  Definitely recommend stopping by.

reviews.author: Mark E
reviews.title: Best Value in Cancun
reviews.text: The Paradisus Cancun provided a great working environment in a very relaxing setting.  The food was not as vast as other resorts but the ambiance was amazing and vibrant.  It`s location to La Isla and Kukulcan Mall was very close and walking the beaches were fantastic.

reviews.author: GregoryD33139
reviews.title: Everything you'll need
reviews.text: Nice, clean, elegant hotel. Food and drinks also amazing. Room are spacious, well equipped. Small detail but well appreciated, the shower products are Thierry Mugler, really nice smell. Overall great stay, great staff

reviews.author: cmxc5
reviews.title: Great choice if you find a good deal
reviews.text:
There are many good things about this place and some things that are not that great. 

The rooms definitely need some upgrade: the AC system is really loud, twin beds are small, bathroom needs deep cleaning, bathtub didn't work, coffee machine didn't work, tv remote didn't work...

Now the good side about this hotel is probably when you you step into the lobby and you see the vegetation and the nice atmosphere created, for first timers it is just WOW... staff is friendly but i got the feeling that they expect to be tipped... but let's be honest when travel ALL INCLUSIVE we expect to have everything taken care of....food for breakfast is pretty ordinary, my favorite restaurant was BANA, the sushi there was really good and you can have as much as you want.
I would recommend anyone to stay in this place only and only if they find a good deal, but if the price is high, then you can try to find something else.

reviews.author: Kenneth W
reviews.title: Most Incredible Experience!!
reviews.text:
WoW, WoW, Wow!! This is one of the most memorable trip my wife and I ever had. We have stayed in 100's of Hotels worldwide but this had to be the best to date!! It did not start out that way.... First night we had to change rooms because i was on crutches and the walk to all the meeting rooms or dining facilities would have been to much. Then we had to change to another room because of minor house keeping issues. Finally we arrived in room 3712. Our rep Natalia for the Royal Service was so helpful and caring, she made us feel like family!! Everyone was so helpful and friendly everywhere in the hotel!! Special thanks to Valeria Gallardo at the Naos restaurant for extra care and service. Guadalupe at the Check out counter and Raul "Paul Newman" our Bell guy, whose service was exemplary!! This was our second trip to Cancun and we do plan to stay at Paradisus the next time we go!! If you want to stay at a place where everyone from check in to check out smiles, says Hi and are incredibly helpful, look no further!! Give our friend Natalia a call and she will give you a Royal welcome!! Thanks Agains Natalia and may God Bless you and your incredible facility!!
Ken and Ratna Wendling  Texas USA!!

reviews.author: jarodri1
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text:
This was my 9th business trip to Cancun and my first time in paradisus hotel. I have to admit that the personnel and the quality of my stay far surpassed my expectations. Thank you for the wonderful experience.
John Martin

reviews.author: Keith H
reviews.title: I'd stay here again
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancun proved to be a great place to stay for my business/leisure trip.  There is a nice combination of business people, couples, singles and families so no one feels out of place.  The restaurants are all good with nice presentation.  The staff is friendly and willing to help.  All of the water sports that are included are located in the AquaMarina right across the street on the lagoon side. They only have an agreement with hotel and are not hotel staff, hence there are tip boxes everywhere and they have no qualms about asking for tips either.  They require a waiver form where we would be responsible to pay $40/square inch of damage, so be careful.  I still rented windsurfing equipment and a Hobie Cat and did a little sailing.  There are also kayaks for rental.  I am into fly fishing, so I spent a half day with a guide from CancunTarponFishing.com and it was excellent.

reviews.author: Laurielee2013
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Tropical, aromatic,uniquie and Mayan in its architecture  this resort is lovely.  For all ages. They offer the family concierge along with an adults only area.As you enter the lobby it is beautiful and very tropical - jungle vines and very appealing to the eye.  Open atmosphere and an abundance of food options.  Offering an incredible convention area it is great for those small, medium, and large conventions and Destination weddings.  Beach front property on a lovely white sand beach in the heart of Cancun.  You can walk a great distance on a nice flat beach. Easy access to public transportation .  The Spa holds up to  the reputation of the Paradisus properties and even has a little kids spa.....a dream for every little lady in the family.  Pedicure and manicure station.  Hair and make up station and a choice of candy for the little guest.   Food and service over the top. Fabulous destination resort for wedding or honeymoon for certain.  The rooms are spacious and very nice. Room category will vary throughout the pyramids.  I would recommend the upgrade for Royal Reserve area for adults only and upgrade to the family concierge for those traveling with children.  The Paradisus Cancun is quite incredible and I would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Libra24
reviews.title: Lovely
reviews.text:
This a a lovely hotel, with beautiful decor.  The staff are amazing people and just cannot do enough for you.  The are all always friendly, greeting as you walk past - and humble.  

We stayed at the hotel as part of a conference. Although there were over about 1000 people from our group staying there and being transported around - all arrangements ran seamlessly.

One bit of advice, this a HUGE hotel and you can to get lost finding your room (however there is usually a friendly staff member around to help you find it)

reviews.author: IdealistRealist
reviews.title: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly
reviews.text:
This is my seventh time in Cancun and I have always selected this hotel (previously the Gran Melia) due to their attention to detail.  I have used their Royal Service each and every time (worth it).

Melia Hotels International still owns this hotel which recently changed names from the previous Gran Melia to the Paradisus.  The big difference is that now they are all-inclusive.

Unfortunately, I did not have the usual excellent experience during my stay from July 14th to July 19th.  Let me explain:

THE GOOD
The new butler service at the Royal Service Tower was quite good.  My assigned butler, Hector, was attentive and professional.  The best change was the all inclusive package.  The food from Vento, Fuego and Mole were delicious!  This was not always the case when it was the Gran Melia.  As usual, the Royal Service desk personnel were courteous and highly professional.

THE BAD
As I mentioned before, I have been a guest at this hotel several times, always choosing the Royal Service Tower.  I previously requested via email (never received a reply) and made a follow up phone call to Reservations get a room either in the 4th or 5th floor.  During the phone call, I was assured by the reservations representative, Victor,  that all was OK.  Upon arrival, I found out I was assigned to the basement level.  Personnel was unable to accommodate me and did not offer a complimentary upgrade.   Mind you, I am a loyal client and paid top money for the Royal Service.  Oh well, the room was OK but, did not have the views that I was accustomed to.

THE UGLY
In the past (when it was the Gran Melia), it was customary for Royal Service clients to request late check out (up to 4:00 p.m.).  This time I was told that I had to pay (an additional $90) to do so.  Interesting, in various traveling websites, the Paradisus offers late check out up to 4:00 p.m. as part of the Royal Service package.  I was still charged the additional $90.00.  I later contacted via email the hotel's General Manager Conrad [--](conrad[--]@melia.com) and the Royal Service Manager Lazaro [--] (lazaro[--]@melia.com) on July 21st requesting they look into this matter.  As of today (8/3/13) neither has responded. I intend to contact Corporate offices in Spain.

In sum, I am very disappointed with the new Management of this Hotel.  The previous General Manager, Rolf [--], would respond to my emails in a timely manner. This hotel has been a home away from home and I was hoping to come back soon.  I am not sure anymore.

reviews.author: MrLomas
reviews.title: Not a bad spot on the strip... Nice interior courtyards.
reviews.text: The six story high ceiling to floor hanging green vines in the courtyard of each compound are what help save this resort from Cancun-strip mediocrity. They make for a somewhat surreal and exciting atmosphere. The staff are wonderfully accommodating, with the only let down (for me) being a slightly dated room and non functioning spa. Still, location is perfect and the greenery that adorns each compound makes for a superb in-resort experience. Not half bad if Cancun is your thing... it isn't mine though.

reviews.author: Sa11yMc
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: The hotel itself is beautiful. The main entrance area is gorgeous with green vines hanging from the top floor to the bottom floor. The pool area is great - pool bar - and right on the beach. The room on the other hand, was a bit disappointing. The air-conditioner which was under the front door leaked. I didn't realise it was leaking and slipped on the water which was on the floor. The same thing happened in a colleagues room too. For a 5* resort I really did not expect this. I went to order room service and was advised it would take over 1hour!!

reviews.author: toddmac29
reviews.title: Great Place!
reviews.text: great place right on the beach! room was huge and staff very friendly and helpful. Only downside was the food. pretty average. beautiful lobby area. great for couples and familys as close to the beach and shopping as well

reviews.author: Sez0sborne
reviews.title: Fairly good
reviews.text:
The hotel itself is huge I didn't even get to see it all as I was only there 2 days.
Large rooms, but there was a group of us an we all had items in our rooms that didn't work, eg hair dryers, phones.

Staff were friendly and great location.
This is not a quiet hotel, there is music going and water fountains but fantastic if your in Cancun for a party.

reviews.author: Dawn T
reviews.title: Amazing Resort!!!!!
reviews.text:
I just attended a conference in Cancun and stayed at the Paradisus Cancun, what an amazing resort. The staff was so helpful and directed us to every area we had a question going to.  Food was very good and wait staff polite and very quick with service even on the beach.  

Speaking if the Beach and Pool areas both are kept very clean and despite the number of us at the hotel we had no problem getting chairs.

I loved the decor of the hotel, with the ivy vines and koi pond, even inside you felt like you were in a tropical paradise.  The rooms are goregous and kept very clean and airconditioning rocks!

If you need to question where to stay in Cancun I would highly recommend Paradisus Cancun. 

I have to give a big thank you to all the staff as you made our conference even more spectacular. 

Dawn

reviews.author: Just_Traveler
reviews.title: Great Hotel to Enjoy and Relax
reviews.text:
Paradisus hotel is a great option to enjoy Cancun.  Overall hotel is comfy, really nice and has a lot of amenities you can make the most of.  The place ambience is great ( lots of plants and water ).
The rooms are great, spacious comfortable, and enjoyable.  Several pools to choose from and a wide wide variety of restaurants and bars.
Staff is friendly and runs a good service through all the hotel. 
Spa is amazing, super zen, delightful and well placed.  The hydro therapy pool is a relax by itself but massage is totally worth it. 
It's was a convention we went on, but had enough time to enjoy the premises. 

Overall a great place to enjoy the sun and have a great time (even on a work trip).

reviews.author: Patty B
reviews.title: Paradise found!
reviews.text:
I was on a business/leisure trip and was just so very pleased with the Paradisus Cancun. It exceeded my expectations in every way!  Just a short and easy drive from Cancun Intl Airport, the hotel is Beautiful, on a most amazing stretch of white sand beach and the dining and meal/drinks service was impeccable.
I would like to personally commend Ms. Ivana at Restaurant Naos for her superb and friendly service.  She truly went to great lengths to see that everything was seamless. 
 I would also like to acknowledge Mr. Israel Ortiz, Regional Sales Manager, for his Excellence in representing his property and chain and making us feel like family!
I already have my next trip to the Paradisus Cancun planned! Hasta Pronto!

reviews.author: Felipe
reviews.title: Good All Inclusive Experience
reviews.text: Formerly Gran Melia Cancun, this hotel is not on the top of the top of cancun, but it's right below that level. Went there for a conference/tradeshow. Group Check-in was a bit messy, but by the time I got to my room the bell staff had my bag in there already. Room was really nice, but not outstanding. Had a very nice view, a big balcony and a decent bathroom. Didn't like the shower that much, but the rest was nice. The pool was very nice, as was the service at the bar over there. Burgers for lunch were very good. The other restaurants were good for an all inclusive, but again, nothing outstanding. Breakfast buffet was very nice though. Fitness Center was very well equipped and always empty. Conferece facilities were great.

reviews.author: AtlanticTravelGroup
reviews.title: Excellent Service Royal Service Samuel Is Great and German Agular
reviews.text: The hotel is very nice, the restaurants service and food is great. We stayed in the Royal Service part of the hotel. This area has its own check in , bar area, beach area, and you are assigned a butler to your room. Our butler was Samuel , he spoke great English , was super friendly and willing to go above and beyond to provide great service. he had my laundry done in 2 hours, met me at the pool cabana and went off to buy me sun glasses. I recommend requesting Samuel as your butler. On a separate note I have to give thanks to German Agular who was the bartender in the main lobby from 3 p.m. to midnight. He makes great drinks, great conversations and he very professional .He also gave a great ideas for sites and tours. Both of these people my our stay enhanced. Be sure to visti both of them and please stay at the resort , you will not regret it. Take from me , I work in the travel industry !

reviews.author: don l
reviews.title: great building, beach and setting, service was spotty
reviews.text:
The building and facilities are first rate and the hotel has plenty of staff. The ocean views are very good. the pool is excellent. the atrium is impressive and well maintained. The beach is pleasant and if the wind is not up you can swim in the ocean. 

service-- most staff were friendly and smiled ,but you could tell that they were not all well trained. For example, I had to ask several times for a drink in the restaurant. A specific waiter, Victor, just ignored me and his supervisor in a black shirt and earpiece (v impressive--secret service?) just forgot.  I finally stopped a waiter and just took a drink off his tray. The minibar guy just barged into my room even though i told him to come back later. the front desk staff were slow. so they have some work to do.

reviews.author: Darryl F
reviews.title: Wonderful hotel, exceptional service
reviews.text: Company award event at the hotel was stellar. Great room with a majestic view of the beach and ocean, perfect weather for snorkeling and scuba diving, and the welcoming people of Cancun made the trip worthwhile. The food in all of the restaurants at the hotel, along with the buffet, was fresh and varied each day, and the service welcoming and personal. Our waiter in the buffet, Carlos Lopez Garcia Naos, gave us his full attention, always making sure we had our drinks refilled and plates cleared in a timely manner. When we had our last meal the day we left, it was like leaving behind a new friend. Although this trip was on the company dime, it definitely would be a destination for us in the future.

reviews.author: CL5309
reviews.title: Mixed review
reviews.text: Common areas including beach, bars, restaurants and conference facilities were nice. Bartenders, restaurant and concierge staff were friendly and efficient. Checkin staff in Royal Service office seemed poorly trained (eg lots of confusion regarding my credit card at checkout).  My room was large, but had strong musty odor which took getting used to. Also ants were in room. I was glad I was here by myself for business because I would not have wanted to have my family put up with room. Bed was very saggy. Food was ok. 3 or maybe 3.5 star property at best. If you like the whole all-inclusive scene this may not be a bad choice, but if quality vs quantity is your priority and willing to spend more I would probably check out the JW next door.

reviews.author: 197milenam
reviews.title: A Wonderful Stay
reviews.text:
We were on paradisus cancún  2 weeks ago  and was and amazing experience  juan on the front desk was amazing because he always   was taking care to  us  he is a polite person and always has the initiative .  We wish to return again  ,the food have an awesome flavour each restaurant is unique  we love paradisus

Miss Milena Marowski

reviews.author: NadiaWood
reviews.title: 2010 Global Incentive Trip
reviews.text:
I stayed at the Gran Melia Paradisus Cancun for a total of 4 nights in October 2010 whilst travelling with 200 delegates from Europe. We were attending a Global Incentive Trip in Riviera Maya for 3 days, however due to varying flight times to and from Europe we needed an alternative place to stay near to the airport for our travellers. 

We stayed on a bed and breakfast basis and I was upgraded to one of the suites which had a stunning view of the ocean. The hotel reception team were helpful and efficient at checking the group in, however concierge took some time delivering our bags (probably due to the volume of luggage!) 

The suite had a beautiful lounge area and king sized bed opening up to a balcony overlooking the pool area & with a sea view. The breakfast and hotel restaurants served a good selection of food, and there were a number of nearby restaurants too. There are some lovely little tourist shops within the hotel, perfect for purchasing gifts to take home! 

Overall we had a fabulous stay and would definitely recommend this hotel to both business and personal travellers. The passing hurricane didn't even ruin our time there!

reviews.author: dcindc2003
reviews.title: Standard all-inclusive resort
reviews.text: I stayed here with work colleagues this past weekend and overall the service was good and the food was decent.   Nothing special here but it is a quick trip to the airport and perfectly serviceable.   It is close to the downtown area, but road at night is very busy so expect the trip to take 45 minutes.

reviews.author: legendair1
reviews.title: Quiet retreat excellent accommodations
reviews.text: Quiet retreat, the accommodations are very modern did not have time to access the 'a la carte' restaurant but the buffet was only average. All the premise were very clean and staff were polite. Plenty of pools and beach surface

reviews.author: secondfloor
reviews.title: Luxe, but not Mega Posh
reviews.text:
This new all-inclusive resort has a lot to offer. There are amazing beaches, three gorgeous pools, tennis courts, organized sporting activities (soccer, volleyball, aqua-aerobics, etc), a well-equipped gym and a spa that has high-caliber treatments, a sauna, a steam room and a really cool aquatherapy element that is offered gratis to Royal Service (the highest caliber) package members, daily! Phew. And then there are the food options, of which, I think there are eight. Basically, you will find almost any kind of cuisine without leaving the premises. But make reservations early, upon arrival or you'll be eating at 11pm. And if you don't see it, ask -- they can generally rustle it up (ask for real shredded cheese on the nachos instead of cheese sauce, if there's no salmon at the breakfast buffet on the weekends, ask for it and you will receive it). 
My issue is with the Royal Service, adults-only highest caliber service offered at the resort. I don't know if everyone experiences what I did, but mine was not the stellar service experience I associate with staying at a place with butler service (like a St Regis resort). First, when I moved rooms b/c I was concerned with the safety of my first room on the ground floor, it took them over an hour to bring my suitcase. My butler offered two specific services, I agreed to take them, and then he never followed through with either. My colleagues all received things like daily newspapers, petit fours in the room, requested items in their mini-bars and I got none of this, though I asked daily. We each asked for specific toiletry items and it took at least three requests before we got them. On my last full day there, a Saturday, I left my room at 930am and when I returned at 5p, my room had not been touched -- there were still dirty dishes there from the night before. And after offering luggage pick-up, no one came for my bags. It seemed like there were a lot of cracks in the exclusive service. If I were to go again, I would perhaps pay for a lower level of service, adjust my expectations and probably be a lot happier.

reviews.author: stacey O
reviews.title: Can't wait to go BACK!
reviews.text: I LOVED this place!  Friendly staff, nice selection of dining options, great drinks, plenty of amenities.  I got a great deal the night before and was taken care of upon arrival.  They offer a tour of the property in hopes that you will buy and in exchange you get a 20 dollar massage.  Ask for Lucy!  At the buffet ask for Francisco and Antonio, they are the BEST!  They made a flamin’ coffee that was TO die FOR!  The lifeguards kept us all safe and the wait staff kept us happy with top shelf liquor which was nice considering I had the all-inclusive package.  The nightly shows in the main lounge were fascinating, I was happy to be there FAT Tuesday, that show was amazing!   Loved it, sad to be back in the cold... Clean beach, beautiful sand.... No real hot tub outside, I heard it was part of the pool.  The hot tub in the spa was killer....

reviews.author: Steve C
reviews.title: Great Property
reviews.text: I thoroughly enjoyed my stay here.  The property is exquistely appointed and the staff is very friendly and attentive.  I especially enjoyed Victor, Webster and Yareli,  they were awesome servers in the Grill.

reviews.author: cpavilag
reviews.title: DO NOT waste your money on this hotel
reviews.text: This hotel was a nightmare from the very begining, took almost 30 min to check in 2 rooms with nobody else but us at the reception. The quality of the food was very poor, not to mention uncooked rise and very limited options for dinner.  Nobody told us where our rooms where located at a different tower therefore it was impossible to locate our rooms. Now after a whole week since we stayed there I haven´t received my bill, I have been calling eveyday for this situation but yet I have not had any answer. Trust me this is a very bad option for accomodation in cancun, the price if extreamly high for what you are getting, I will strongly recommend other hotels.

reviews.author: Steve T
reviews.title: Saved My Life!
reviews.text: While swimming in the ocean on a beautiful day last December I got caught in a riptide and floundered off shore, exhausted.  If not for the assistance of Angel, the Lifeguard at the hotel, I think that I would have drowned.  He is typical of the exemplary employees there.  Thank you,again.

reviews.author: CL0111
reviews.title: Nice beach side hotel
reviews.text:
Stayed here back in November 2012 when it was the Gran Melia Cancun.  Was here for a conference so I didn't get to enjoy all the amenities.  
Ride from airport to hotel took about 20 minutes.
Check in was reasonably quick, make sure they give you the bracelet thing so you can enjoy the all inclusive stuff.  When eating at the fancier restaurants in the basement, make sure to ask if it's included or if you have to pay extra.
Room was facing the road, but I could see the beach and ocean from the balcony.  The rooms on the other side of the hall were facing the beach and ocean as well, just closer.
Went to the buffet in the basement and it had a decent variety of food.  There's a carving station with a soft taco made to order station in the back corner.
The air conditioning in the room was great, but in the public areas like the lobby and hallways, it was humid.  Be sure to go outside (to the back) and enjoy the beach - I only got to walk it since there was no free time with the conference though.
